articleTitle: BundledSLAM: An Accurate Visual SLAM System Using Multiple Cameras
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Multi-camera SLAM systems offer a multitude of advantages, primarily stemming from their ability to amalgamate information from a wider field of view. This results in enhanced robustness and improved localization accuracy. In this paper, we present a substantial extension and refinement of a state-of-the-art stereo SLAM system, ORB-SLAM2, with the aim of achieving even higher accuracy. To attain this goal, we initiate the process by mapping measurements from all cameras onto a virtual camera known as BundledFrame. This virtual camera is designed to seamlessly adapt to multi-camera setups, allowing us to effectively fuse data captured from multiple cameras. Furthermore, we leverage extrinsic parameters in bundle adjustment (BA) to achieve precise trajectory estimation. In addition to this, we conduct an extensive analysis of BA’s role within the context of multi-camera scenarios. We explore its impact on tracking, local mapping, and global optimization. Our experimental evaluation involves comprehensive comparisons between ground truth and the state-of-the-art SLAM system. To rigorously assess its performance, we employ EuRoC datasets. The results of our evaluations consistently demonstrate the superior accuracy of our system when compared to existing approaches.

articleTitle: Multiple Face Detection Algorithm for Complex Background Images Based on Edge Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Face detection is widely used in fields such as security monitoring and secure access. In practical detection, the key to facial image detection is to determine the facial region and the edge contour of the face. From the perspective of facial region, a rough facial region is constructed by locating facial key points, and then be corrected based on the structural and edge features of the face. Under complex background conditions, edge features will be weakened. Based on this, we adopted a face target search algorithm based on complex background images and tested multiple face images with complex backgrounds on the VOC2007 dataset. It was proven that this detection algorithm can partially eliminate the influence of edge feature weakening caused by complex background conditions, and effectively improving face detection performance.

articleTitle: Cascade Control of Wireless Charging LCC-LCC Structure Based on ADRC
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the context of the widespread popularity of electric vehicles, wired charging has various limitations, while wireless charging has become a research hotspot due to its safety in avoiding physical contact, sparks and leakage risks, strong environmental adaptability, and convenient charging. This article proposes a secondary closed-loop control method based on ADRC for wireless charging LCC-LCC compensation structure, to achieve precise control of the output power of the wireless charging system and solve the problem of output current voltage deviation from the target value caused by external or self parameter disturbances during the working process of the wireless charging system. This method utilizes secondary closed-loop control technology and ADRC algorithm to dynamically adjust and optimize the wireless charging system, ensuring its stability and reliability in complex dynamic environments. This study conducted a theoretical analysis of the system, and then used Simulink simulation to compare the constant current control of the primary LCC-LCC and the PID control and ADRC control of the secondary LCC-LCC. The experimental results show that the primary constant current control and secondary closed-loop control method proposed in this paper can effectively improve the performance of wireless charging systems. Under working conditions, the control effects of ADRC controller and PI controller are compared, and the results show that ADRC controller has better control performance.

articleTitle: A Light Gradient Boosting Machine Based Effectiveness Prediction Method of Space Reconnaissance System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To address the problem of effectiveness evaluation of space reconnaissance systems with limited data sets, vast array of indexes and inadequate model interpretability, an interpretable effectiveness prediction method based on Light Gradient Boosting Machine(LightGBM) and the Shapley Additive exPlanations(SHAP) is proposed. The thorough evaluation process is given and the index system of space reconnaissance systems is built. Then LightGBM is used to establish a nonlinear mapping the model between the indexes and the effectiveness. Additionally, the model’s hyperparameters are adjusted using Bayesian optimization to improve accuracy and lessen computational load. Furthermore, the feasibility of the proposed method is validated by modeling and evaluating the performance of the space reconnaissance system under a particular operational scenario. The experimental results show that compared with other mainstream machine learning methods, the proposed method has higher prediction accuracy and can efficiently extract the potential characteristics of the space reconnaissance system.

articleTitle: Energy Consumption Optimization Strategy for Autonomous Underwater Vehicles Based on Model Prediction Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Enhancing the endurance of autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) is an important foundation for AUVs to be able to perform various types of complex missions as well as return safely. In this paper, for the problem of insufficient energy during the AUV mission, an energy-saving model predictive controller is proposed to reduce the control energy of the AUV when it returns back and avoid the risk of loss of connection caused by energy exhaustion of the AUV. Firstly, the dynamics model of the AUV and the energy consumption model of the power system are established, and it is analyzed that the propellers are the main energy consumption source, due to the existence of the base system energy consumption, the energy consumption can be reduced by optimizing the surge speed. Secondly, leveraging conventional line-of-sight (LOS) guidance for reference tracking, the proposed controller tracks the desired heading and optimal surge velocity within the model prediction framework. Through simulation results, it is demonstrated that the proposed method effectively minimizes energy loss during the return phase.

articleTitle: Differential Energy-Driven Adaptive Dual-Threshold Collaborative Spectrum Sensing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In emergency communication scenarios, ensuring highly reliable and low-latency network transmission is crucial. Efficient spectrum utilization becomes paramount in such situations, necessitating advanced spectrum sensing techniques. Cognitive radio systems rely heavily on spectrum sensing algorithms to detect spectrum occupancy, signal strength, and optimize spectrum usage for improved transmission efficiency. Among various spectrum sensing algorithms, the energy detection algorithm stands out but suffers from performance degradation under noise uncertainty and low signal-to-noise ratio. To address these challenges, we introduce an innovative adaptive dual-threshold collaborative spectrum sensing algorithm based on differential energy. Simulations and experiments demonstrate that our proposed algorithm significantly enhances detection efficiency, especially in low SNR environments, and effectively handles double threshold confusion. This advancement contributes to more robust and dependable spectrum sensing in critical communication systems.

articleTitle: Emulation of Forest Fire Spread Using LSTM and Cellular Automata
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Forests are one of the most valuable and necessary resources to protect the ecological balance of the planet, a natural habitat for animals, and they are vital to our lives in many direct and indirect ways. However, forest fires can cause severe damage to the land and many other resources such as property, human life, and wildlife. Previously, metacellular automata have been used to simulate the spread of forest fires, and the traditional metacellular automata model outputs the spread of forest fires by inputting forest fire-related factors such as topography, meteorology, and vegetation type, but these inputs are highly unstable and fires can have an effect on the wind direction and speed, so the inputs must be calibrated. The aim of this study is to explore a forest fire spread simulation model based on Long Short-Term Memory(LSTM) and Cellular Automaton (CA), and to improve the accuracy of the simulation results by calibrating the incoming parameters of the CA in order to improve the fire-fighting action during forest fires.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Cloud-Based Intelligent Diagnosis Platform for Chronic Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: At present, the problem of chronic diseases in China is becoming more and more prominent, and there is a trend of rejuvenation, among which diabetes, as a common chronic disease, is located in the first place in the world in terms of the number of patients. To alleviate the aforementioned problems, this paper designs a cloud platform for intelligent diagnosis of chronic diseases. The platform is dedicated to helping people effectively prevent chronic diseases and reduce the risk of developing complications. In this study, diabetes prediction models are analyzed from multiple perspectives, firstly, the category imbalance problem is solved by SMOTE-ENN, and then models such as KNN, logistic regression, random forest, SVM, GBDT, and XGBoost are used to classify the samples respectively and the optimization performances of the two hyper-parameter tuning methods, Bayesian and random search, are compared. Experiments show that XGBoost based on Bayesian optimization outperforms other models and can be applied to intelligent diagnosis of diabetes.

articleTitle: Backstepping Sliding Mode Control for Trajectory Tracking of Mobile Robot: An Experimental and Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper investigates the trajectory tracking control for a mobile robot under nonholonomic constraints. To address those constraints and the system’s MIMO nature, a backstepping-based Sliding Mode Controller (SMC) is designed at the kinematic level to ensure the system’s asymptotic stability. Complementing this, two Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controllers manage the lower-level velocity control. Compared with two alternative methods from existing literature, the SMC excels notably in time and energy efficiency, albeit at a slightly reduced accuracy. The factors contributing to this accuracy variation are thoroughly discussed. Finally, experimental results are presented to demonstrate the overall performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on improved overhead transmission line defect detection algorithm based on YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Electric energy is one of the most important fundamental energy sources. As an important part of the power system, it is necessary to ensure the safe and stable operation of transmission lines. To improve the accuracy of recognition, this article proposes a transmission line defect detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv8 to address the practical problems in inspection. Firstly, add full dimensional dynamic convolution to the original algorithm to improve its feature extraction ability and detection accuracy without increasing computational complexity; Then, due to the loss of a large amount of position and feature information after multiple downsampling of the feature map, a dynamic object detection head DyHead (Dynamic Head) combined with attention mechanism is adopted. This detection head integrates scale perception, spatial perception, and task perception to achieve stronger feature expression ability; Finally, use the SIOU loss function to accelerate convergence speed and improve model accuracy. The actual insurance shows that the improved algorithm has a detection accuracy of 84.4%, which is 11.2% higher than the original algorithm. It has good detection accuracy and real-time performance, and effectively solves the problems of missed and false detections.

articleTitle: A Sketching Image Generation Algorithm Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of detail loss and image blurring in the process of generating sketch images from original images, a sketch image generation algorithm with residual block attention mechanism was proposed. By introducing residual blocks of attention mechanism, the generator and perceptron of the network model assign different weights to different parts of the input facial image during the training process, thereby improving the quality of the generated facial sketch image. At the same time, in response to the difficulty of training generative adversarial networks on small-scale datasets such as APDrawing, facial sketch images were horizontally flipped at a ratio of 6:1, and the dataset was enhanced by randomly adjusting brightness. Compared with CycleGAN, the facial sketch images generated by this generation algorithm model have clearer contours, more complete details, and more natural and realistic expressions. The FSIM index is used to compare the performance of different algorithms, which verified the stability and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in facial sketch generation tasks.

articleTitle: Combined Jamming Method of Chaff and Corner Reflector Against Anti-ship Missiles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the jamming ability against anti-ship missiles, this paper studies the principle of chaff centroid jamming and inflatable corner reflector false target jamming, and proposes a combined jamming method of chaff and corner reflector against anti-ship missiles. Firstly, deploy inflatable corner reflector false target jamming. Then, the chaff bomb is fired, and the ship turns to evade. The chaff centroid jamming is formed. By implementing the combined jamming of chaff and corner reflector, the missile tracks the corner reflector false target when the chaff and ship are separated. Finally, the simulation experiments validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: inflatable corner reflector false target jamming
combined jamming method of chaff and corner reflector

articleTitle: Evaluation of Equipment System Combat Effectiveness Based on Task Sequence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For the evaluation of the combat effectiveness of weapon equipment systems, starting from the expression of effectiveness, the probability is used to describe the effectiveness. Propose a method for evaluating the combat effectiveness of equipment systems based on task sequences. This method analyzes the execution of specific tasks by different weapons and equipment, and reduces the task sequence by decomposing the overall task to form basic task structural units. By analyzing the effectiveness of basic structural units and then synthesizing them, the overall combat effectiveness is calculated. Finally, a specific example was used to demonstrate the effectiveness of this method, which can analyze the weak points of weapon equipment and provide decision-making and construction for the subsequent development of weapon equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Nonlinear Hydraulic Servo System Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper systematically analyzes the general modeling process of hydraulic servo system, points out the simplified conditions of its approximation as a linear model, and makes clear the shortcomings of its control as a linear model. In order to satisfy the land-based arresting device’s accuracy control of the hydraulic servo system requirements, using the immunity algorithm to control the hydraulic servo system, the internal unmodeled dynamics process of hydraulic servo system, the internal and external disturbance quantity as an extended state, through the estimated expansion and using the control volume of its compensation, obtained the good control effect. The estimation of the unmodeled dynamic characteristics makes the whole control process less dependent on the accuracy of the model. The problem of nonlinear control can be solved by compensating the internal nonlinear characteristics as disturbance quantity. Adopted linear extended state observer and the pd control with the combination of control method, because the immunity control algorithm parameters is more, this article through the theoretical analysis of parameters and the system stability, the relationship between parameter setting process is given, based on the actual prototype test proved that the proposed method is feasible, improve the control performance of hydraulic servo system.

articleTitle: Cramer-Rao Bound for Direction-of-Arrival Estimation Based on Moving Array
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper studies the Cramer-Rao bound (CRB) for direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation based on moving array. Two cases that may appear in some applications are discussed, namely the case with more extended antenna number than the source number (overdetermined case) and the opposite case (underdetermined case). Firstly, the CRB of DOA estimation for the moving array under the overdetermined case is derived. Then, we deduce the CRB of DOA estimation for the moving array under the underdetermined case and the scope of application for this CRB is also given. Several numerical examples for the derived CRBs are provided by considering both the overdetermined and underdetermined cases.

articleTitle: Parameter Extraction Method for Cut-in Scenarios of Intelligent Connected Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of intelligent connected vehicle technology, more and more vehicles are equipped with ADAS. To verify the safety and reliability of ADAS, a large number of testing and evaluation scenarios have been set up in the standard system and testing evaluation system. The scene of the front vehicle cut-in is extremely complex, and how to quickly and accurately extract dangerous test cases has become an urgent problem to be solved. This article analyzes the driving behavior data of typical drivers by collecting their driving behavior characteristics, and constructs a driving model. On this basis, through joint simulation of driving models and testing scenarios, extract the parameters of danger test cases for front vehicle cut-in scenarios.

articleTitle: CQF-Based Joint Routing And Scheduling Algorithm In Time-Sensitive Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Time-sensitive networks provide deterministic transport for time-sensitive flows in industrial control. IEEE802.1Qch proposes a circular queuing and forwarding mechanism based on ping-pong queues. Many of the scheduling algorithms proposed for time-sensitive networks do not take into account the network topology. For the IEEE 802.1Qch standard in time-sensitive networks, a joint routing and scheduling model that allocates resources based on starting time slots is proposed, taking into account the traffic, network model and traffic characteristics. And by reasonably allocating the network resources for each scheduling time slot, the network load is more balanced. Simulation results show that the number of successfully scheduled flows can be increased by 17% compared with other algorithms. On this basis, the effect of the sorting method and the length of the queue on the results with is explored.

articleTitle: Research on Underwater Seismic Observation Based on Distributed Fiber Optic Sensing Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper conducts in-depth research on the application of Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) systems in marine seismic observation. The DAS system injects pulse laser signals and demodulates backward Rayleigh scattering signals, transforming the submarine optical cable into a series of seismometers, providing a new means of observation for marine seismic research. While international research has made certain progress in the field of natural seismology, domestic research on marine seismic observation still lags behind. This paper carries out a series of experiments at a nearshore seabed seismic observation site, including in-situ hammering ratio measurements, observation of sea-induced artificial seismic sources, and research on the sensing capability of underwater acoustic pressure along the sensing cable. The experiments verify the performance of the DAS system in aspects such as submarine seismic wave perception and underwater acoustic pressure sensing. The paper innovatively proposes sustainable dense sampling and the utilization of a large amount of redundant available optical fiber cable resources, pointing out that, compared to single-node seismometers, DAS systems have the advantage of lower acquisition and operation costs. However, the article also reveals challenges that DAS systems still need to address in marine seismic observation, such as the coupling of sensing cables with the ground, improvement of microseismic detection capabilities, and the management of large-scale data storage. In summary, this research provides new technical means for marine seismic observation.

articleTitle: STM32-Based Intelligent Badminton Pickup and Launch Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper outlines the application value and future development direction of intelligent badminton pickup and launch robots in the sports industry. This project promotes the development of the sports industry by realizing the integration of badminton robot picking up and launching badminton balls. Utilizing the openmv vision module to control the high torque planetary gear motor and McNamee wheel, it can carry out all-around intelligent automatic identification of badminton balls and plan the path for picking up. Using STM32F4xx series microcontroller for serial communication to connect the motor drive module to control the speed of the high speed brush motor, it can control the height, distance, left and right position of the badminton ball launching, so as to satisfy the user’s demand for the development of badminton technology in all aspects. In summary, by combining the STM32F4xx series microcontroller algorithm, openmv vision algorithm and motor drive module and other embedded control technology, for the sports industry to bring intelligent automation experience and development.

articleTitle: A developed residual weighted position estimation algorithm for the power IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the power Internet of Things (IoT), non-line-of-sight (NLOS) error is an important factor affecting the stability and accuracy of position estimation. At present, there are many technologies to eliminate NLOS errors, with the prior information about the NLOS channel. This paper proposed an improved residual weighted location estimation algorithm in NLOS environment. Based on the principle of minimum residual error, the novel method continuously removes the base station with the largest NLOS error through calculation, and uses the residual value to weight the different base station combination results. The weighted result is the final positioning result. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has good positioning accuracy in the NLOS environment of power IoT without prior information about the NLOS channel.

articleTitle: Analysis of metering misalignment caused by abnormal current of smart energy meter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In addition, when the primary metering current transformer is running, the secondary circuit contact is poor, which causes the smart energy meter to lose current, resulting in abnormal electricity. Analyze the change rule of the metering data of the smart energy meter during the operation of the metering device, calculate the recharge power during the bad contact of the secondary circuit of the current transformer, and propose measures to strengthen the installation quality management, weekly inspection management and remote inspection management of the power metering device to prevent it, so as to ensure the safe, accurate and reliable operation of the power metering device.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv8 for Complex Environmental Fish Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer vision and deep learning technologies, object detection plays a crucial role in various fields. Due to the complexity and diversity of underwater environments, underwater vision tasks face great challenges. In this paper, we improved the YOLOv8 detection model for the fish detection task in complex environments. Specifically, we proposed a multi-scale feature fusion method (MFANet) that combines multiscale weighted feature fusion with multiscale attention to efficiently capture multilevel features of fishes in complex environments. We designed a multiscale weighted feature fusion module that combines feature maps at different scales to enhance the model’s representation of the target. By introducing a multi-scale attention mechanism, the model is able to pay more attention to important feature regions. We conducted experiments on real underwater complex environment datasets. The results show that our proposed improved method significantly enhances the performance of the YOLOv8 model in fish detection tasks and lays a good foundation for subsequent underwater detection tasks.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic diffraction tomography based on Wi-Fi signals
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Wi-Fi imaging achieves object perception in the form of images by analyzing Wi-Fi signals and their channel response. To solve the modeling problem of Wi-Fi imaging, a method based on Wi-Fi electromagnetic diffraction tomography is proposed. Firstly, the Wi-Fi communication system is mathematically modeled, which contains a channel model and channel state information(CSI) indicator, and the CSI matrix of the Wi-Fi system is highlighted. Secondly, the electromagnetic diffraction tomography physical model and its mathematical principles are analyzed, and the imaging algorithm is proposed. Then the hardware platform of the system was built, and the software modification and debugging were carried out. Finally, the CSI was acquired by this hardware system, and this data was processed, including the removal of outliers, noise reduction, and phase correction, and subsequently reconstructed into a clearer contour map by the Wi-Fi electromagnetic diffraction tomography algorithm.

articleTitle: A Low-Noise Inverter-Based Receiver for Gigabit-Per-Second Optical Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, an inverter-based optical receiver is proposed to support gigabit-per-second optical wireless communication (OWC). The proposed optical receiver mainly consists of inverter-based amplifiers. In particular, a low-noise shunt-feedback transimpedance amplifier (TIA) is employed based on the three-stage inverter structure with pseudo-differential output. By decreasing the power supply, the noise performance is improved significantly, while the power consumption of the receiver is reduced. In addition, a two-stage limiting amplifier (LA) is adopted to further amplify signal swing. To prevent the saturation of the receiver under strong incident ambient light, a DC photocurrent cancellation (DPC) block is employed. The proposed receiver is designed with a 180 nm standard CMOS process. Simulation results indicated that the receiver achieves a data rate of up to 2 Gb/s with a bandwidth of 1.36 GHz, a gain of 110 dB $\Omega$, and an input-referred noise (IRN) of $0.16 \mu$ A<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rms</inf>. Due to its simple inverter-based structure, the proposed receiver is promising to be implemented through digital synthesis in the future.

articleTitle: Identity Authentication via ECG and PPG Signals: An Innovative Method Incorporating Singular Spectrum Analysis and Feature Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Electrocardiograms (ECG) directly measure cardiac electrical activity, while Photoplethysmography (PPG) indirectly reflects cardiac function; jointly, they reveal vital information about heart health. This paper pioneers the challenges of fusing ECG and PPG signals for identity authentication. We introduce an innovative approach that combines features from both ECG and PPG signals using Singular Spectrum Analysis (SSA) and a feature fusion model. Compared to existing methodologies, our approach demonstrates enhanced accuracy and robustness in identity verification. The results indicate a significant improvement in authentication precision using this integrated method. Simulated studies validate the effectiveness of our approach, underscoring its potential applications in the realm of identity authentication.

articleTitle: Digital Construction Technology for Power Line Engineering Construction Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents a technique and method for the rapid digitization of models in the construction phase. Combining existing information about the power line attributes and model libraries, the paper utilizes laser point cloud data to automatically segment tower head, tower body, and tower leg point cloud data through methods such as denoising and clustering. The paper proposes a method that combines model-driven and data-driven approaches to model towers, ultimately achieving automated modeling for the entire section of the power line project in the construction phase. This establishes a more comprehensive data foundation for the operation, monitoring, and analysis of the power line after construction.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent roadside parking system based on multi-dimensional feature visualization technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of urban modernization and the sustainable development of economy, the problems of driving difficulty and parking difficulty are increasingly prominent in large, medium and small cities. In order to alleviate the contradiction between urban space and vehicle growth rate and improve the utilization efficiency of parking resources, based on the roadside parking data of Nanshan District in Shenzhen City, this paper combines the time series data visualization method and geospatial data visualization method in multi-dimensional data visualization, and adopts the mode of view collaborative interaction to design the intelligent roadside parking collaborative interactive visualization system. The system integrates multisource data, displays roadside parking data information in an all-round way, supports exploratory analysis of roadside parking data characteristics and laws, and helps to understand parking demand and parking distribution at different times and regions. It provides decision support for optimizing parking resource allocation and roadside parking management.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Heliostat Field based on Improved High-dimensional Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Nowadays, tower solar thermal power generation is an essential low-carbon environmental protection new energy clean technology; how to design the layout of the heliostat field in the tower power station so that the energy efficiency of the tower power station, the average annual output heat power per unit mirror as high as possible, has become an essential part of the clean energy project. This paper mainly studies the geometric cone refraction model based on the rotation transformation matrix, and the designed average annual output thermal power per unit mirror area is 0.7181kW/m2, which achieves a good effect.

articleTitle: Research on Short-term Prediction Algorithm for Distributed Photovoltaic Power in Regional Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In response to the current lack of intelligent prediction capabilities for distributed new energy in energy management terminals in regional distribution networks, this article relies on the deployment of new energy regulation terminals equipped with artificial intelligence Falcon A200 chips in microgrid distribution radio areas, and introduces Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) network models to achieve end side ultra short time photovoltaic power generation prediction, And based on this, a combination model with better predictive metrics is proposed by combining the Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) model optimized with dual attention modules. Due to the deployment of this prediction model on the distribution side, there are certain limitations on the model size. Based on this reason, lightweight convolution is introduced to design the model in a lightweight manner, resulting in a lightweight distributed photovoltaic power prediction algorithm model.

articleTitle: Survey For Ruin Probability With Phase-Type Claim Amounts
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Ruin probability is an interesting topic in actuarial mathematics. Phase-type distribution is an extremely popular tool for applied probability wishing to generalize beyond the exponential while retaining some of its key properties. In this paper we study the ruin probability in classical risk model with phase type claim amounts. First the clear descriptions about basic assumptions of classical risk model is given. We introduce the phase type distribution according to the probability of the Markov process into an absorbing state. Next an explicit formula of ruin probability are presented in classical risk model when the individual claim amount is phase type distribution. Finally, we present three numerical examples at the end of paper for illustration. With the help of Matlab, we give exactly results of ultimate ruin probability.

articleTitle: Research On Forest Resource Supervision Technology Based on Digital Twin UAV
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: My country has vast land and abundant resources, including numerous forest resources. Once a major dangerous event such as forest fire occurs, it will be a huge loss of resources, and even worse, it will cause capital consumption and casualties. Therefore, strengthening the effective supervision of forest resources and improving the level of supervision information has become an urgent need to be solved problem. This paper proposes to use UAV to collect the global image of forest, and carry out simulation application with digital twin, which can realize real-time monitoring, simulation and other functions. Experiments have proved that real-time monitoring and virtual-real interactive connection resource supervision can be performed. It can effectively make up for the shortcomings of previous forestry production, operation and management, and can be freely and flexibly reorganized. It has an irreplaceable role and value in reducing natural disasters in forests and saving manpower and time.

articleTitle: A 3D object localization method based on EPNP and dual-view images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In many production fields such as chemical, food, fertilizers, cement, etc., products are usually shipped in bags and stacked on pallets in warehouses for sale and transportation. Currently, long-distance transportation mainly relies on semitrailer trucks or box trucks, while the loading and unloading process of bagged materials relies heavily on manpower and material resources, significantly reducing the overall efficiency of product logistics transportation. This paper proposes a 3D object localization method based on EPNP and dual-view images for addressing the stacking issues of goods in industries such as factory production and logistics transportation. The method employs two cameras and a gantry to form a goods stacking positioning detection system. The Zhang Zhengyou chessboard calibration method is utilized to calibrate the cameras and determine their intrinsic parameters. The three-dimensional coordinates of the goods are calculated through methods such as the EPNP algorithm, perspective projection principles, and coordinate transformations. Experimental results have shown that this method can accurately measure the position of goods under the camera, making it convenient for palletizing machines to accurately stack and improve palletizing efficiency.

articleTitle: Space Frequency Adaptive Interference Suppression Method Based on QR Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In traditional Space-Frequency Adaptive algorithms, calculating the optimal weight vector involves directly inverting the covariance matrix. For covariance matrices with larger conditions, the results obtained by directly inverting are unstable and inaccurate, leading to parasitic nulls on the synthesized beam. To solve this problem, this article proposes using QR decomposition to indirectly inverse, thereby improving the ill condition of the covariance matrix and obtaining more accurate and stable weight vectors. 100 Monte Carlo simulation results show that the proposed method can not only generate large main nulls in interference, but also effectively eliminate parasitic nulls which can reduce the impact on satellite signals while suppressing interference, therefore, the overall anti-interference ability is effectively improved.

articleTitle: Layered Parking Control of Self-driving Buses based on Active Disturbance Rejection and Nonliner Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As a convenient means of transportation, self-driving bus can effectively improve the traffic efficiency and safety, for which arriving and stopping smoothly and precisely at the platform affect the traffic efficiency and the user experiences. In this paper, a layered framework of self-driving bus is proposed, consisting of parking speed planning and longitudinal speed control, based on a combination of nonlinear model predictive control(NMPC) and active disturbance rejection control(ADRC). First, the target speed is planned by NMPC in real-time by minimizing the weighted sum of distance error, ride comfort and travel time. Then, the tracking of the target speed is realized by ADRC, where the extended state observer (ESO) is used to observe the uncertainties in the vehicle longitudinal dynamic, road-tire friction, etc. For improved robustness against the vehicle weight variations, the recursive least square(RLS) algorithm is deployed for online vehicle weight estimation, based on the total disturbance observed by ESO. Experimental results show that using the proposed solution the stopping distance error is within 0.03m, the average speed tracking error is less than 0.04km/h, the error of vehicle weight estimation is about 4.8% with the initial vehicle speed ranging from 10km/h to 25 km/h.

articleTitle: A Novel Intelligent Scheme for Monitoring and Repairing the Health Status of Networking Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The operation and maintenance of networking equipment (including intelligent gateway and router, etc.) is a difficult problem, there is no good solution at present. Based on the shortcomings of the current network equipment health monitoring and repair scheme, this paper designs a novel intelligent network equipment health status monitoring and repair scheme. In this scheme, through the cooperation of several modules and the scheduling and optimization of the algorithm, the monitoring and automatic repair of the health status of the networking equipment is effectively realized, the whole process does not need manual participation, and the degree of intelligence is high. This scheme can effectively realize the monitoring and repair of the health status of the networking equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Injection System of CT Image Enhancement Based on Pressure Feedback
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the study of image enhanced injection system within the CT environment, and provides software and hardware solutions for CT intelligent contrast agent injection system. The structure of the device is presented in detail, and the embedded control system is developed, including software and hardware components. By integrating pressure feedback control algorithms, precise and stable dual injector motion control has been achieved, reducing pressure fluctuations during contrast agent injection for patients during CT imaging. This development enables hospitals to achieve high levels of pressure stability during contrast agent injection and improve the automatic flow rate during contrast injection.

articleTitle: Short Term Forecast of the F10.7 Solar Flux Index based on Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The F10.7 solar flux index reflects the intensity of solar activity and serves as a significant input parameter for the MSIS model of the atmosphere. Accurate forecasting of the F10.7 index aids in enhancing the accuracy of atmospheric density predictions, which is of paramount importance for space missions such as spacecraft collision warning. The forecasting methods for the F10.7 index mainly involve physical models, statistical models and machine learning models. Specifically, physical models can predict the F10.7 index based on the physical laws, while statistical models and machine learning models utilize historical data and algorithms for prediction. In this paper, a neural network model for short term forecasting F10.7 index is studied. The model is composed of a long short term memory(LSTM) network and a feed forward network(FFN). Observational data from 1957 to 2019 is used to optimized the model. Simulation results show that the trained model exhibits an average absolute percentage error of less than 3.70% and 5.73% in forecasting the F10.7 indices three days in advance for year 2021 and 2022, respectively. The predicted F10.7 solar flux indices present good correlation with the actual observational data, proving efficacy of the model.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency Optimization of Aerial IRS-Assisted UAV-MEC Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) powered by Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) can provide ubiquitous communication and computing services for the Internet of Things (IoT). Integrating Intelligent Reflecting Surface (IRS) with UAVs can improve network service performance. In this paper, an energy efficiency optimization algorithm for aerial IRS assisted UAV-MEC networks is proposed to maximize the energy efficiency of the system by jointly optimizing the transmit power, computational resources, IRS phase shift, and UAV flight trajectory. Because the problem is a non-convex fraction, and there are complex coupling relations among the variables. Therefore, an iterative algorithm with a dual-loop structure is used to solve the problem, where the outer loop is based on the Dinkelbach method and the inner loop decomposes the problem into three sub-problems. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can balance the calculation rate and energy consumption, has good convergence, and is better than other comparison schemes.

articleTitle: Collision-Free Path Planning for Dual-Arm Robots Based on Improved RRT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: When using the Rapidly Exploring Random Tree (RRT) algorithm for robotic arm path planning, several challenges may arise, including slow convergence speed, low path safety, and poor smoothness. To solve these problems, this paper proposes an improved RRT algorithm. Firstly, an attractive force function is incorporated into the RRT algorithm to reduce the generation of redundant nodes, thereby decreasing the randomness of the path and improving convergence speed. Additionally, a decoupling method is proposed to prevent the occurrence of the dimension catastrophe during dual-arm path planning. Simultaneously, a layered detection method with the establishment of bounding box trees was introduced to improve collision detection efficiency and precision. Finally, the path was smoothed using Bezier curves to enhance trajectory smoothness. MATLAB simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can provide faster, safer, and smoother paths for dual-arm robots.

articleTitle: Optimization strategy of virtual power plant participating in power spot market
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of the influence of large-scale distributed energy on power grid and the invisibility of small-capacity distributed energy on power grid dispatching, virtual power plant is used to solve such problems. This paper uses robust optimization method to deal with the uncertainty of spot price, establishes the objective function, establishes a robust equivalence model through the existing constraints, and verifies the effectiveness of the model through simulation examples.

articleTitle: BDCM:BERT-based Dual-Channel Hybrid Model for Aspect Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For the current research on aspectual emotion analytic problems in the task of low degree of text utilisation, insufficient extraction of semantic and emotional features from commented text, and inefficient recognition of polysemous words, We propose a dual-channel mixed neurological network based on the Bert’s sentimental analysis model (BDCM) for this paper. the BERT model performs text vectorisation; the dual-channel hybrid neural network model is constructed by BiLSTM channel and BiGRU channel to obtain the full and partial traits information of the selected texts. Finally, the features output from the dual-channel are horizontally fused for the emotion classification. results of the SemEval 2014 dataset shows that BERT is more capable of extracting semantic features from the text. Contrast to this with the primitive model, fusion of various attentional mechanisms in dual-channel hybrid neural network model is more capable of extracting features than the simple one and the performance of emotion classification significantly improves, which can lead to better performance in the domain of emotion classification.

articleTitle: MQTT Subscription Tree Optimization and Performance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the continuous development of the Internet of Things (IoT) technology, the large number of messages generated by the increasing number of IoT devices has brought new challenges to MQTT servers. Due to the need for timely forwarding of MQTT messages, the latency of message reception and forwarding will also increase when there are too many clients connected to the server and message publishing and subscription activities are too frequent. In response to this issue, this paper proposes an MQTT subscription tree optimization method that combines hash tables and trie trees. Then, this method is used to implement the subscription tree module of a simple MQTT server, and its performance is compared and analyzed with several other subscription tree implementation methods. The final experimental results show that when a large number of clients connect to the server and frequently publish messages or subscribe to topics, the method proposed in this paper can reduce message forwarding latency, achieve fast message routing, and improve the efficiency of server message forwarding.

articleTitle: Impact Analysis of Diverse Prior Information and Protection Cost on Attack Efficiency in Cyber-Physical Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The secure operation of Cyber Physical Power System (CPPS) is a prerequisite for all societal activities. However, recent research has shown that CPPS is increasingly vulnerable to cyber attacks. In this paper, considering the virus spreading and cascading failure processes, we investigate the robustness of CPPS under different cyber attacks. In contrast to previous studies, we propose a more realistic simulation model that assumes attackers can not access full information about CPPS. Therefore, we focus on studying the impact of diverse prior information and protection cost on the robustness of CPPS from both offensive and defensive perspectives. We perform the simulation based on theoretical networks and the IEEE 118-bus system. Experimental results show that the more prior knowledge attackers obtained, the more advantageous it is for them to disrupt the system. More importantly, we further analyze the average benefit and the marginal benefit of protection, revealing how to configure the number of nodes to be protected under limited defense resources. Our findings provide practical insights for establishing a resilient CPPS.

articleTitle: Quantum key distribution strategy based on ant colony algorithm in Quantum Trusted Relay Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the quantum key distribution strategy in the existing QKD network based on key relay cannot meet the routing requirements in the hybrid network environment, we analyzes the routing characteristics of the classic-quantum hybrid network and proposes the corresponding routing requirements, and then designs the quantum key distribution strategy based on ant colony algorithm. The ant colony algorithm is used to analyze the execution cost of ants to search for the best global quantum key distribution, which improves the key routing efficiency in the classical and quantum hybrid network environment. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme has the advantages of fast convergence of routing update, small delay of quantum key distribution and more balanced network load.

articleTitle: A Method for Evaluating the Autonomy Capability of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles based on the Autonomy Indicator Institution
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a quantitative evaluation method, which is significant for assessing the autonomy of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles(UAV). Firstly, the four-tier evaluation index institution of UAV autonomy is established, which consists of an Objective Layer, a Competency Layer, an Indicator Layer, and a Factor Layer. When evaluating the autonomy of UAV, the weights of different indicator factors are assigned through hierarchical analysis to obtain the relative importance weights. Then, the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation matrix is established through the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, and the evaluation set rubric with the largest affiliation degree is taken as the judgment result, and the evaluation result is obtained through calculation, which is the autonomy level of UAV system. Finally, the relevant task cases are designed to realize the application of the evaluation model.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis and Tolerant Control of Spacecraft via Interacting Multiple Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: An integrated fault detection, diagnosis, and reconfigurable control method of spacecraft attitude control system is proposed. The IMM algorithm, based on the extended Kalman filter and an index related to the closed system performance, is presented to detect and diagnose the faults. To achieve steady attitude tracking, the attitude tracking controller which shares the structure of a proportional-derivative feedback plus feedforward compensation is designed. As the faults are detected and isolated, the controllers are reconfigured to tolerate the faulty system to maintain the system stable performance. The simulations evaluating the spacecraft attitude tracking demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Method and System for Evaluating Condition of Secondary Equipment in Substation Based on Simulation Check
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency and accuracy of on-site check and point debugging verification of substation secondary equipment, and meet the requirements of effective evaluation of the operating health status of secondary systems and equipment, a state evaluation method of substation secondary equipment based on simulation check is proposed. This method simulates the communication between the main station and the secondary equipment, and then verifies the correctness of the data collection by using the substitution method. Finally, an equipment state abnormality analysis model is established according to the equipment state data to obtain the degree of equipment state abnormality, and the equipment state is evaluated, and an alarm is given when the equipment state is abnormal, so as to guide the on-site transportation and inspection personnel to overhaul or replace the secondary equipment and realize the automatic verification of the data from the source to the end. Based on the substation secondary equipment state evaluation method of simulation check, a substation secondary equipment based on simulation check is developed.

articleTitle: Aera coverage path planning for unmanned ships: an improved COA and PWO composite algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Unmanned Surface Vehicle (USV) face challenges in underwater survey tasks, considering both environmental and self-performance constraints. In complex marine environments with obstacles, optimal route planning is crucial for survey efficiency. To address this issue, we propose an integrated approach by combining the traditional Grey Wolf Optimization (GVO) algorithm with the Coati Optimization Algorithm (COA), forming the COA-GWO composite algorithm, validated through simulation. Ultimately, by defining the objective function for underwater survey area coverage path planning (ACPP), effective path planning is achieved.

articleTitle: Research on AOA/Snell Indoor Fusion Positioning Algorithm with NLOS Error Compensation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In indoor positioning systems, the positioning accuracy is susceptible to Non Light Of Sight (NLOS) environment, which causes certain errors. In this paper, an AOA/Snell indoor fusion positioning scheme with NLOS error compensation is proposed. Using the multipath positioning estimation method, i.e., multipath angle of arrival (AOA), and angle of departure (AOD) position estimation method, and at the same time, referring to the refraction phenomenon produced by light passing through different media, and combining the refraction theorem with the multipath error compensation when the signal passes through the obstacle, developing a compensated multipath estimation algorithm, which does not need to be clock-synchronised, and using channel compression sensing technology, a single anchor can be performed in the Single-anchor point localisation and multi-anchor point localisation can be performed in two-way communication, the algorithm has good robustness and can achieve decimetre-level accuracy in real typical channel simulations.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of 2FSK Signal Modulation and Demodulation Based on Simulink
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on the principle of 2FSK modulation and demodulation, Simulink models for 2FSK modulation and demodulation were established with the Simulink software tools, and simulation analysis was carried out. Simulation results showed that the waveform variations of the signals were consistent with theoretical analysis, indicating that the design was reasonable and the system was effective. Finally, with Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN), the bit error rate (BER) of three 2FSK demodulation systems, namely coherent demodulation system, envelope detection system and zero crossing detection system, were analyzed. It was found that when the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) was large, bit error free transmission could be achieved, while as the signal-to-noise ratio decreased, the bit error rate increased. This paper has certain guiding significance for communication system design and experimental teaching.

articleTitle: Load Carbon Rate Forecasting Based on Genetic-Ant Colony Hybrid Algorithm Improved Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the implementation of the ‘double carbon’ target, load carbon rate forecasting will become essential primary data for power system operation. However, the sample data of short-term load carbon rate have both volatility and randomness, which challenges load carbon rate forecasting. Population optimization algorithms, especially genetic algorithm and ant colony algorithm are widely used in forecasting. However, conventional genetic and ant colony algorithms can easily lead to local convergence, which leads to a decrease in later search efficiency. This paper uses the genetic-ant colony hybrid algorithm to improve the search efficiency. Firstly, the hybrid algorithm is used to force the current optimal solution to avoid the algorithm falling into local convergence. The improved algorithm optimizes the support vector machine’s key parameters c and g. Finally, the load carbon rate is predicted. The genetic-ant colony hybrid algorithm has a better optimization effect, and the support vector machine improved by the genetic-ant colony hybrid algorithm has a better forecasting effect.

articleTitle: Research on the Flight Speed Influence on Airborne Gravity Gradient Measurement
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As a high-precision measurement method, Airborne Gravity Gradient Measurement (AGGM) is easily affected by any error source. In this paper, the influence of flight speed on AGGM is studied. Firstly, the relationship between flight speed and gravity gradient signal is derived from the dynamic formula. Secondly, the impact of flight speed on AGGM is simulated based on the actual flight data of the aircraft. The results show that when the flight speed of the aircraft is 60m/s in the east-west direction and 50m/s in the north-south direction, the impact of velocity on $\Gamma_{xy}$ component is 3E, and on $\Gamma_{x x}-\Gamma_{yy}$ component is 0.5E. Finally, we find that when the flight speed meets a certain relationship, the flight speed has no effect on AGGM. In short, our study not only makes a significant contribution to reduce the influence of flight speed on the AGGM, but also offers some useful suggestions on how to design the survey line.

articleTitle: Research on Data Storage and Analysis of Fire Characteristics in Important Areas
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the information recording capability of the fire monitoring system in important areas and enrich the data set of fire characteristics, the collected monitoring data is stored by using timing recording and change recording, the analog data information is encapsulated in 6-bit ASCII code, and then compressed at a fixed period, and the early data is automatically overwritten according to the memory space, afterwards, it can reverse decode and draw the data distribution map at every moment, effectively reduce the memory space occupied by the monitoring data, achieve real-time collection and long-term storage of environmental data in important areas, as well as later analysis and evaluation, and support the intelligent upgrade of the fire monitoring system in important areas.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage TMV SRAM PUF Preselection Method with Fewer ECC Resources
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The Temporary Majority Voting (TMV) method can enhance the stability of Static Random Access Memory Physical Unclonable Function(SRAM PUF), but it still incurs a significant overhead of Error Correction Code (ECC) resources. This paper proposes a two-stage TMV preselection method, where the preselected ‘1’ and ‘0’ cells are divided into two parts. The response is segmented into two equal-length segments, and each segment is composed of ‘1’ and ‘0’ cells with different bias strengths. During the reconstruction phase, both segments of the response use the same fuzzy extractor. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method reduces error correction resources by 48.6% by leveraging hardware resources reuse without compromising the performance of SRAM PUF. The proposed approach holds significant practical engineering value.

articleTitle: Dynamic Slot Injection and Queue Allocation Scheduling Algorithm Implementing Hybrid Flow Scheduling In TSN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Time-sensitive networks provide deterministic, low-latency, and reliably delivered data transmission to existing networks, while being able to retransmit traffic of different priorities on the same network. To achieve this reliable transmission, the Time Sensitive Networking Standard defines a number of flow scheduling methods. In this paper, we innovate the TAS and CQF hybrid scheduling mechanism and propose an algorithm for dynamic slot injection. Compared with the existing hybrid scheduling, the scheduling algorithm in this paper can schedule more mixed time-sensitive traffic. The dynamic time slot injection algorithm dynamically adjusts the injection time slots of different periods of the same stream, and plans the optimal injection time slots for each stream. At the same time, the CQF mechanism has been improved, and a dynamic queue has been added to increase the number of cached streams in the same time slot. We compare the algorithm of this paper with the HSTC algorithm, and the success rate and number of flow scheduling in this paper are much larger than those of the HSTC algorithm.

articleTitle: A Cascaded Metric Learning Mechanism with Adaptive Weights for Person Re-Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the field of computer vision, person re-identification is a popular research topic, one of its difficulties is how we can enhance the recognition effect of the algorithm in scenes containing varieties of similar pedestrian images. Traditional metric learning algorithms are not effective in recognizing pedestrian samples with high similarity. We propose an adaptive weighted cascaded metric learning mechanism in this paper. The algorithm performs multiple metric learning in a cascade manner to enhance the differentiation between features. The results of each level of metric learning are weighted and fused using an adaptive weighting mechanism, which ensures that some important pedestrian identity information contained in the original or shallow features will not be lost, and also avoids the overfitting phenomenon to a certain extent. Our method achieves good recognition results in VIPeR, GRID and CUHK01.

articleTitle: Drone application in typical indoor warehouses during epidemic spread
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Recently, drones have appeared in various aspects of industrial manufacturing and management. During epidemic spread, drones (Unmanned aerial Vehicles) are widely used in economic and indoor material management. In this paper, drones and two-dimensional code technology in logistic management are mainly discussed. Drones in inventory management would be essential in improving the efficiency of material allocation during epidemics. Some companies now use drones to deliver goods, and some researchers also research drones in warehouses. We conduct systematic tests to certify its feasibility in indoor inventory applications with two-dimensional code technology.

articleTitle: Image Dehazing Base on Dual Attention Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the field of image dehazing based on deep learning, the lack of clarity and color distortion in defogged images has been an ongoing problem. To address the above problems this paper proposes a novel generative adversarial network defogging algorithm. Its generator is composed of an encoder-decoder network, and the shortcoming of insufficient feature connectivity is compensated by adding feature extraction group (FEG) and dual attention module (DAM) between adjacent layers. FEG is used to extract shallow feature information at each scale, and DAM performs feature weighting on feature maps at different scales to enable it to perceive color changes in different regions and enhance the ability of the generator to express features. Comparative experiments were conducted on RESIDE public dataset to compare several mainstream image dehazing algorithms, and the experimental results show that the algorithm in this paper has a greater advantage over other algorithms in color restoration and detail recovery.

articleTitle: Research on Cancer Recognition Based on Deep Transfer Learning and CT Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Artificial intelligence technology has been applied in real life to help people solve various problems, such as smart transportation, smart cities, and smart healthcare. Machine learning, as one of the artificial intelligence technologies, has been widely used in various medical image diagnosis and recognition, including CT or X-ray-based pneumonia identification, cancer identification, and more. However, traditional machine learning algorithms such as random forest, support vector machine, and shallow neural networks cannot fully extract image information, resulting in low recognition accuracy and requiring manual feature extraction, which increases the model’s cost. Additionally, most existing deep learning algorithms, such as fully connected DNN and convolutional neural networks CNN, require a large number of images to train the model. However, obtaining this image information in real life is costly. Therefore, this article proposes a deep transfer learning algorithm for CT cancer image recognition, based on MobileNet. Specifically, we freeze the shallow parameters of MobileNet that have already been trained; then, we fine-tune the deep network parameters to achieve cancer recognition based on CT images. Unlike traditional deep learning algorithms, we use a GlobalAveragePooling layer before the output layer to obtain more critical hidden information while reducing the model’s parameters. Compared with traditional deep learning algorithms, the proposed deep transfer learning algorithm can obtain satisfactory diagnostic results with less training data. Compared to starting training from MobileNet, it saves a lot of training time while maintaining high accuracy. We designed, trained, and experimentally verified the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm on a real dataset, achieving an accuracy rate of 88.42%.

articleTitle: A Customized Quad-Core RISC-V SoC for Energy Control Units
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents a quad-core RISC-V SoC custom-designed for energy control units and data concentrators for smart meters. Leveraging the open-source framework Chipyard and employing a high-level hardware description language and the agile design methodology, we successfully implemented the SoC. The chip achieves a maximum core clock frequency of 1.32GHz in a 22-nm CMOS process, with a nominal power consumption of 310.3mW.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Phase Shift Pulse Control Algorithm for High Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: High current output and fast response is required by the coil power supply of Experimental Advanced Superconducting Tokamak lower deflector. According to this requirement, the main circuit topology composed of 12 power modules in parallel is designed. In order to control the load current change rate, the power module is driven by the mode of phase shift pulse operation. The generation mechanism of phase shift drive pulse is analyzed in detail. The control algorithm of feedforward plus feedback is given, and the software architecture of the system is described. Finally, the pseudo load is taken as the test object, and the experimental waveform proves that the current following characteristic of the system is good and can meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: The Application of the Fifth Generation Mobile Communication Technology in Data Link Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Information warfare is one of the important forms of future warfare, which places high demands on communication capabilities. The existing military communication technology is difficult to meet the distribution needs of a large amount of information on the battlefield. Therefore, the acceleration of the development of military communication through civilian mobile communication has gained widespread recognition in the industry. However, the inherent characteristics of mobile communication make this process very slow. The key technologies of the fifth generation mobile communication can eliminate and alleviate some obstacles to the militarization of mobile communication, effectively improving the transmission performance of existing military communication systems. This article explores the application of the fifth generation mobile communication technology in data links and proposes an architecture for a data link based on 5G mobile communication technology.

articleTitle: High Precision Voltage Sampling Circuit for Battery Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: High-precision battery parameter detection is the basis of Battery Management System. In order to effectively monitor battery voltage, this paper designs a 16-channel high-precision voltage sampling circuit based on $0.18 \mu m \ 70 \mathrm{V}$ BCD process. The fully differential switched-capacitor sampling and amplifying structure is applied, where the advantage is that the capacitor can isolate high-voltage and low-voltage circuits. As for high-voltage sampling switch, a grid-cross-coupled charge pump structure is utilized to drive switch transistor. There is only one differential operational amplifier for all battery cells, which can save circuit area and power consumption. At the temperature range of $-40^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \sim 150^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ and process corner of TT, FF, SS, FS, SF, the simulation results show that the circuit can realize the dynamic measurement of the single cell voltage of 16 lithium batteries in series. The voltage detection error of single cell is no more than 2 mV and the voltage scanning and output of 16 batteries can be completed within $32 \mu\mathrm{s}$.

articleTitle: Feature extraction and recognition of face image based on 2DPCA with LDA algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Face recognition has become a hot research topic in many fields such as biometric recognition and pattern recognition. By processing face images, different features of faces are extracted for matching and recognition. To solve the “Small Sample Size’’ problem caused by LDA algorithm, this paper combined 2DPCA with LDA algorithm and its improvement algorithm 2DLDA to achieve feature extraction and recognition of human faces. In order to improve the disadvantage of slow recognition time of 2DPCA with LDA algorithm, 2DPCA combined with PCA and LDA improvement algorithm was proposed. The experimental results illustrated that the improved algorithms, 2DPCA combined with 2DLDA and 2DPCA combined with PCA and LDA, which perfectly avoided the “Small Sample Size’’ problem, can extract the face features faster and improve the recognition efficiency effectively.

articleTitle: Research on the Quality Evaluation System of Logistics Services for Fresh Agricultural Products Based on improved SERVQUAL method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the characteristics of fresh agricultural products and the current logistics situation, referring to the logistics service quality model, the key factors affecting the logistics service quality of fresh agricultural products are determined, and the evaluation index system of logistics service quality for fresh agricultural products and the service quality evaluation model based on improved SERVQUAL method are constructed. Taking Jingdong Mall as an example, empirical research is conducted on the evaluation of logistics service quality after determining the weight of the evaluation index using the Analytic Hierarchy Process. The results show that the evaluation system can effectively solve the problem of quality evaluation of logistics services for fresh agricultural products.

articleTitle: Multi-Range Spatial-Temporal Attention Network for Traffic Flow Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the increasing complexity of urban traffic systems and the growing significance of traffic flow management, accurate traffic flow prediction has emerged as a key challenge in urban planning and intelligent transportation fields. Existing methods mostly adopt graph neural networks to obtain spatial dependencies from traffic data, yet they often fall short in capturing spatial dependencies across multiple scales. Moreover, due to the intricate periodicity in time and the complex spatial-temporal dependencies, achieving accurate prediction for traffic flow remains a challengeable task. This paper proposes a noval model named the Multi-Range Spatial Temporal Attention Network (MRSTAN) for traffic flow prediction, which comprises two innovative attention modules to model muti-range spatial and temporal dependencies together. Firstly, a gated spatial attention module is designed to obtain local as well as global range spatial dependencies. Subsequently, a multi-scale temporal attention module is introduced to address long range temporal dependencies by combining different scales of convolutional layers and attention mechanisms.
