Additionally, Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN) are incorporated to compensate for the limitations in extracting short range temporal dependencies. Our model’s effectiveness is supported by experimental results on two real-world traffic datasets.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv5 algorithm for driving detection in foggy weather
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In road traffic, foggy weather is a common traffic situation. Heavy fog weather is a common occurrence throughout the year, and it is also common for drivers to misjudge the road conditions due to heavy fog weather, leading to traffic safety accidents. In order to avoid traffic safety accidents caused by low visibility due to excessive particle solubility in heavy fog, combined with the current development of intelligent assisted driving, this article proposes to use a combination of multi head self attention mechanism and YOLO v5 algorithm to achieve recognition of small targets and occluded targets. The experimental results show that the use of multi head self attention mechanism has significantly improved the performance in terms of average accuracy. Through experimental comparison, the network model that ultimately used BoT’s multi head self attention increased its average accuracy by 1.4%, and its accuracy in road vehicle recognition increased by 4.4%, and its accuracy in road pedestrian recognition increased by 0.9%.

articleTitle: False Data Injection Information Detection Method for Power Systems Based on Improved Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the widespread application of information technology and the intelligence of the power grid, more refined and efficient elements have been injected into the power system, but at the same time, it has also brought new network security threats to the power system. In order to maintain the stable operation of the system, reduce the probability of power accidents, and reduce and avoid losses caused by network attacks, how to effectively detect data attacks in smart grids has become a research hotspot in the field of power system security. We emphasized the necessity of system attack detection and defense, and conducted in-depth research on the current application status of various attack detection technologies. We first model the load frequency control system, laying the foundation for subsequent system attack detection. Subsequently, through training and comparative analysis of the application of the random forest algorithm in detecting false data injection attacks, it was found that the algorithm has superiority in classical performance indicators, which also proves its advantages in good detection timeliness, high detection efficiency, and wide applicability. Finally, the effectiveness of the study was verified in practical application scenarios through simulation analysis.

articleTitle: A Non-Isolated Three-Port DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, a non-isolated three-port DC-DC converter suitable for fuel cells is proposed. By adjusting the duty cycle of the three switches, the power distribution between the fuel cell, the battery and the output load is realized. In this paper, the working modes, working principles and key parameters of the proposed three-port converter are analyzed. In order to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the theoretical analysis, a simulation prototype with a rated power of 200 W is built for verification. The simulation results are consistent with the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Efficient dense pedestrian detection based on transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of occlusion between pedestrians and small-scale pedestrians, as well as the huge number of model parameters and computation for dense pedestrian detection by Deformable DETR. In this paper, an efficient algorithm for dense pedestrian detection is proposed. The algorithm firstly uses EfficientNet network to replace ResNet50 network to make the model lightweight. Secondly, this paper proposes a cross-fertilization module that fuses spatial information into multi-scale features and fuses the features of each scale several times, in order to obtain more occluded and small-scale pedestrian feature information to improve the problem of feature loss caused by network occlusion. At the same time, this paper introduces noise removal training, so that the improved detection algorithm can find and locate dense pedestrians faster. In this paper, the improved algorithm is experimentally evaluated on the CrowdHuman dataset, and the detection accuracy is improved by 1.9 percentage points compared to the baseline model with the number of parameters and floating-point computation almost halved.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation of Hydraulic Characteristics of Box Fishway based on FLUENT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As a new vertical slit fishway, the box fishway has many advantages, such as good fishing effect, simple structure, low economic cost, and easy standardization. There is a successful engineering practice of fishway on Qinghai Lake, but there needs to be systematic research in China. Taking the box fishway of Qinghai Lake as an example, the standard $\kappa\sim\varepsilon$ mathematical model was established by Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) numerical simulation software, and the flow pattern, velocity distribution, and turbulent kinetic energy were analyzed in combination with the target fish. The results show that the distribution of this type of fishway rest area is suitable for the mainstream area and can produce “S” shape meandering water flow characteristics. The bottom of the box fishway has a large backflow area, and the turbulent energy in the fishway is small, which is suitable for fish to rest. The design of a vertical slit separator can effectively reduce the peak velocity and create a good flow field for fish migration.

articleTitle: Semi-supervised Medical Image Segmentation through Dual-subnet Mutual Correction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has achieved remarkable progress in medical image segmentation. SSL can effectively learn knowledge from limited labeled data and obtain reliable prediction results while reducing the training cost and the workload of annotators. As the training progresses, the cognitive bias of the model will also deepen. The cognitive bias of the model may lead to wrong boundary detection, which reduces the accuracy and quality of segmentation. In this paper, we propose a dual-subnet mutual correction framework. The VNet is adopted as subnet 1. Subnet 2 is a variant of VNet that employs ResNet34 as the encoder and introduces the 3D Squeeze-and-Excitation module (SE-R34VNet) to enhance the feature extraction and fusion. By employing mutual learning and correction between two subnets, this framework effectively reduces the cognitive bias of the model and enhances the segmentation performance of the network. We validate the proposed method on the LA dataset. Experiments show that the Dice and Jaccard reach 89.52% and 81.74% respectively. The 95HD drops 1.32 and ASD drops 0.3. Experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms several state-of-the-art methods in the medical image segmentation.

articleTitle: Unified Modeling of External Characteristics for Multi-Type Reactive Power Sources Under Short-Circuit Faults
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Under short-circuit faults, synchronous machine power source exhibits voltage source characteristics, while non-synchronous machine power source external characteristics are determined by the control mode, presenting the controlled voltage source or current source characteristics during fault ride-through. At present, the external characteristic models of the above different types of power sources under short-circuit faults have not been unified. Therefore, this paper proposes a unified model of reactive-voltage external characteristics for synchronous machine power source and non-synchronous machine power source under short-circuit faults. Firstly, the excitation regulation characteristics of synchronous machine power source, the fault ride-through control strategy of grid-following converter and the fault current limiting method of grid-forming converter are considered in the model proposed in this paper. Then the short-circuit currents contributed by different types of reactive power sources under short-circuit faults are analyzed based on the model. Finally, actual and equivalent models of synchronous and non-synchronous machine power sources are established based on DIgSILENT PowerFactory to verify the correctness of the proposed unified model and the accuracy of the short-circuit current analysis based on this equivalent model.

articleTitle: Dynamic Handwriting Recognition of Chinese Characters Based on Pressure Sensor Array
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Biometrics have natural uniqueness and reliability, among which handwriting is widely used for personal identification due to its non-invasive and easy-to-capture characteristics. The intricate nature of Chinese characters, a pivotal communication medium for the Chinese, presents significant recognition challenges. Predominantly, existing methods in Chinese character and handwriting recognition rely on static binarized images for identification and authentication, often overlooking individual differences in stroke order and pressure. This research proposes a novel approach for simultaneous recognition of handwritten Chinese characters and handwriting via an array of pressure sensors, which are capable of discerning variations in stroke pressure among different individuals. Moreover, a 3D convolutional neural network with multi-scale residual combined with attentional mechanism (MSR-A-Net) was designed by dynamically capturing time-series pressure data to capture the stroke order of writing. The approach achieved a 97.25% accuracy rate on a custom-compiled dataset featuring ten Chinese characters and four distinct handwriting styles. These results show the potential in the application on Biosecurity detection and human-computer interaction.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of signboard on Spatial Signal of GlidePath
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of civil aviation industry, in order to improve airport capacity, more and more large hub airports build new runways and adopt multi-runway operation, which will cause the taxiway connecting the outer runway to cross Glidepath site protection area of the inner runway. At the same time, the signboard on both sides of the taxiway will be located in the protection area of the GlidePath, which does not meet the requirements of GB6364-2013 and MH/T4003.1-2021. The installation of the signboard may affect the spatial signal of the GlidePath and further affect the aviation operation safety. To solve these problems, this paper analyzes and demonstrates the influence of signboard on spatial signal of GlidePath from multipath interference and radiation interference, which provides theoretical support for construction of signboard and has important engineering value.

articleTitle: An algorithm for critical node identification in coupled power-communication networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the wide application of artificial intelligence (AI) in power systems, the smart grid has gradually developed into a coupled power-communication networks that is deeply coupled by the power grid and the power communication network (PCN). The faults of PCN affect the power system through the coupling relationship, and even trigger cascading failures in the coupled network, so it is of great significance to identify the critical communication nodes that have a significant impact on the coupled power-communication network and protect them for the safe and stable operation of the power system. Based on the interaction mechanism of coupled power-communication network, a coupled power-communication network model is constructed and a critical node identification algorithm is proposed considering the coupling influence.

articleTitle: Adaptive Sliding Mode Variable Structure Attitude Control for Space Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and stability of the free floating space robots in capturing space targets, an adaptive sliding mode variable structure method is proposed to optimize the attitude control law of the free floating space robot system, in response to the traditional sliding mode variable structure method being unable to eliminate the influence of external interference, symbol function, and model parameter uncertainty on the system. This method dynamically estimates the uncertain moment of inertia and external disturbances, and uses estimated parameters to design the control law, thereby enhancing the performance of the controller. And compared with the traditional sliding mode variable structure control law, the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method were verified.

articleTitle: A Weak Signal Extracting Method for Defect Diagnosis in Spherical Radiation Source based on Active Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Gamma-ray source is widely used in medical imaging. The inner structure of radiation source can be diagnosed using active imaging technique. The small defect appears to be an extremely weak signal in the diagnostic image of spherical <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">60</sup>Co-$\gamma$-ray source. This article reveals a weak signal extracting method called IFM (Iteration Filling Method) to distinguish the small defect based on mean filter and median filter. A program is developed based on Geant 4 toolkit to simulate the imaging process. A $\Phi 4 \mathrm{~cm}$ spherical 60<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Co</sup> embedded by defect of $\Phi 1 \mathrm{~cm}, \Phi 8 \mathrm{~mm}, \Phi 6 \mathrm{~mm}$ and $\Phi 4 \mathrm{~mm}$ is chosen as the test object. The $\gamma$-ray intensity of the defect is 98 %, 95 %, 90 %, 85 %, 80 % and 0 % of the normal sections. After image processing, the defect shape can be identified clearly for intensity lower than 85 % and can be distinguished for intensity lower than 95%. What’s more, images of 1 %, 3 % and 10 % statistical fluctuation are tested. The shape and size of defect can be easily judged from image of 1 % statistical fluctuation. The defect edge turns to be irregular and distortion appears for image of 3% statistical fluctuation. Obvious distortion and artifact appear for image of 10 % statistical fluctuation. It indicates that the weak signal can be effectively extracted from the diagnostic image of strong background using IFM. Increasing image contrast and reducing statistical fluctuation is helpful to increase the extracting efficiency.

articleTitle: Image deblurring algorithm based on improved generative adversarial networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The image deblurring algorithm based on improved generative adversarial network is an image restoration algorithm that uses generative adversarial network. In this algorithm, the generator adopts an improved residual block method, which effectively solved the problem of gradient vanishing and reduced network parameters by combining dilated convolution and residual blocks. At the same time, the loss function of the generator has been improved, increasing the generator’s attention to important information and structures in the image. By performing deconvolution pixel transformation on the output of the generator, the deblurred image is obtained. The experimental results show that the algorithm can effectively remove image blur and improve the quality of repaired images.

articleTitle: Multi-RIS-Aided Secure MIMO Dual-Function Radar-Communication System Based on Signal-to-Interference-plus-Noise Ratio
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce multiple Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RISs) aided secure MIMO Dual-Function Radar-Communication (DFRC) system for enhanced dual-functionality performance. We aim to optimize the Signal-to-Interference-plus-Noise Ratio (SINR) as a performance metric for radar, while simultaneously meeting the secrecy rate requirements for the communication link. Major effort is given to optimize multiple RISs configurations that counteract the presence of eavesdroppers and actively manage the propagation environment to benefit legitimate user. The optimization problem is solved iteratively by using CVX and the majorization-minimization (MM) algorithm. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed method with multiple RISs can improve SINR for radar target detection and also secure communication link, which in turn enhances system performance. The proposed model is used to determine the optimum directions for RISs deployment.

articleTitle: Research on Sensorless Control of High Dynamic Performance of IPMSM Based on Extended Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Compared with other permanent magnet motors, the interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM) has stronger pull-in synchronization ability, greater reluctance torque, and higher overload multiple, but at the same time, the magnetic circuit structure is more complex. Therefore, some sensorless control algorithms for non-salient permanent magnet synchronous motors cannot be perfectly applied to IPMSM, which requires optimization and improvement of these sensorless control algorithms. This paper takes IPMSM as the control object, aiming at the problem that the extended Kalman filter (EKF) model of a non-salient permanent magnet synchronous motor cannot be applied to IPMSM, this paper proposes a five-order salient PMSM extended Kalman filter model, and optimizes its shortcomings of increasing calculation amount, reducing the calculation amount. Finally, the robustness of parameter variation and the estimation performance of rotor position are analyzed by simulation and experiment, and the effectiveness of the proposed method is proved.

articleTitle: HTRNN: A New Protein Nuclear Localization Prediction Tool
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Current protein nuclear localization assays encounter multiple challenges that underscore the constraints of conventional biochemical assays and sequence-based procedures. This paper highlights the emerging interest in utilizing artificial intelligence to surmount these limitations. Specifically, a supervised deep learning algorithm, employing the HTRNN model, is presented to identify mechanisms responsible for the nuclear location of proteins. This methodology embraces an entire data-driven end-to-end structure, making expert experience or previous biological knowledge unnecessary. By utilizing amino acid sequence features from both the head and tail regions, the algorithm displays remarkable detection and generalization capabilities, which have been validated by experimental results on present tagged nuclear location protein datasets. Overall, the data-driven algorithm plays a crucial role in enhancing the identification of protein nuclear localization properties.

articleTitle: Research on Construction Method of Science and Technology Service Domain Knowledge Map
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of the science and technology service industry, there is an urgent need to effectively organize multi-source and heterogeneous science and technology resources to meet the personalized needs of science and technology services in different industrial fields, that is, to provide various services to different industrial fields according to industry perspectives. Required scientific and technological resources, including scientific and technological project resources and scientific and technological consulting resources, etc. Effective organization and management of scientific and technological resources can be completed by building a domain knowledge map for industrial industry scientific and technological services. However, these resource fields have a large number of data types, are highly professional, and have complex businesses. How to obtain useful data, information, and business knowledge from massive data and store it in a graph database to complete the construction of a knowledge graph is the subject of this article. Concerns. Therefore, this article proposes a set of methods that integrate data preprocessing and knowledge modeling based on structured data processing and ontology technology to complete the construction of domain knowledge graphs.

articleTitle: Eviction Set Construction Can Be Faster and Victim Interference Less in Cache Side-channel Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Obtaining proper eviction sets is crucial for the success of conflict-based cache side-channel attacks. A minimal eviction set contains just enough addresses mapped to the target cache set. Developing efficient search algorithms that incur the lowest latency with the highest success rate is important. Most existing search algorithms need to trick the victim into accessing the target address numerous times, which might be infeasible in some restricted scenarios. It is therefore important for the attacker to minimize the times of victim accesses. For this reason, the Fast and Firm Probe Twice (FPT) algorithm is proposed. It can quickly produce an eviction set with extraordinarily few victim accesses. FPT has been compared against Prime, Prune and Probe (PPP), Group Elimination (GE) and Conflict Test (CT) algorithms on Intel processors. The results show that FPT is preferred among existing algorithms.

articleTitle: A Low-Power High-Speed Dynamic Comparator with Temperature Compensation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents a low-power high-speed dynamic comparator with temperature compensation. In conventional dynamic comparator design, designers tend to pursue high speed and low power consumption, while ignoring the influence of temperature on comparator performance. However, simulation results show that temperature variation has a significant impact on the delay of conventional dynamic comparators. A novel preamplifier stage with a temperature compensation structure is proposed in this paper. By optimizing the temperature characteristics of hybrid resistors, the delay fluctuation with temperature is effectively reduced. Furthermore, an initial voltage is given to the output to reduce the delay. This comparator is implemented in a $0.18 \mu \mathrm{m}$ CMOS technology. Simulation results show that, compared with the conventional double-tail comparator, the typical delay of the dynamic comparator is reduced by $45 \%$, and the power consumption is reduced by $27.6 \%$; The delay variation at different temperatures is reduced by $8 \times$.

articleTitle: An optimization method for the generalized simplified SWU algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The use of elliptic curve encoding algorithms is crucial in several areas including password-authenticated key exchanges, identity-based encryption, verifiable random functions, identity-based digital signatures, and BLS short signatures. Among the different forms of elliptic curves, the simplified form of the Weierstrass equation is the most widely used in cryptography. For this form of elliptic curve, the most efficient and widely used elliptic curve encoding algorithm with the most relaxed usage conditions is the generalized simplified SWU algorithm. In this paper, on the basis of reviewing the algorithmic ideas and operation mechanism of the generalized simplified SWU algorithm, we proposed an optimization method starting from the perspective of optimizing the sub-algorithm of the original algorithm, i.e., optimizing the algorithm for calculating the square root over the finite field. Substituting the TonelliShanks algorithm implemented in the original method with the more efficient algorithm proposed in this paper lead to a 43.7% enhancement in the algorithm’s total operational efficiency.

articleTitle: A test scheme for time-sensitive network switch in intelligent substation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the wide application of TSN technology in smart substations, it is necessary to study the test technology of power time-sensitive network switches in terms of performance, function, security and reliability. Based on the principle and mechanism specified in TSN series standards, this paper proposes a test and verification scheme for performance, function, security and reliability. It is verified that the test scheme proposed in this paper can effectively achieve the test goal, which has reference significance for the development and testing of TSN network equipment.

articleTitle: High precision time synchronization method of substation based on TSN delay sensing capability
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The internal clock source device (master clock), TSN switch, protection/measurement and control device and other interval layer devices (slave clock) of the substation all use TSN technology to achieve network interconnection. By introducing the TSN network to measure the uplink and downlink transmission delay, the existing time synchronization protocol is improved, the time synchronization error caused by asymmetric transmission is overcome, and the time measurement equation between the master clock and the protection device or the measurement and control device is obtained. Secondly, the local time prediction equation of the process layer equipment is constructed by using the frequency drift characteristics of the local crystal vibration of the protection device or the measurement and control device. By fusing the time synchronization measurement value of the master clock and the process layer equipment with the local crystal vibration prediction value, the high precision time of the protection device or the measurement and control device is finally obtained.

articleTitle: Research and development of centralized GOOSE interlocking device for intelligent substation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A centralized GOOSE interlocking device scheme is proposed in this paper to solve the problem that interlocking between multi-bays needs relevant bays to cooperate with power failure during maintenance and new bay expansion in distributed interlocking system. In this scheme, two centralized GOOSE interlocking devices with identical software and hardware are configured to exchange information with the intelligent terminal through the process-layer network. The two centralized devices operate in the master/standby mode to achieve centralized collection and independent calculation, in which only the host sends interlock information to the intelligent terminal, the standby does not send GOOSE, and the state of the master/standby supports manual and automatic switching. The centralized GOOSE interlocking device in this scheme can be applied to both digital substations and conventional substations, which can minimize the power outage caused by maintenance and bay expansion, and better support the long-term stable operation of substations.

articleTitle: Drug-Target Binding Affinity Prediction by Combination Graph Neural Network and BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Drug development is not only expensive and time-consuming, but often companied with safety problems. The existing methods for predicting the affinity between drugs and targets are plagued with accuracy issues or have weak molecular feature capturing abilities. In this study, we propose a novel method that Combination Graph Neural Network (CGNN) and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) to predict drug and target affinity (DTA). Our approach employs the CGNN module to capture molecular features of drug compounds and utilizes the BiLSTM layer to process protein sequences. The drug and protein representations are then concatenated for the final prediction. Our model was trained on the Davis and KIBA (Kinase Inhibitor Bioactivity) benchmark datasets, and the experimental results demonstrate that it outperforms existing deep learning methods in DTA prediction and has excellent feature capturing ability.

articleTitle: Analysis and application of measurement data of loss voltage fault of intelligent energy meter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Three-phase three-wire wire metering is widely used in neutral insulation system, which is usually used in high supply and high meter customized user metering mode. When the intelligent energy meter fails, it will cause power abnormal. In this paper, based on the power anomaly caused by the loss of voltage of the user’s intelligent energy meter in 35kV special line, the correction coefficient method is used to calculate the recharge power, and the solution is put forward to avoid the power error.

articleTitle: Research on day-ahead optimal dispatch of wind power-photovoltaic-thermal power-pumped storage combined power generation system
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Vigorous development and utilization of renewable energy will help achieve my country’s dual carbon goals. This paper constructs a day-ahead optimal dispatch model for windsolar-pumped-storage joint operation system and explores the day-ahead optimal dispatch results under different typical weather conditions. The results show that the introduction of pumped storage power stations can significantly improve the economic benefits of combined system operation and the stability of thermal power output, as well as reduce system pollution control costs and reduce system CO2 emissions.

articleTitle: Traffic Flow Prediction Algorithm Based on Attention Spatiotemporal Graph Convolution Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of smart city construction, short-term urban traffic flow prediction has become increasingly important. Considering the impact of traffic flow characteristics on traffic flow prediction results, this paper proposes a short-term urban traffic flow prediction algorithm based on an attention spatiotemporal graph convolution mechanism for cities with irregular urban layouts. The algorithm integrates graph convolutional networks and long short-term memory neural networks into an end-to-end network. Firstly, the spatial and temporal characteristics of traffic flow are extracted using graph convolutional networks and long short-term memory neural networks, respectively. Secondly, they are connected with spatial and temporal attention mechanisms to capture the dynamic correlations in the data. Finally, the model is validated using New York City bike data, resulting in reduced values of mean absolute percentage error and root mean square error.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Electricity Substitution Indicators in Industrial Parks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the comprehensive energy construction system, electricity substitution is an indispensable part. Electricity substitution technology directly converts electricity into other forms of energy to meet the needs of various loads, promotes the consumption and use of clean energy generation on the supply side, closely adheres to the design concept of safety, efficiency, and ecological protection in the park, promotes the electrification process, and optimizes the energy consumption structure. In addition, the implementation of electricity substitution work and the integration of clean energy sources can effectively reduce the emissions of pollutants and greenhouse gases, generate relevant environmental benefits, and ensure the construction of environmentally friendly parks. Integrated energy system operators bear the social responsibility of optimizing energy structure and maintaining the ecological environment, and electricity substitution projects are an important source of social benefits, which can quantify the advantages of the system in clean, high-quality, and sustainable development. This article constructs a multi-level, multi-objective, and multi criteria comprehensive evaluation index system based on the sources and influencing factors of the comprehensive energy system benefits in industrial parks, and proposes a quantitative calculation model, numerical calculation method, and index system reduction method for the indicators.

Author Keywords: Evaluation of electric energy substitution index

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Hainan Tropical Fruit Picking Robot Based on OpenMV
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The Hainan tropical fruit picking robot based on OpenMV takes Hainan tropical fruit lychee as the research object, focusing on solving the visual recognition problem of the picking robot, achieving rapid recognition of fruits and completing picking actions in complex scenes. The harvesting robot consists of six parts: an Arduino main control module, an OpenMV machine vision module, a motor drive module, a motion motor, a 2-degree-of-freedom gimbal, and a 6-degree-of-freedom robotic arm. The OpenMV visual sensor utilizes algorithms such as grayscale, filtering, binarization, dilation, and corrosion to process the images captured by the camera, thereby achieving recognition and localization of picking targets. Transmit data to the main control module through serial communication. The main control module controls the robot’s motion trajectory based on data information, bringing the motion platform closer to the fruit tree, and controlling a 6-degree-of-freedom robotic arm to complete the fruit picking task.

articleTitle: ORB-SLAM3 Dynamic Scene Reconstruction based on fused YOLOV5
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of enterprise intelligence and automation, the inspection of power distribution room is not limited to manual work. This paper proposes a semantic segmentation method based on improved ORB-SLAM3 and YOLOV5 fusion to eliminate dynamic features. ORB-SLAM3 is used to realize scene reconstruction to generate dense point cloud maps. In this paper, all the differences between ORB-SLAM2 and ORBSLAM3 are compared, and the dense point cloud generation and loop detection modules are added to make the mapping more accurate. In real scenes, the depth sensor is inevitably disturbed by dynamic objects when obtaining real environmental information. Compared with dynamic SLAM for object detection, the semantic segmentation module of YOLOV5 is used in this paper, which can remove dynamic objects while minimizing the loss of effective features. In addition, TensorRT is used to accelerate the construction of the map, and the semantic map is generated, which makes a prerequisite for the subsequent conversion of the map into a two-dimensional occupancy map. Experimental results show that compared with the original ORB-SLAM2/3, the improved ORBSLAM3 greatly improves the accuracy in dynamic scenes. A more real-time and accurate scene reconstruction function of power distribution room is realized.

articleTitle: Joint data augmentation and attention mechanism for occluded human pose estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Human pose estimation technology has important applications in many fields. Existing research mainly focuses on precise localization of human key points in unobstructed situations but neglects the common occlusion problem in daily environments. Occlusion can disrupt the correlation between key points in the human body, causing a decrease in model accuracy. In response to the above issues, this article proposes a joint data augmentation and attention mechanism for occluded human pose estimation. This article focuses on training human key points in images, generating a specific number and size of occluded areas to simulate scenarios where human key points are occluded. To further enhance the model’s ability to extract feature information, this method considers the global context of feature and integrates the GC Block attention mechanism into the human pose network structure, enabling the network to focus on the human body regions in the image. This method has been experimentally validated on the OCHuman dataset, and the results show that it can effectively improve the accuracy of joint localization in human pose estimation.

articleTitle: Research on Power Quality Analysis System Based on IEC 61850
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the current economy, the increasing number of nonlinear users in the power grid has led to a deterioration in power quality. Due to the inconsistent interfaces and functionalities among various power quality monitoring and management devices, the transmission of information data has become a challenging issue, resulting in the isolation of power systems from each other and affecting system reliability. This paper, based on the IEC 61850 international standard, establishes a communication model for power quality monitoring and management, starting from information modeling, data flow, and functional decomposition, to facilitate information exchange between power systems. Multiple devices on the same drive can communicate with each other through IEC 61850, supporting interoperability between systems and enabling power quality monitoring and analysis. Ultimately, a power substation power quality analysis system with free configuration, interoperability, and long-term stability is established.

articleTitle: SDR-Net:Surface-embeddings-guided Direct Regression Network For 6D Object Pose Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Obtaining 6D positional information of a target object from a single frame RGB image is widely used in robot grasping, virtual reality, and autonomous driving. The current best-performing deep learning-based methods rely on an indirect strategy that first establishes a 2D-3D correspondence between the image plane and the coordinates in the object coordinate system and then applies a variant of the PnP/RANSAC algorithm. However, this two-stage approach is not end-to-end trainable and the method instead of loss does not directly reflect the final 6D pose estimation task. In this work, we introduce a Surface-embedded-guided Direct Regression Network (SDR-Net). The point cloud coordinates of a 3D object are used to steer the network to learn the implicit correspondence between 2D pixel points to 3D object coordinates, and then the 6D pose of the object is directly estimated from this potential correspondence. SDR-Net is evaluated on three benchmark datasets, T-LESS, LM-O, and YCB-V, and obtains competitive performance. Moreover, SDR-Net is computationally much more efficient than the previous state-of-the-art method SurfEmb.

articleTitle: Analysis and research on complex wrong wiring of primary smart watt-hour meter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For the 10kV high-voltage special transformer users who adopt the high supply and high meter measurement method, the electric energy metering device is installed in the process of installation. Due to the careless installation of the construction personnel, the complex fault wiring of the three-phase three-wire intelligent electric energy meter, such as voltage misconnection and current misphase, causes the abnormal electricity. This paper analyzes the measurement data change law under the condition of complex fault connection of three-phase three-wire intelligent electric energy meter with voltage misalignment and current misalignment, and puts forward reliable measures to prevent complex fault connection, effectively avoid electric error, and improve the operation quality of electric energy metering device.

articleTitle: Event-based Fast Visual-Inertial Odometry by Adaptive Slicing of Time Surface
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Event cameras are asynchronous bio-inspired vision sensors, possessing advantages such as high output frequency and high dynamic range, enabling the output of valid information in challenging scenes. Current visual odometry (VO) pipelines based on event cameras primarily leverage the high dynamic range advantage of event cameras, but struggle to achieve a balance between system accuracy and output frequency. In this paper, we propose a fast visual-inertial odometry (VIO) pipeline with adaptive slicing of the Time Surface, leveraging the complementary advantages of event cameras and standard cameras to achieve accurate and fast motion estimator. To achieve this goal, we introduce the method of valid events adaptive slice and an asynchronous tightly-coupled strategy during the optimization phase between standard cameras and event cameras/IMU. Experimental results on public benchmark datasets demonstrate that our pipeline outperforms state-of-the-art event-based VIO pipelines in terms of both accuracy and speed.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation of high-quality development of higher continuing education based on entropy method and cluster analysis method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on the machine learning methods of entropy method and cluster analysis method, we conduct data mining on the data of China’s higher continuing education. On the basis of relevant research on higher continuing education, we construct an index system for the high-quality development of higher continuing education. Based on the relevant data, we make a comprehensive evaluation of the high-quality development status of higher continuing education in 28 regions and gives a cluster analysis. Finally puts forward policy suggestions for the transformation and development of higher continuing education in China. The conclusion can provide some reference value for the development of higher continuing education.

articleTitle: The Research on High Sensitivity Large-Range Strain Sensor Based on Composite Material Substrate Fiber Bragg Grating
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the complex and demanding flight environment, critical sections of aircraft wings with composite structures can experience significant strains, reaching up to $10000 \mu \varepsilon$. Existing fiber optic grating sensors for large strain measurements often have lower sensitivity. To enhance the sensitivity of the fiber optic grating sensor for large strain measurements, a multi-layered, sensitivity-adjustable encapsulation structure is proposed. Through an analysis of strain transfer mechanisms among the sensor structures, coupled with finite element simulations, the impact of key sensor parameters on sensitivity is assessed. Response surface optimization is employed to optimize the sensor design. A highly sensitive fiber optic grating sensor for large strain measurements is fabricated based on simulation results and subjected to calibration testing. The results indicate that the sensor exhibits a range of up to $10000 \mu \varepsilon$ with a linearity of 0.9996, an average sensitivity of $0.317 \mathrm{pm} / \mu \varepsilon$, and demonstrates good repeatability. This composite-based fiber optic grating sensor effectively addresses the challenges in monitoring large strains in aircraft composite structures.

articleTitle: Design of remote monitoring system for Smart home
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of China’s economy, more and more technology companies have begun to study smart home. These smart home products have a wide range of types and brands, with uneven functions, high costs of procurement and maintenance, and complex operation. Aiming at the above problems, a new smart home remote monitoring system is designed. In terms of hardware design, the system uses STM32F103VET6 as the control core, which is composed of temperature sensor module, humidity sensor module, smoke sensor module, liquid crystal display module, fingerprint identification module, relay module and door lock module. In the aspect of software design, the main program software flow chart, the screen display software flow chart, the fingerprint identification software flow chart, the fingerprint input software flow chart and the wireless communication software flow chart are designed and the Ali cloud platform is built. Realize the temperature, humidity, gas detection, fingerprint identification, liquid crystal display, data wireless communication and other functions. Finally, through the joint adjustment of software and hardware, the results show that the smart home remote monitoring system can meet the actual needs of the average family, and realize the purpose of low price and convenient operation.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Topology Analysis and Parameter Calculation Method Based on Pseudo Measurement Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Parameter estimation and topology identification of distribution networks are the foundation of distribution network planning, operation analysis, and safety control. Traditional linear regression methods have high requirements for measurement data errors or noise data. Only in the absence of noise can the estimation be accurate. However, both the actual input measurement values (such as voltage amplitude and phase angle) and the output measurement values (such as active and reactive power) contain noise data. For topology estimation, even if the measurement error is small, regression methods cannot obtain accurate topology. In response to the above issues, the impact of measurement errors on line parameter estimation and topology recognition was quantitatively analyzed, and the pseudo measurement data was cleaned and preprocessed; On this basis, a basic model for estimating distribution network parameters was constructed, and a line parameter estimation model considering bilateral measurement errors was established. In response to the difficulty in solving the problem caused by its non-convexity, an improved immune clone cuckoo algorithm is used to solve the equivalent transformation and obtain a multi parameter mathematical model that is easy to solve. Finally, based on the IEEE 33 node system, simulation analysis was conducted and compared with traditional linear regression and least squares methods to demonstrate that the proposed method still has good estimation accuracy even when the measurement error reaches 10%.

articleTitle: Prediction Method for Flexible Adjustment Capacity of Microgrid Groups Based on Improved LSTM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The flexible regulation ability of microgrid clusters is related to the operational stability of microgrid clusters and even the overall power grid. we introduce an advanced prediction method for the flexible adjustment capacity of microgrid groups utilizing an Improved Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) algorithm. Recognizing the complexity and dynamic nature of microgrid operations, the study aims to overcome the limitations of traditional forecasting models by enhancing the predictive accuracy and computational efficiency of LSTM networks. The proposed method integrates an optimization technique, the artificial fish swarm algorithm (AFSA), to fine-tune the LSTM parameters, leveraging the collective behavior of fish to navigate towards optimal solutions. The research systematically evaluates the improved LSTM model against standard forecasting methods across various performance metrics, demonstrating a significant increase in both accuracy and efficiency. Experimental results indicate the superior capability of the improved LSTM algorithm

articleTitle: Review of Calculation Methods of Power Cables Temperature based on Thermal Circuit Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The temperature of cable conductor is the main factor limiting cable ampacity, and determining the life of cable insulation. The accurate calculation of the conductor temperature is of great significance to the safe operation of cable lines. Based on the theory of heat transfer, this paper analyzes the heat source of power cable that causes temperature rise, and the heat transfer (heat dissipation) mode of the cable under different laying methods. Based on the analysis of cable heat transfer problem, main researches on steady state model and transient model of power cable temperature rise is summarized and prospected.

articleTitle: Leveraging Multi-Actions to Improve Bayesian Personalized Ranking for Heterogeneous Implicit Feedback
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Implicit feedback (e.g., purchases, views, clicks, follows, listens, likes) have been receiving more attention due to their close relationship with real applications. In some recent works, pairwise ranking algorithms have been shown to leverage multiple types of auxiliary implicit feedback for solving the recommendation problem of heterogeneous implicit feedback (HIF). In this paper, we develop a novel preference learning algorithm to learn a confidence over multiple users’ actions, which is called Multi-actions Auxiliary Feedback Confidence Learned Bayesian Personalized Ranking (MAC-BPR). MAC-BPR has the merits of generating effective data from multiple auxiliary feedback and accommodating it for accurate pairwise preference learning. Experimental results on the real-world dataset demonstrate that MAC-BPR achieves better recommendations than several state-of-the-art methods over various evaluation metric.

articleTitle: Research on adaptive control of temperature field in double heat source brazing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In view of the current situation of low radiation heat transfer efficiency, slow heating process and long brazing cycle of titanium alloy plate-fin heat exchanger. The method of rapid heat generation of resistance pole is used to assist radiation heating to realize efficient heating and accurate temperature control of welded parts. Develop the infrared/thermocouple dual continuous temperature monitoring technology, establish the adaptive temperature control algorithm and model based on the measured temperature as feedforward control.

articleTitle: A satellite selection method based on maturity factor mapping in multi-GNSS positioning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the process of selecting satellites, the geometric dilution of precision (GDOP) is commonly utilized to identify a group of satellites that can provide high solution accuracy. However, traditional satellite selection method usually relies on traversal, which often leads to large amounts of computation when there are many visible satellites. Conventional genetic algorithms usually fix the crossover and mutation probabilities, resulting in unnecessary time consumption. To address these problems, this paper proposes a dual-system satellite selection genetic algorithm based on maturity factor mapping to quickly find an acceptable solution. Compared with other existing genetic algorithms for satellite selection, this paper proposes maturity factor to reflect the monotonicity of the current population gene pool. Adjusting the crossover and mutation probabilities by the maturity factor not only mitigates the risk of falling into local optimality in the long term but also reduces computation time.

articleTitle: A Design Method for Intelligent Commander in Military Simulation Engine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the design of military simulation engine, computer-generated forces, especially intelligent commander, is important and difficult issues that need to be studied. The article adopts various intelligent technologies to enhance the intelligence level of virtual commanders. Firstly, the technical architecture of the simulation engine was elaborated, and the intelligent commander association model was sorted out. The physical model, auxiliary decision-making, situational awareness, autonomous decision-making, and action models were designed for the entire life cycle of the intelligent commander, and specific applications were carried out on the basis of the simulation engine. The design method in this article provides application reference for the implementation of military simulation engines.

articleTitle: Research on Electricity Energy Market Trading Mechanism Based on Electricity-Carbon Linkage
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Currently, the environmental constraints faced by China’s power industry are changing from the control of conventional pollutants such as soot and sulfur dioxide to carbon emission control, and it is the future trend to promote the construction of low-carbon power market and the transformation of clean energy. Promoting the direct or indirect coupling of power market and carbon market is an important way to reduce carbon emissions in the power industry and promote clean substitution of electric energy. This paper firstly analyzes how the power market and carbon market affect each other, and designs a trading mechanism for the power-carbon linkage market by combining the typical scenarios of power-carbon linkage, and finally verifies that the proposed trading mechanism has a certain effect on improving the level of renewable energy consumption and reducing the cost of power purchasing by the users through the arithmetic examples.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Antenna Tower Tooling with High Stiffness for Complex Vibration Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: An antenna mount must be able to function properly in a complex vibration environment characterized by strong vibration, high frequency, large swing, and small cycle. Therefore, it is necessary to conduct a vibration test on the antenna mount, and the tooling used for the antenna mount must possess high strength and rigidity while being adaptable. This paper presents the design of a multi-bar, sinking tower type tooling based on the structural characteristics of the antenna mount. Finite element analysis is performed on the tooling, and the results of modal analysis indicate that the first-order frequency of the tower tooling is 221.3Hz, surpassing the upper limit of the 200Hz vibration spectrum. Additionally, the results of sinusoidal vibration analysis reveal that the maximum stress value is 11Map, which is significantly lower than the permissible stress value of the tooling material. The tower structure proposed in this paper can serve as a valuable reference for the design of similar antenna holder tooling.

articleTitle: Research on Short-term Load Forecasting Model Based on iForest-GA-BPNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The stable operation of the power system plays a vital role in the safety of electricity consumption and the production of electricity. In order to ensure the stability of electricity and adjust the power arrangement in time, it is very important to forecast the electricity load in the short time in the future. Without solving the problem of short term load forecasting, a short term power load forecasting model based on iForest-GA-BPNN is proposed in this paper. The model first uses the isolated forest algorithm to screen the collected power load data and supplement the data vacancy value. Then, based on the filtered data, the BP algorithm with improved weight and threshold value by genetic algorithm is used as the prediction model to forecast the short-term power load. Then, the performance of the proposed prediction model is verified by an example. The numerical results show that the proposed iForest-GA-BP algorithm has good prediction performance. It can be applied to the load forecasting of the power system, which can effectively improve the accuracy of the load forecasting, so as to provide theoretical support for the power consumption planning and power production of the power grid department, and improve the overall power consumption efficiency of the country.

articleTitle: Industrial Image Anomaly Localization Method based on Reverse Knowledge Distillation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Anomaly localization holds significant importance in the intricate production processes within smart manufacturing systems. Given that acquiring normal data is com paratively straightforward while abnormal data tends to be scarce, this study emphasizes unsupervised anomaly detection techniques centered on reconstruction. It introduces a novel framework that leverages image segmentation and reverse knowledge distillation for the detection and localization of a nomalies in moving objects. This framework is structured in to two distinct phases: component identification and anomaly diagnosis. The component identification phase, utilizing in stance segmentation methods, concentrates on key areas for inspection, ensuring the visual integrity of the components under scrutiny. In the anomaly diagnosis phase, the method of component anomaly diagnosis through reverse knowledge distillation facilitates the unsupervised reconstruction of tem plate images for anomaly diagnosis. This approach adeptly addresses the diversity of component types and their anomalies. An evaluation conducted on a dataset comprising images of scraper transmission chains demonstrates the framework’ s robustness in complex settings and its efficacy in detecting anomalies in transmission components.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Adjustment Mechanism for Communication System of Spacecraft
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Most existed intelligent adjustment mechanism methods for communication system of spacecraft are limited to physical layer design at present, making it difficult to adapt to special conditions. The intelligent adjustment mechanism method of Communication system for most spacecraft is limited to the physical layer design at present, making it difficult to adapt to special conditions. for Communication system, a layered intelligent adjustment mechanism method is proposed, which is designed by the physical layer, data The physical layer is designed separately from watchdog and read back reconfiguration, and the data link layer has completed the independent detection design based on the data link layer. The physical layer is designed separately from watchdog and read back reconfiguration, and the data link layer has completed the independent detection design based on the RF link. The application layer has completed the design of automatic power control strategies for transmitters. The verification is carried out in ground experiment as well as in-orbit flight, and the result shows that the mechanism proposed is suitable for long-term flight.

articleTitle: State-independent Linearization Based Load Flow Analysis for Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Mesh distribution networks not only improve the reliability of the power supply, but also increase the use of distributed renewable energy. In order to efficiently deal with the power flow (PF) analysis problems of mesh distribution networks, this paper constructs a state-independent linearization PF model. The proposed model treats the PF equation as a smooth nonlinear manifold, after which it is locally linearized using a tangent plane. The initial linearization point is chosen as a flat starting point, then the linearization point is iteratively updated while the approximate solution gradually converges to the true value, so that the proposed linear model is not affected by the initial state. Finally, through simulation of the modified 34-bus system, it is confirmed that the proposed model can converge quickly and achieve a high approximation accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Access Scheme for Distributed Photovoltaic Cluster Based on Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: China is comprehensively launching the planning and construction of large-scale photovoltaic (PV) bases, accelerating the integration of power generation, grid, and energy storage, as well as the integration of wind and solar power for hydrogen production. However, as the installed capacity continues to increase, higher demands are placed on the construction and operation maintenance of PV power plants. The communication network of PV power plants serves as the nerve center of the entire system, responsible for transmitting measurement and control information and providing feedback on fault status. It also supports various power-related operations. In this context, designing an optimal communication scheme for PV power plants not only ensures accurate real-time monitoring of the plant’s status but also guarantees its safe and reliable operation. Furthermore, it provides a scientific basis for decision-making regarding power generation efficiency, fault prediction, and risk control. This paper investigates the networking scheme of wireless transmission technology in the context of PV scenarios. We presents the design of micro-gateways and the secure access scheme for the network.

articleTitle: Multi region wind power prediction method based on improved transfer learning algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Wind power, as one of the renewable energy sources, plays an increasingly important role in today’s society where energy structure transformation and climate change issues are becoming increasingly prominent. However, the power fluctuations and instability of wind farms pose challenges to the operation of the power system, making accurate prediction of wind power particularly important. This article proposes a wind power prediction method based on improved deep transfer learning to address the problems in wind power prediction. This article first studies the correlation between the output power of multi region wind power and environmental factors, and provides the basic principle of wind power prediction. A single region wind power prediction model was established using long short-term memory algorithm; Subsequently, the deep reinforcement transfer learning algorithm was used to extend the wind power single region model to the multi region model. Finally, establish a simulation model to validate the proposed method.

articleTitle: Improved Droop Control Strategy Based on the Parallel Operation of a Single-Phase Inverter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In view of the problem that reactive power cannot be evenly divided when multiple inverters operate in parallel in low-voltage microgrid, this paper proposes an improved droop control strategy based on virtual impedance. By analyzing the working principle of droop control and the equal distribution condition of reactive power, this strategy adds virtual impedance link based on the traditional droop control to reduce the impedance difference of the line, and change the resistance ratio of the circuit to improve the inductance component, and make it more in line with the requirements of droop control, so as to improve the equal distribution of reactive power. To verify the effectiveness of this strategy, the simulation model is verified with MATLAB/Simlink. The results show that the improved control strategy can effectively improve the average separation accuracy of reactive power, which verifies the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection of Server Data Based on Depthwise Separable Convolution and Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Server data is an important indicator of the server status, and its anomaly detection is greatly valuable for the normal operation of applications. However, server data is difficult to be processed effectively due to its diversity and complexity. In addition, current algorithms are difficult to find the anomalies accurately. To address this problem, we propose an anomaly detection model based on Depthwise Separable Convolution(DSC) and Transformer in this paper. The model uses sliding window partition to reorganize the data, and uses DSC and Transformer structure to learn local and global context information respectively. We reconstruct the original server data based on the learned patterns and use the reconstruction error as the final anomaly score for anomaly determination. Experiments show that our model has an F1 index of 0.92 on the public dataset SMD, proving its abilities to accurately detect the anomalies of the server data.

articleTitle: Fixed-time Disturbance Observer-based Boundary Control of a Flexible Satellite
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper studies the attitude and vibration control of flexible satellites under external disturbance based on the PDEODE model. The vibration of the appendage is described by a partial differential equation, which is not discretized and truncated in this work. A fixed-time disturbance observer is designed to exactly estimate the disturbance in the first. Then, to avoid the spillover effects, a boundary controller is proposed to control the attitude of the satellites and suppress the vibration of the appendage. Without considering the viscous damping, the closed-looped system is proved to be exponentially stable. The procedure for determining the control coefficients is also provided. Finally, simulations are carried out to evaluate the performance of the proposed controller under external disturbance.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Radar Emitter Identification System based on K-Nearest Neighbor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: When detecting radar targets, we need to infer the specific type of radar the target is by obtaining the feature data, such as a certain type of aircraft loaded radar. In the past, this work was usually recognized manually, depending on the staff’s familiarity with the feature data of radar targets. Moreover, the values of the feature data for different types of targets are sometimes very similar. All these circumstances described above have resulted in the low accuracy and efficiency of recognition. Therefore, this paper develops a radar emitter identification system, which uses one of the most well-known and widely being used machine learning algorithm K-nearest neighbor (KNN) to assist the staff to recognize the target. According to the feedback of users, the system has achieved excellent results.

articleTitle: Research on Fabric Defect Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of sluggish defect detection, suboptimal accuracy, and susceptibility to adverse environmental conditions in the textile production process. Extensive research on textile defect points led to the development of an innovative defect detection algorithm based on an improved YOLOv5 architecture. The approach involves data augmentation techniques, including noise injection and brightness reduction, to enhance the algorithm’s robustness under complex detection scenarios. Additionally, the introduction of the ShuffleNetV2 lightweight network, featuring depth-wise separable convolutions and other lightweight techniques, optimizes its operability on resource-constrained devices. Furthermore, the incorporation of the SimAM attention mechanism empowers the model to extract crucial image information without introducing extra parameters or computational complexity. Experimental results validate the model’s efficacy, achieving a detection accuracy of 93.9% on a textile defect dataset, surpassing the original YOLOv5 model by 1.5%.

articleTitle: Research on apple surface defect detection based on improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the continuous development of artificial intelligence technology, deep learning methods have been widely used in smart agriculture. With the continuous progress of object detection algorithms, it is a future trend to introduce computer vision methods into smart agriculture. This paper proposes an improved YOLOv8 network model for detecting whether apple is still in a healthy state in smart agriculture systems. By introducing a better backbone network EfficientNet, features can be extracted from the data efficiently. In addition, by introducing a novel WIOU calculation function, the rectangular box can be computed better. In this experiment, the average accuracy of the improved YOLOv8-Enet is mAP0.5 and mAP 0.5:0.95, which are 7.1% and 6.5% higher than that of YOLOv8-base, respectively. The proposed YOLOv8-Enet model can effectively detect apple surface defect and provide theoretical and technical support for future research on vision of smart agriculture

articleTitle: Design and Verification of Autonomous Task Management for Remote Sensing Satellites
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The remote sensing SAR satellites have built two rate level distributed information networks for the control, information transmission, and operational management of the entire satellite system. The article introduces the satellite’s requirements for ease of use and ease of use. It adopts layered and distributed autonomous task management architecture, providing users with advanced task interfaces and shielding the internal design status of the satellite, greatly simplifying satellite control. To meet the requirements of stable operation of satellites in orbit, task management measures such as autonomous task conflict and merging have been adopted. Finally, the testing verification and in orbit application of remote sensing SAR satellites in the development process of autonomous mission management system were introduced.

articleTitle: An Improved Method of Measurement and Launch Control Software based on Long-distance and Autonomous Launch
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To adapt to the new changes of the unattended control computer, as well as the requirements for remote monitoring, this article proposes improvements of the ground measurement and control software based on the automatic operation of the test process and the application of device for remote control. First of all, the human-computer interaction mode in the traditional testing process is improved to realize the automatic operation; Secondly, the remote control device is applied to realize remote measurement and control purposes, while an interactive mode featuring dual redundant communication instructions is designed to differentiate between independent consistency and related consistency of redundant instructions. This enhancement improves system reliability and lays a technical foundation for engineering development of automaticity and maneuverability in the filed of the launch vehicle.

Author Keywords: remote control monitoring: measurement and control software

articleTitle: Anomaly Data Detection Method Based on Neural Network for Dual-link Aggregated Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Power grid communication is critical within the power system, directly impacting its stability and operation. To enhance anomaly detection accuracy in power grid communication networks, this paper introduces a dual-mode neural network anomaly detection algorithm. It involves real-time data collection through a dual-mode communication system, preprocessing via wavelet transformation, training and prediction using two deep convolutional neural network sub-models, and combining results via a soft voting method. Comparative experiments across seven datasets demonstrate the method’s superiority in accuracy, false positives, and missed detections over traditional approaches, making it more suitable for real-world anomaly detection scenarios.

articleTitle: The Optimization of Land Resource Data Management Model In Big Data Era
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Land resource data management in big data era involves data collection, storage and use. At present, there are many problems in land resource data management, such as management mechanism, platform construction and data use. Based on the realization of big data analysis, this paper analyzes the structure and model of land resource data management. Faced with problems of imperfect management mechanism, increased management difficulty and deficiencies of existing models in big data era, this paper puts forward optimization schemes from the aspects of perfecting land resource data management mechanism, building an efficient data platform and optimizing data use structure.

articleTitle: A High-Linearity 19 GHz LC-Based VCO for PVT Compensation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A high-linearity 19 GHz LC-based VCO circuit with PVT compensation was designed, which can achieve a low-jitter high-quality clock signal. Cross-coupled PMOS-NMOS structure with two additional adjustable voltages was used to compensate for the effect of process, voltage and temperature (PVT) on the operating frequency and improve the linearity of voltage-controlled characteristic. Simulation results show that the proposed VCO can achieve the wider frequency of 18.7-19.5 GHz and exhibit the phase noise of -109.458 dBc/Hz at the frequency offset of 1MHz. And when the output frequency is 19GHz, it takes 0.4us to generate the stable clock signal, whose jitter is less than 0.22 UI.

articleTitle: Facial expression recognition method based on dual-branch fusion network with noisy labels
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As an important problem in the field of computer vision, facial expression recognition has been widely used in many fields such as human-computer interaction and emotion recognition. This paper proposes a dual-branch parallel facial expression recognition network that integrates Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Transformer. By consolidating local and global information obtained from the dual branches, the network effectively combines subtle local variations and overall contextual features of facial expressions. The fused feature representation demonstrates enhanced representativeness and discriminative power, leading to a notable improvement in facial expression recognition accuracy.
