In addressing the challenges posed by inter-class similarity and annotation ambiguity, the Erasing Attention Consistency (EAC) mechanism is employed. This mechanism effectively prevents the model from memorizing noisy samples, thereby enhancing robustness against noisy labels. Additionally, the focal loss function is utilized to rectify imbalances within data samples. Experiments conducted on RAF-DB datasets with labels containing noise reveal that the proposed methodology achieves accuracies of 87.65% and 86.05% at 10% and 20% noise rate, respectively. This substantiates the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis System Based on Asymptotic Affiliation of Multidirectional Correlation Indicators for Power Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The main characteristics of the power communication network is multi-level, multi-indicator, this paper multi-directional analysis of the reliability of the power communication network, the first analysis of the reliability of the power communication network reliability indicators for hierarchical combing, the formation of multi-directional correlation index evaluation system, the use of the distance between the proposed value to calculate the corresponding decision-making weight, the use of the improved fuzzy integrated evaluation method through the fuzzy mathematics according to the principle of the maximum degree of subordination will be the object of the study of qualitative evaluation Using the improved fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, the qualitative evaluation of the research object is converted into quantitative evaluation through the principle of maximum affiliation degree in fuzzy mathematics, and on this basis, the weights of the first-level indexes based on the variance are calculated and fused to obtain the reliability affiliation degree. The analyses show that this method can effectively evaluate the reliability of electric power communication network.

articleTitle: QCGFNet: A Lightweight Color Image Denoising Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Most current denoising methods rely on large-scale models, such as transformers and diffusion models. However, these methods suffer from drawbacks such as excessive network layers and parameters, prolonged training time, and slow denoising processes, which can result in significant costs when applied to real-world scenarios. This work proposes a lightweight color image denoising network, called the quaternion convolution guided filter denoising network (QCGFNet). First, guided filtering is used to separate the base and detail layers of the original image. Then, two quaternion convolutional subnetworks are separately trained for the base and detail layers. Finally, their results are combined to produce the final denoised image. The quaternion convolution module can better fuse information between channels, and the four channels are processed in parallel. Using the detail layer for training simplifies image information and accelerates network learning and convergence. Compared with other excellent methods discussed in this paper, our method reduces the parameters by up to 145 times and speeds up inference time by up to 212 times. It achieves excellent performance on several datasets, especially the Kodak-24 dataset, improving average PSNR by 1.4% to 13.4% and average SSIM by 0.7% to 22.4%. It can be said that QCGFNet achieves outstanding performance at a very low cost.

articleTitle: A W-Band Power Amplifier With 19.6% PAE in 45-nm SOI CMOS
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents a two-way power-combing W-band power amplifier (PA) in 45nm SOI CMOS process. To alleviate the parasitism in large-sized transistors, the customized power cell with an optimized layout is adopted. The drain-gate neutralized common-source (CS) stages are employed in the two amplification stages of the PA to enhance power gain and guarantee stability. Two types of transform-based power combining are analyzed and compared. Parallel combining is considered more suitable in this design for a lower transformation ratio and higher power-combining efficiency. The PA is designed and achieves 11.7-dBm output 1-dB compression point (P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1dB</inf>), 15.2-dBm saturated output power (P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sat</inf>), and 19.6% power added efficiency (PAE) at 94GHz. The 3-dB bandwidth of the PA is from 85-105GHz.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Decision Model Construction Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In real-world combat scenarios, decisionmaking serves as the central dynamic between conflicting parties. The introduction of innovative technical means of decision support in combat situations is therefore of the utmost importance. Reinforcement learning algorithms offer the capability to optimize strategies through ongoing interaction with the environment, ultimately deriving the most effective action plan. This optimised strategy aims to improve command effectiveness by providing better support for commanders in making combat decisions. Our study focuses on historical war incidents in the Russian-Ukrainian conflict. We develop an intelligent decision-making system using the classical Q-learning algorithm in reinforcement learning. Taking into account the battlefield environment, the system uses input data to assess the basic condition of the troops of both factions. By evaluating the Q-values of each action in the resulting Q-table, the system provides training and decision-making suggestions. Ultimately, the goal is to provide valuable support to leaders to help them make informed combat decisions.

articleTitle: Aerospace Launch Contingency Planning Simulation based on HTCPN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Space launch failure is an uncommon but extremely important real-world problem. This paper proposes a Hierarchical Timed Colored Petri nets (HTCPN) simulation and validation method for the emergency response plan in response to the fact that the emergency response process of space launch failure is difficult to be fully practiced in real launch scenarios. Firstly, HTCPN is introduced as a kind of advanced petri net which is convenient in modeling and analyzing the actual complex system. Then the HTCPN model is constructed for the key process links of space emergency launch, and finally the model is dynamically operated and its performance is evaluated. After analysis, it can be seen that the use of HTCPN to model the space launch emergency response plan can summarize the disposal process comprehensively, describe it clearly, and analyze the results with credibility.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Image Object Detection Method with Feature Denoising Fusion Module
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Remote sensing object detection is an important research area in computer vision, widely applied in both military and civilian domains. However, challenges in remote sensing image object detection such as large image sizes, complex backgrounds, and significant variations in target scales are prevalent. To address these issues, this paper proposes a new Feature Denoising and Fusion Module (FDFM) aimed at enhancing the accuracy and robustness of object detection. This module comprises a Multi-Scale Denoising Submodule(MDS) and an Attention Optimization Submodule(AOS). The Multi-Scale Denoising Module aims to suppress lower-level texture noise by utilizing higher-level semantic features before the fusion process, reducing the impact of lower-level noise on subsequent multi-scale feature fusion. Meanwhile, the Attention Optimization Module seeks to enhance the precision of self-attention computations within the Multi-Scale Denoising Module without increasing the parameter count. The efficacy of this method was evaluated on public datasets DOTA, VisDrone, VOC and COCO, showing improvements in comparison to baseline models.

articleTitle: Action Association Learning Network for Weakly-supervised Temporal Action Localization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Weakly-supervised Temporal action localization (WTAL) is a tough task in computer vision that aims to identify the temporal boundaries of actions in videos, whereas only video-level labels available. However, most existing approaches give scant consideration to the action association information in videos. In this paper, we investigate the impact of action associations and propose a new framework: Action Association Learning Network (AAL-Net) for temporal localization. Firstly, we introduce attention modules to exploit association information in snippet features. The class-aware and class-agnostic action associations are fused into the features respectively. Additionally, a hybrid Class Activation Sequence (CAS) strategy based on adaptive thresholds is proposed to increase the proposal pool and adjust temporal attention weights. Thirdly, during action proposal generation, we propose a method to adjust initial proposals using the learned action association weights. Finally, we conduct extensive comparative experiments on two datasets to evaluate the effectiveness of our proposed temporal action localization model. The model leverages action association information to enhance the accuracy of action localization, and achieves state-of-the-art results on both datasets. Ablation studies are also performed to further demonstrate the efficacy of our methods.

articleTitle: Research on Design Method of Subject of Equipment Operational Test
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of design method of equipment operational test subject, The paper brought forward the multi mapping-based design method of equipment operational test subject, brought forward the optimization principle and method of operational test subject. Finally, it gave an example to show that the method’s scientificity and operability.

articleTitle: Research on a Time Plane Based Algorithm for Identification of Distribution Network Line Parameters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Accurate line parameters are an important foundation for refined regulation and protection setting of distribution networks. In recent years, the topology of the circular distribution network, which has gained practical promotion, is complex and the direction of power flow is variable, making it difficult to apply the traditional radial network method for identifying line parameters. In this paper, a "time plane" based algorithm for identifying distribution network line parameters is proposed. In response to the situation where some distribution networks cannot collect voltage phase angle information from all nodes, it is proposed to analyze the power and voltage data that can be obtained by existing measurement equipment in the distribution network, and use a digital way to reflect the physical system to achieve visualization of the distribution network topology structure and line parameters. To achieve this goal, firstly, based on multiple sets of measurement data under time cross-sections, a linear regression topology and line parameter identification model is established according to the power flow equation, and preliminary calculations are made; Secondly, based on the concept of "electricity consumption", the line loss is used to infer the line parameters for each segment; Finally, the Adaboost algorithm was used to fuse the parameter identification results of the "time plane" and obtain the final distribution network parameter identification results. The feasibility of this method was verified using an IEEE 33 node example.

articleTitle: Study on the Shielding Performance of the Counterpoise for DVOR and DME Antenna Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: At present, all internationally recognized professional simulation software for civil aviation are unable to simulate the impact of the counterpoise on the shielding performance of DVOR (Doppler VHF Omni-Range) and DME (Distance Measuring Equipment) signals. Research in this specialized domain has only advanced to the theoretical stage, leaving no intuitive reference value for relevant technical personnel. This article studies the reflection characteristics of the grid size and thickness of the counterpoise in the frequency band of DVOR and DME devices. By establishing a steel mesh model of the reflection network, setting corresponding boundary conditions and excitation modes, this study analyzes the variations in S11 (reflection) and S21 (transmission) parameters in response to changes in the mesh size and thickness parameters of the counterpoise. This paper presents reflection and transmission values across various frequencies, sizes, and steel mesh diameters. A definitive conclusion is drawn based on the analysis, providing valuable insight and serves as a reference for the future installation and application of civil aviation DVOR and DME equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Service Quality Evaluation of Rural E-commerce Logistics Based on SPSS
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Taking rural e-commerce consumers as the center and combining the actual situation of rural ecommerce logistics, the questionnaire survey method is adopted to collect the evaluation data of rural residents on the logistics services of e-commerce enterprises in rural areas, and the initial evaluation index system of rural ecommerce logistics service quality is established. Then SPSS is used to analyze the questionnaire data and verify the reliability and effectiveness of the indicators. Therefore, an index system of five dimensions and 15 indicators is established, which provides certain reference value for other e-commerce logistics service quality evaluation.

articleTitle: Anti-jamming Trajectory Design Method of UAV Based on Intelligent Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposed an intelligent optimization algorithm to design the anti-jamming trajectory of the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) aided in wireless sensor networks (WSNs). In practical terms, a UAV is used to collect data from a plenty of ground sensor (GSs) while existing multiple of ground jammers (GJs) under line-of-sight (LoS) channel model. We aim to maximum the data collection average rate by optimizing the horizontal trajectory. We provide two different intelligent optimization algorithms to design trajectory of the UAV, Random Iterative Algorithm and Tree seed Optimizer Algorithm (TSA). Simulation result shows that the latter one is better in improving the data collection rate and enhance the security of the network with multiple jammers.

articleTitle: CO2 Concentration Measurement with Enhanced Sensitivity Adopting Vernier Effect
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: We demonstrate a highly sensitive fiber gas sensor with Vernier effect utilizing a reference Sagnac interferometer (R-SI) in series with a sensing Fabry-Perot interferometer (S-FPI) for CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> concentration measurement. The S-FPI is prepared through two butt ceramic cores with ~161 μm air gap, being easy for CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> gas to flow into the open cavity. It reveals the CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> concentration measurement sensitivity of -1.11 pm/ppm in the concentration range of 100-900 ppm. In order to improve the measurement sensitivity further, the modulation of the gas concentration on the envelope is used to enhance the measurement sensitivity with a certain magnification. For the sake of producing obvious envelope and high magnification, the RSI is introduced to match the S-FPI due to the flexible tunability of free spectral range (FSR) by adjusting the polarization maintaining fiber (PMF) length. The experimental results show that the cascaded fiber gas sensor achieves the CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> concentration sensitivity of 8.506 pm/ppm, being ~7.66 times higher than that of the S-FPI. The designed gas sensor has broad prospects in weak gas concentration measurement because of high sensitivity, simple preparation and low cost.

articleTitle: Energy Minimization for Data Collection in UAV-Assisted WSNs with All-User Uplink Single-Carrier NOMA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, we study the optimization of energy consumption for data collection in UAV-assisted wireless sensor networks (WSNs) under the uplink single-carrier non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) approach. The total energy consumption of ground users is minimized by jointly optimizing the single UAV trajectory, sensor power allocation and updating access order while ensuring the completion of the data transmission task. This is a mixed integer nonlinear programming problem (MINLP) that is difficult to solve, for this reason we propose an iterative algorithm to solve the resulting optimization problem by using the block coordinate descent (BCD) method. First, for a given UAV trajectory, the sensor access order is determined according to the channel quality; second, we use the successive convex approximation (SCA) method to optimize the two subproblems of sensor transmit power and UAV trajectory, respectively; then the access order is updated according to the optimized UAV trajectory and the energy consumption minimum is obtained by iterative optimization. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: U-CCNet: Brain Tumor MRI Image Segmentation Model with Broader Global Context Semantic Information Abstraction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Since brain tumor detection can help in the diagnosis of diseases such as Alzheimer’s disease, segmentation and classification of brain tumors are crucial for diagnosis and treatment. Although radiologists can find the tumor area using magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), it is more time-consuming. The high-precision segmentation results provided by deep learning models can assist radiologists in better-identifying brain tumors. In this paper, we propose a U-Net-based approach to detect brain tumors in MRI. In this paper, the cross-attention mechanism is added to the U-Net benchmark architecture and trained and tested on the LGG Segmentation dataset (TCGA-LGG) dataset. The test results show that the proposed model performs well in brain tumor MRI segmentation tasks. Finally, the proposed U-CCNet model is compared with other studies. Experimental results show that this study is superior to other models in the Dice similarity coefficient and IoU index. The proposed method is tested on the LGG brain MRI segmentation dataset. There is a significant improvement in segmentation accuracy in terms of dice score and mIoU, reducing the use of computationally expensive 3D networks.

articleTitle: Measurement System Design of Pantograph Slider Wear Using Binocular Structured Light
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In response to the increasing automation requirements for measuring the wear of pantograph slider in rail vehicles, this paper presents a pantograph slider wear measurement system based on binocular structured light. The system captures image data of pantograph slider from different perspectives using line-structured light and binocular cameras, utilizes structured light information for feature matching and calculates three-dimensional point cloud data based on binocular vision principles. The DBSCAN algorithm is used to denoise and segment the point cloud data, and then the Gaussian smoothing method is used to smooth the segmented point cloud data. The cross-sectional point cloud of the smoothed point cloud is intercepted along the direction of the train. Finally, the cross-sectional point cloud is registered with the unworn standard pantograph slider’s cross-sectional point cloud. The maximum distance between the point clouds in the slider region after registration represents the maximum wear value of the target pantograph slider. Experimental results demonstrates that the system exhibits high measurement accuracy and strong stability in repeated measurements, with a measurement error of less than 0.3 mm. It holds certain engineering application value.

articleTitle: Research on the Prediction of Sunspot Numbers based on Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Sunspots are strong magnetic fields on the sun, and the solar surface where sunspots appear is the active region of the sun. The number of sunspots reflects the strength of solar activity and is a key indicator of changes in solar activity. Predicting the number of sunspots is of great value for human space exploration and application activities. Meanwhile, the prediction of sunspot numbers has also played an important role in satellite navigation, communication and other fields. In the ionospheric IRI model, the number of sunspots is one of the input parameters. Therefore, studying the prediction methods of sunspot numbers, improving the accuracy and precision of predictions, is of great significance for ensuring the safety and normal operation of human activities. In this paper, a short-term prediction method for sunspot numbers based on neural networks is studied. Using historical observation data of sunspot numbers as training data, parameters are adjusted to obtain the optimal prediction network. The trained network is used to predict the number of sunspots in the next three days. Experimental results show that the method used in this paper can effectively predict the number of sunspots. When forecasting one day in advance, the mean absolute error of the predicted number of sunspots does not exceed 9, and when forecasting three days in advance, the mean absolute error does not exceed 16.

articleTitle: Development of Ultrasonic Measurement System for Underwater Mapping Unmanned Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper mainly designs an underwater ultrasonic measurement system based on unmanned ship, which is used in the research of underwater survey. Underwater exploration is widely used. In this paper, ultrasonic system is used to collect information, and a PTZ system is designed to ensure the stability of ultrasonic probe. Through the coordination of servo motor and steering gear, the stability of ultrasonic probe is well stabilized. Finally, the data collected by stm32 microcontroller is used to model and analyze the underwater terrain. The sending, receiving and processing methods of the data are explained in detail. Finally, the stability of the whole measurement system is verified by experiments, and the measurement task function can be completed in the underwater measurement experiment.

articleTitle: Improved Design and Analysis of Antenna’s Support under Complex Vibration and Shock Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The antenna’s support plays a crucial role in supporting the antenna. Its stiffness directly impacts the stability and pointing accuracy of the antenna, necessitating high stiffness and strength. However, the current antenna’s support has a low first-order frequency, which poses a risk of damage to the antenna in a strong vibration and impact environment. To address this issue, this paper proposes an improvement by widening the width of the three support arms and increasing the ribs inside them. Modal simulation analysis reveals that the first-order frequency of the antenna’s support increases by 38.8% from 148.9 Hz to 206.7 Hz. Moreover, vibration and impact simulation results demonstrate that the strength of the improved antenna’s support meets the design requirements. The structural form and improved design method presented in this paper can serve as a reference for optimizing similar antenna’s support structures.

articleTitle: A review of risk assessment of transmission lines under wildfire disaster
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In recent years, the frequent occurrence of wildfire disasters in China has seriously threatened the stable operation of transmission lines. This paper expounds the mechanism of transmission line fault caused by wildfire disaster, introduces a variety of wildfire monitoring and transmission line fault analysis methods, analyzes the technical principles, advantages and disadvantages of transmission line fire risk assessment methods based on BP neural network, naive Bayesian network and analytic hierarchy process, and summarizes and analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of three different assessment methods, so as to improve the risk assessment of transmission lines under wildfire disaster.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Intelligent Trace Monitoring Vehicle Using Image Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the existing track model car easy to lose the line, easy to go off the track out of the problem, this paper carries out the intelligent track monitoring car model of the software program part of the design as well as intelligent track monitoring car parts of the overall design debugging and analysis and other aspects of the research. The design adopts MK60 as the core microprocessor, uses CMOS image sensor OV7725 digital camera to collect road conditions, and processes the road surface information to get the road surface guidance information. Through the guidance information of the road surface to guide the stable driving of the tracking monitoring vehicle, the control system real-time closed-loop control of the corner and speed of the tracking monitoring vehicle, and based on the road surface information and the measured corner and speed information for PID control. The experiments show that the tracking vehicle can be driven stably under the given experimental route, and has better speed and control accuracy.

articleTitle: Cross-domain risk assessment of cyber power physical system based on network attack
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of cross-domain risk assessment in cyber power physical system, this paper proposes a cross-domain risk assessment method based on network attack. Firstly, the attacker resource constraint and system flow constraint are considered, and a FDI attack model aiming at minimizing attack cost is proposed. Then CVSS is used to evaluate the exploitability of vulnerabilities, and a Bayesian attack graph is established based on the distribution of vulnerabilities to calculate the prior probability of successful attacks. Then the probability of network attack combination is obtained from the minimum attack cost and prior probability. Secondly, the physical consequences of network attacks are calculated based on DC optimal power flow algorithm. Finally, the cross-domain risk of the system is evaluated by combining the probability of network attack combination and the physical consequences of network attack. Through simulation verification, the method in this paper effectively reduces the difficulty of cross-domain risk quantitative assessment in the cyber power physical system, deeply explores the vulnerable links of the system, and provides references for improving the reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Design of Tennis Picking Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A tennis picking robot that is implemented in this project with the aim of replacing manual ball picking, saving human resources, and improving ball picking efficiency. The system uses Raspberry Pi 4B as the upper computer, which has a central processing unit of 1.5GHz, a quad core BCM2711 and Cortex A-72 architecture, and uses Qt for image processing algorithms on the Linux system of the upper computer. At the same time, using ST’s STM32F103R series chip as the lower computer, the main developed functions include Bluetooth control of robot movement and grasping, obstacle avoidance function, and serial communication. The PC controls the upper computer through Wi-Fi, and the upper computer controls the lower computer through serial communication. The information obtained by the upper computer through image processing is sent to the lower computer, and the lower computer takes corresponding actions when it obtains the information. The upper computer uses vncviewer software to exchange files with the PC, FileZilla software for file transfer between the PC and the upper computer, and Qt5 software for graphic interface design and control of image processing algorithm writing.

articleTitle: Model Reference Adaptive Control and Neural Network-Based Concentration Control of CSTR
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The paper discusses the concentration control in Continuous Stirred Tank Reactors (CSTR) using another CSTR as a reference model. The PI controller regulates the reference model, which adjusts the model reference adaptive controller (MRAC). The neural controller is then tuned with the model identified from the second CSTR. The controllers’ performance is assessed through the utilization of MATLAB/SIMULINK aiming to illustrate and enhance the system’s concentration and stability. The simulation results are compared with the Model Reference Adaptive Controller MIT and Lyapunov rules.

articleTitle: Design Considerations and Scheme Research of Civil Aircraft Audio System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The airborne audio system is an important component of the avionics system, mainly used for voice communication between the aircraft and the ground, communication between flight crews, generation of alarm audio, and reception of navigation audio. It runs through every flight and every phase of the aircraft, and is an important guarantee system for safe flight of the aircraft. In traditional aircraft architecture design, the onboard audio system uses analog audio for transmission and processing, which easily introduces typical audio system problems such as noise and howling. These issues seriously affect the operating experience of pilots, and may even lead to pilots missing important control orders, leading to the occurrence of unsafe events. Therefore, in the design of audio systems, the design of details becomes particularly important. This article summarizes common problems in the use of audio systems and proposes relevant design considerations and solutions.

articleTitle: Modeling and risk assessment of cyber physical distribution system based on cyber attack
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the continuous development of information and communication technology and its wide application in distribution network, distribution network has evolved into an cyber physical distribution network system(CPDS). The interaction between cyber and physical system means that power system faces greater potential risks. However, existing risk assessment methods do not take into account the coupling relationship between system network topology and equipment, and most of them only focus on physical system risk assessment. Therefore, this paper proposes a CPDS risk assessment method based on network attack. A method for calculating the prior probability of information nodes based on cumulative density function, FAHP and TOPSIS is proposed. Secondly, a physical node posterior probability calculation method based on SIS infectious disease model is proposed. Then, the optimal AC power flow model is established in the active distribution network, and the minimum load loss value is calculated. Finally, the risk value of network attack is calculated by prior probability, posterior probability and minimum loss of load. Through the simulation experiment of the improved IEEE33 system, the results show that the proposed method accurately evaluates the risk of network attack in CPDS.

articleTitle: Design of a Host Monitoring Secondary Screen Display System Based on Embedded ARM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For real-time monitoring of hardware parameters during full screen processing tasks. This article designs a real-time image transmission system based on ARM, which can achieve the display of image information on the secondary screen of the host monitoring. By calling the open hardware monitor dynamic link library to obtain host hardware information, converting the information data into images, connecting the display screen through the UIBHID interface, using a custom TFT screen communication protocol, sending data to the secondary screen, and achieving listening to host hardware data without affecting the main screen task, and verifying it through experiments. The results show that this method can achieve real-time display of host hardware parameters on the secondary screen, and has the advantages of low power consumption and low cost.

articleTitle: Design of City Manhole Cover Monitoring System Based on NB-IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Manhole covers are prevalent in urban streets and alleys. necessitating the imperative attention to their daily maintenance and inspection. In order to meet the requirements of intelligent maintenance of manhole covers, this paper designs and implements an urban manhole cover monitoring system based on NB-IOT, which mainly uses single-chip microcomputer processing technology, sensor acquisition technology and wireless communication technology, and combines peripheral functional modules for design. The core control device of the system is STM32 single-chip microcomputer, which mainly collects water level height, combustible gas concentration and manhole cover pressure data in the well through the water level detection module, combustible gas concentration detection module and pressure detection module respectively, The GPS module collects the location data of the manhole cover, Additionally, location data of each manhole cover is collected by a GPS positioning module. The NB-IoT wireless communication module facilitates remote transmission of data while local data is periodically uploaded to the remote terminal, and the relevant data can be viewed on the mobile phone, which brings convenience to the manhole cover maintenance work and reduces the risk of accidents.

articleTitle: STMLN: Transformer-Based Multivariate Loop Recurrent Denoising Network for Sonar Image
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The impact of speckle noise on sonar image quality during the imaging process is particularly pronounced. To enhance the quality of sonar images, this paper explores a speckle noise reduction network for sonar images based on Transformer and multivariate loop operations, namely STMLN. This network architecture integrates the Transformer into the denoising network with the aim of extracting global features and combining them with convolutional operations for a more comprehensive understanding of sonar image characteristics. Unlike conventional models, STMLN decomposes model outputs into denoised images, signal-related noise, and signal-independent noise, refining the output through multivariate loop operations to enhance denoising accuracy. Furthermore, we designed a specific loss function addressing the correlation between sonar image content and multivariate loop operations to calibrate the model’s learning process, reducing information loss and enhancing output image quality. Experimental results on synthetic speckle noise datasets and real sonar image datasets demonstrate that compared to existing sonar image denoising methods, STMLN achieves outstanding denoising performance.

articleTitle: Improvement of Human Recognition Algorithm in Public Places Based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the field of human recognition in video surveillance, this paper proposes a higher detection accuracy object detection algorithm YOLO-GAM+to address issues such as dense object occlusion and low detection rate of small targets. By adding a layer of GAMAttention module to the Backbone of yolov5, and then adding a detection layer to the head, the detection accuracy of the model was effectively improved. Finally, by introducing soft nms, the detection accuracy of the model was further improved. The experiment showed that the mAP50 of YOLO-GAM+ reached 76.8%, which increased by 2.1 percentage points while the parameter quantity remained basically unchanged. Experimental results have shown that the improved algorithm proposed in this article is more suitable for the deployment of human recognition in video surveillance.

articleTitle: Research on Topology Identification Algorithm for Distribution Network with Distributed Photovoltaics Based on Deep Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The topology structure of the new power system with multiple distributed power sources in the distribution network has diversity and variability, which affects the real-time and accuracy of topology identification. To address this issue, a distribution network partition topology identification method based on an improved deep forest algorithm is proposed. Construct a distribution network topology identification framework that combines topology, using switch state matrices to describe the topology structure for physical identification and dimensionality reduction; Propose a feature selection and topology identification method based on an improved deep forest algorithm, which obtains region topology identification of historical and unknown topologies through parallel offline training in zones. The improved deep forest model obtains real-time region switch state matrix labels through online application, forming a distribution network switch state matrix to achieve system topology identification. The test results of the distribution network example system have verified the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Binomial Logistic Regression and CatBoost Model of Music on Empathy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: We conducted a comprehensive review of previous studies and observed a robust and widespread impact of music training on empathy. However, the majority of these studies primarily relied on qualitative approaches, with limited research incorporating covariates and a lack of studies comparing the magnitudes of these variables’ effects. To bridge this gap, we utilized an online questionnaire to gather pertinent data. The dependent variable in our study was the empathy ability of each participant, while the independent variables encompassed five dimensions of musical literacy, methods of acquiring musical literacy, personality traits, and demographic information. Utilizing Binomial Logistic Regression and CatBoost model, we quantitatively analyzed the factors influencing empathy. Across both modeling techniques, there was a consistent and significant influence on high empathy factors, primarily attributed to gratitude attitude, positive reciprocal motivation, ability to perception of music, ability to identify music emotions, collaborative experiences. In contrast, whether individuals had undergone long-term professional music training or the influence of personality traits on high empathy, it was found that this influence was minimal. Our findings contribute to a more nuanced understanding of the relationship between music training and empathy, emphasizing the importance of quantitative analysis in this domain.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Power Load Forecasting Algorithm based on Data Fusion Cluster Tree
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of new energy technology, photovoltaic load forecasting is one of the current research emphases and hot spots. Optical image processing is used to study the regional situation in photovoltaic load forecasting. The primary objective of point cloud alignment is to determine the optimal spatial correspondence among two or more point cloud datasets. Despite advancements in this research area, a persistent issue remains: the features extracted by point cloud alignment algorithms are often insufficiently rich, hindering accurate alignment. This study aims to effectively exploit information from different resolution levels in point cloud data, enhancing alignment accuracy. Thus, we propose a multi-scale feature fusion point cloud alignment algorithm (MSM, Multi Scale Matcher) that incorporates the cross-attention mechanism. Experiments conducted on the ModelNet40 dataset demonstrate that the proposed method significantly enhances the accuracy of load forecasting.

articleTitle: An ultra-short-term wind power prediction method based on CNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the precision of wind power prediction, a convolutional neural networks-long short-term memory combination method for ultra-short term wind power prediction is proposed. First, a CNN-LSTM ultra-short-term wind power prediction model is built. In the CNN-LSTM model, CNN is used for feature processing of wind power data sets, and it is used as the data input of LSTM model, so as to establish a CNN-LSTM fusion prediction model. The effectiveness of the combined model is verified by analyzing the Numerical Weather Prediction data and historical observation data of a wind farm. The proposed model is compared with various comparative models, leading to the important conclusion the combination model has higher prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: A Study of ECBI Children’s Early Behavioral Problems based on Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To fully understand the concentration degree of each student in the classroom, it is necessary to build a model of student concentration detection. This paper establishes a concentration analysis model to quantify the concentration index of students by analyzing the facial expression, eye attention, and head posture of middle school students in surveillance videos. The model adopts convolutional neural network technology and a Transformer self-attention mechanism. The practice results show that the error loss value of the model is close to 0, and it has a good prediction effect.

articleTitle: A Battery Control Strategy for Sequential Utilization of Energy Storage Systems in Power Batteries
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the widespread adoption of energy storage systems utilizing power batteries, battery lifespan degradation has become a primary constraint on system performance. To address this issue, this study proposes a lifespan-optimized battery control strategy. Firstly, a battery lifespan calculation model for the energy storage system is established, taking into detailed consideration key parameters such as battery State of Charge (SOC). Secondly, a control strategy based on SOC for charging and discharging is designed, aiming to minimize battery lifespan consumption to the greatest extent possible. Finally, experimental results demonstrate that the proposed control strategy significantly improves the lifespan of the energy storage system compared to existing strategies. This research provides an effective means of control for the long-term stable operation of power battery systems.

articleTitle: Zero padding IFFT based HRRP Synthesis Method for the Ultra-wide Band Random Stepped Frequency Radar
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The modulation frequencies of the random stepped frequency radar (RSFR) can be randomly distributed over the ultra-wide bandwidth for the synthesis of high-resolution range profile (HRRP). However, the randomness of the modulation frequencies makes the HRRP acquisition difficult. In the paper, a real-time zero-padding inverse discrete Fourier transform (ZP-IFFT) method is proposed to address this problem. Besides, the output signal-to-noise (SNR) performance of the proposed method is analysed and compared with the traditional matched filtering method. The simulations demonstrate that the proposed methods can obtain the same maximal output SNR with the classical method but requires less computational costs. It could effectively extend the application of the RSFR.

articleTitle: Research on Synchronization Channel Design on 230 MHz for Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Renewable energy is expected to account for increasingly higher percentages of power consumption. However, distributed energy has a random pattern of output power, resulting in the intermittent and unstable power supplies. The establishment of a dedicated network for the control and management of the smart grid to provide reliable and secure power services is attracting increasing attention. At the same time, due to the rapid development of wireless broadband communication technologies, wireless communications are increasingly being considered as a supplementary method by power communication services to extend smart grid services to areas where traditional fixed wireline communication technology cannot reach.

articleTitle: Design of PTZ Gesture Teleoperation System Based on the Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) gesture teleoperation method based on the Kalman Filter. By mapping the changes in the pitch angle and yaw angle of the hand obtained by Leapmotion to the desired angle of the two-degree-of-freedom PTZ, the teleoperation control based on the gesture for the PTZ is realized. To reduce the interference caused by hand jitter and sensor noise, this paper uses the Kalman Filter to process the measured values of Leapmotion. The experiment results show that the PTZ gesture teleoperation system based on the Kalman Filter can effectively resist interference and ensure the stability of the PTZ control.

articleTitle: Cross-Scale Focal Interactive Attention Network for Skeleton-based Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Skeleton-based action recognition has attracted much attention, benefiting from its succinctness and robustness. Previous methods often compute pairwise global self-attention for all joints in both spatial and temporal dimensions, which leads to computational redundancy. Besides, there is still a lack of a flexible strategy for effectively fusing multi-scale skeletal features. In this paper, we propose a Salient Feature Localization module that leverages the class activation map to guide the adaptive selection process of the most salient joint tokens in all frames and subject them to further processing. Then, Deformable Spatial-Temporal Focal Attention adopts the deformable sampling strategy to calculate focal attention on the selected salient features. Cross-Scale Adaptive Interactive Attention performs cross-scale attention in the spatial dimension and calculates the offset of salient feature reference points, thereby allowing for flexible integration of multi-scale information more dynamically and adaptively. Extensive experiments are conducted on the datasets NTU RGB+D and NTU RGBRGB+D. Our methods perform competitively compared to state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: A Software Workload Measurement Method Based on Workload Quota
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the software development investment planning stage and bidding stage, the requirement specification or the list of function points have not yet been formed, so the specific development realization of the system and the development workload information of the project cannot be clarified. By establishing the workload quota based on the function module, the system structure and workload estimation can be quickly judged without detailed demand analysis. The investment estimation time is greatly saved. For the individual requirements that the workload quota of functional modules cannot cover, the workload quota based on the requirement description is formed by establishing the database of the corresponding relationship between the historical requirement description and the workload measurement results, and the short text similarity matching algorithm based on the bag of words model is used to search. The two kinds of workload quotas jointly support the rapid estimation of software development workload.

articleTitle: N-O Doped Sb2Te3 Phase-Change Materials for High Performance Artificial Synaptic Device
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In recent years, in order to develop brain-like systems, researchers in the world succeeded in mimicking functions of neurons and synapses, basic components of the brain. But the adopted functional materials for artificial synapses are often not able to provide a stable and fast change, which is required in future’s real-time cognitive and image processing. In this work, in order to greatly improve the thermal stability of chalcogenide-based synapses, N-O co-doped fast-speed Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Te<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> chalcogenide materials fabricated by reactive sputtering are systematically investigated using X-ray diffraction and sheet resistance measurements.

articleTitle: Research and Brief Analysis of Unmanned Aircraft Terminal Area Encounter Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As the research on the integration of unmanned aerial systems (UASs) into the national airspace progresses, modeling the encounters between UASs and manned aircraft in airport terminal areas has become a crucial issue to address the coexistence of manned and unmanned operations and the development of UAS onboard detection and avoidance systems. The acquisition and analysis of real flight test data are essential technical means for establishing empirical models. In light of this problem, this paper analyzes publicly available UAS airport terminal area encounter data from the Lincoln Laboratory in the United States. The primary focus of this study is on the distribution of the closest points of approach (CPAs) and encounter altitudes between manned and unmanned aircraft, along with an analysis of the flight parameters of the encounter trajectories. The analytical methodology presented in this paper lays the groundwork for the subsequent development of predictive models for manned-unmanned encounters in airport terminal areas.

articleTitle: Optimization Scheme for Privacy Protection on Cloud Platforms Based on Data Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In addressing how to effectively utilize the powerful features of cloud platforms to provide users with efficient and convenient services while safeguarding the security and privacy of user data, this paper proposes a cloud platform privacy protection scheme based on data classification, namely the PPP-DCP scheme. Through experiments, it is demonstrated that as the user's project set continues to grow and the classification ratio varies, the PPP-DCP scheme outperforms the PrivRank and PrivCheck schemes, offering superior user privacy protection.

articleTitle: Radar Target Tracking Coordinated Control with PTZ Cameras for Monitoring Nearshore Buoys
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To address the difficulty of collision monitoring and evidence collection for nearshore buoys, a monitoring system integrating radar and PTZ camera is constructed. A method is developed to guide the PTZ camera to align with waterborne vessel targets through radar target tracking. Considering the characteristics of complex backgrounds and high noise in nearshore radar images, the threshold method is employed to determine whether the radar background image is updated. Through consecutive frame differencing, it is determined whether there is a voyaging vessel. Subsequently, morphological operations, filtering operations, and testing image connectivity are employed to accomplish vessel noise removal, target boundary smoothing, and calculation of connected region areas, and consequently completing vessel tracking and positioning. Field deployment tests indicate that a stable tracking state can be achieved by continuously acquiring 10 frames of radar images. This capability can provide parameters for coordinated control with the PTZ camera.

articleTitle: Research on a silicon resonant gas pressure transmitter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the continuous development of science and technology, industrial control, meteorological detection, aerospace and other fields of pressure measurement accuracy requirements are also higher and higher, in order to achieve high-precision conversion of pressure signals from silicon resonant pressure sensors, a silicon resonant pressure transmitter capable of high-precision conversion of pressure signals was designed. The transmitter is supported by a hardware framework of the transmission system through a new type of circuit design and connecting cylinder shell model. Through hardware debugging and software design, the frequency signal output from the silicon resonant sensor is converted into a standard analog signal output. The test results show that the accuracy of the transmitter reaches 0.04% FS, which is significantly improved compared with the single crystal silicon pressure transmitter and has a broad development prospect.

articleTitle: A new method for detecting the inner wall of water pipeline
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: We introduce an innovative approach to inspecting the inner walls of water pipelines, aiming to tackle the challenges associated with accurate and efficient detection. By emulating real-world conditions found within water pipelines, we reframe the problem of inner wall inspection as a three-dimensional modeling process using line-structured light. This innovative approach facilitates detection by reconstructing the three-dimensional representation of the pipeline’s inner wall. The detection approach involves the use of camera to capture the changes that occur when the line laser interacts with the inner wall of the pipeline. It extracts information about the center points of the line laser and promptly generates a model of the inner wall of the pipeline. Within the Webots simulation environment, we deployed a simulated underwater robot equipped with camera and a line laser emitter to conduct numerous experiments within water pipelines. The experimental outcomes confirm that the three-dimensional reconstruction method proposed in this paper is capable of efficiently and accurately reconstructing the inner walls of pipelines in challenging underwater environments, successfully fulfilling the detection task. This algorithm showcases robustness and broad applicability, making it a valuable asset for inner wall detection in water pipelines.

articleTitle: Research on Accurate Portrait Technology of Power Market Subjects based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the application analysis function of power business big data integration and the cost of mobile learning data is gradually increasing, data analysis application results and many other problems also need better analysis and integrated use.Making use of big data effectively can better achieve accurate marketing service, and further improve the marketing effect and service level. This paper studies the accurate portrait technology based on the big data of China’s power market, and constructs the index model of accurate portrait technology for the power market subjects of power generation enterprises, electricity selling companies and wholesale power users, which has important reference significance for the application of power big data portrait technology in practical energy.

articleTitle: Design of Power Quality Monitoring System for Distributed Photovoltaic Power Station
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the large-scale use of photovoltaic power station, the power quality problem caused by grid-connected photovoltaic power station has become a research hotspot. The power monitoring device of distributed photovoltaic power station has the function of monitoring the power before grid connection. It can monitor the power quality parameters, analyze the data, and transmit the real-time monitoring results to the client. Firstly, the calculation of power parameters is described, which mainly describes the concepts of power supply voltage deviation, voltage / current effective value, power system frequency deviation, voltage fluctuation and flicker, and power harmonics. Then the hardware structure and function of the device are described. Finally, the core device TMS320F28335 is selected, and some auxiliary peripheral circuits are designed to form a complete hardware monitoring system.

articleTitle: A 32nV/√Hz Noise 13µV Offset 0~65V Input Common Mode Range Current Sensing Amplifier based on Switch Capacitor Circuit with 1~256 Gain
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A current sensing amplifier with low noise, low offset and wide input common mode range (ICMR) is proposed in this paper. A Capacitively-Coupled Chopper Instrumentation Amplifier (CCIA) with high voltage (HV) chopper is used as the input stage to achieve $0 \sim 65\mathrm{V}$ ICMR. The switched-capacitor (SC) amplifier with correlated double sampling (CDS) technique is used as the driving stage to eliminate the offset of the input stage and provide the ADC driving capability. The proposed current sensing amplifier was simulated in 0.18um BCD process. The current sensing amplifier achieves $13 \mu \mathrm{V}$ input-referred offset, 32nV/$\surd$Hz input-referred noise, $1 \sim 256$ adjustable gain and 120dB CMRR at all gain settings within $0 \sim 65\mathrm{V}$ ICMR.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Satellite Communication Technology in the Power Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Against the backdrop of digital construction in the power grid and the accelerated construction of a new power system, satellite communication technology holds great promise for applications in the field of electricity. This article analyzes the application of satellite communication technology in various power business scenarios, summarizes the characteristics of satellite communication technology, and highlights typical architectures for its application in the power industry. Furthermore, by examining the current state of power communication in remote areas and addressing the emerging needs for satellite communication technology, the feasibility of applying satellite communication technology in power infrastructure projects, transmission line inspections and other scenarios is analyzed and explored. A typical system architecture is proposed to serve as a reference for future large-scale applications of satellite communication technology in the power sector.

articleTitle: Salient Object Detection Based on High-level Semantic Guidance and Multi-modal Interaction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Semantic information is essential in RGB-T salient object detection (SOD). Most existing methods directly input the extracted low-level features into the interaction module and utilize a simple recursive structure for prediction. Despite their excellent performance in several scenarios, they suffer from capturing and exploiting the attributes and complementary potential between different feature layers of images, which are critical in obtaining details and object location. In this work, we proposed a top-down SOD method based on high-level semantic guidance information and multi-modal interaction information. On the one hand, a high-level semantic module (HSM) is designed to implement high-level semantic guidance to the decoder part and to retain the location information of salient objects. On the other hand, a multi-modal interactive module (MIM), which composed of channel attention and multi-branch structure, is designed to interact cross-modal features and retain object location information. Evaluation results on three common benchmark datasets reveal that the proposed method successfully achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance.

articleTitle: A New Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Method with Triangular Distribution for Protection Characteristics of Circuit Breaker with Oil Dashpot
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A new fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method with triangular distribution for the protection characteristics of circuit breaker with oil dashpot is proposed. Firstly, the protection characteristic of circuit breaker with oil dashpot is measured by test method, the action time under different current and the protection characteristic curve of circuit breaker with oil dashpot are obtained. Secondly, taking the measured action time as evaluation index factors, taking the mean value of the standard action time as the optimal value of the evaluation index, setting evaluation set with five levels. Finally, the protection characteristics of circuit breaker with oil dashpot are evaluated through the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method with triangular distribution. Through test verification, this evaluation method of the protection characteristics of circuit breaker with oil dashpot is feasible, and it provides a research method for the evaluation of the protection characteristics of other similar products.

articleTitle: Research on the Integrated Method for Power Equipment State Simulation and Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The construction of the new power system can be supported using digital technology. In addition, digital technology is the best way to deal with the risk of safe and stable operation of power equipment while realizing intelligent maintenance. It is important to use digital modeling simulation and state reconstruction of power equipment to understand the multi-physical field and its spatiotemporal evolution law during the development of equipment defects. These methods can also guide the design and deployment of sensors to monitor the internal characteristics of power equipment. This paper proposes an integrated software tool for equipment state simulation and reconstruction for substation equipment state perception scenarios. It is based on the simulation calculation method of sensing data fitting and improves the analysis speed of multi-physical field simulation models. At the same time, it realizes the integration of equipment state simulation and reconstruction for equipment state perception scenarios. The tool takes the power cable as the research subject to achieve the functional integration of multi-physical field simulation of the internal temperature field of the cable, internal state data deduction, and equipment state visualization. This research has successfully delved into the data transmission chain, encompassing the entire modeling and analysis process, yielding desirable outcomes.

articleTitle: Power IOT Terminal Message Depth Analysis Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The Internet of Things technology is widely used in all aspects of power. In this paper, a deep analysis method is proposed for the message data of power Internet of Things terminal. The message data of power Internet of Things terminal is collected without disturbance through data mirroring, the hierarchical relationship of protocol tree is constructed, and the collected message data of power Internet of Things terminal is analyzed layer by layer according to the hierarchical relationship of protocol tree. Protocol reverse engineering is used to process the analyzed data, obtain the communication protocol of the electric iot terminal, and extract the meaning of the operation instruction generated in the communication process. The meaning of the operation instruction includes the behavioral meaning of the device instruction and payload data. At the same time, the model takes into account the undisturbed acquisition, real-time analysis and deep analysis of message parsing, effectively realizes the global iot management, and has portability, which can realize the scalability and consistency of the capacity expansion of electric iot terminal equipment, provides strong technical support for the automatic registration of electric iot terminal equipment and the rapid online service, and improves the work efficiency of electric iot terminal equipment.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Multiple Sampling Rate Merging Unit
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Merging unit widely used in domestic intelligent substations adopt a sampling frequency of 4kHz, which can meet the needs of bay level protection and measurement. Higher sampling frequency requirements such as power quality or PMU typically require a frequency of 12.8kHz or higher. This article proposes a scheme for transmitting multi sampling frequency data through a common port, using a merging unit device to meet the sampling needs of different specialties in the substation. Tests have shown that this scheme is suitable for networking, with low requirements for frame spacing and delay, reducing the number of sample devices, and improving the sharing of sampling data.

articleTitle: Image Restoration Algorithm Based on Attention Mechanism and Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In response to the problems of semantic discontinuity and unclear texture in image restoration, an image restoration algorithm based on attention mechanism and feature fusion was proposed. The method first generates coarse repaired images by generating adversarial networks; Then, the coarse repaired image is used as input to establish a dual channel for repairing texture and structural details. The first channel combines low-level image information with deep semantic information through attention mechanism to repair missing texture details; The second channel is a generative network architecture with dilated convolutions, which captures image structural information through a large receptive field and increases the structural similarity of the repaired image. Finally, by fusing the dual channel feature information and processing the high-level features, it can improve the accuracy of structure generation and generate more natural texture details. The test results on the CelebA dataset show that the proposed method has improved in both structural similarity and texture clarity.

articleTitle: AGV Path Planning Based on Improved A-star Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Traditional A-star algorithms encounter challenges such as an excess of turning points, significant turning angles, and proximity of turning points to obstacles. These issues can lead to increased energy consumption, hinder Automated Guided Vehicles(AGV) motion control, and elevate the risk of collisions, particularly when turning points cluster near obstacles. In response, we present an improved A-star based path planning algorithm. Our approach addresses these challenges by incorporating innovative modifications to the cost function, dynamically adjusting weights based on diverse turning angles to curtail unnecessary turns. Additionally, we integrate the artificial potential field method, introducing a unique heuristic function. This function includes a penalty term accounting for obstacle information at turning points, ensuring that these points are strategically positioned away from obstacles. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of our algorithm in comparison to traditional A-star algorithms. It successfully reduces the number of turning points in the path, maintains a safe distance from obstacles, resulting in smoother paths, and proves advantageous for precise path tracking and control.

articleTitle: Study on Evaluation of Comprehensive Economic Strength of Xinjiang Based on Factor Entropy Method and Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on data mining technology and traditional factor analysis, this paper studies the comprehensive economic strength of cities and states in Xinjiang by using the method of factor entropy. In addition, the indicators related to economic development are selected from three aspects and analyzed by SPSS software. The results show that Urumqi, Kashgar and Ili are the top three with a high level of economic development. Through cluster analysis, 14 prefectures are divided into four categories, and each category is analyzed in detail, which shows that there is still imbalance in economic development in Xinjiang. The research results are of practical significance to formulate relevant policies and promoting the further development of Xinjiang.

articleTitle: A Scheme for Improving the Observability of Power Grid by Weakening the Coupling of CPS
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a PMU measurement network configuration method based on maximum power disjoint routing to address the high cost and poor flexibility of Cyber-Physical System (CPS) in power-side fault defense. Additionally, a mathematical optimization model is formulated with the objective of minimizing the power intersection degree based on routing. Furthermore, a heuristic algorithm is designed to solve the optimization problem. In light of the economic and reliable aspects of the PMU measurement network, this study establishes an optimization configuration model for the PMU measurement network. Additionally, an improved genetic algorithm is designed to effectively solve this model. Simulation experiments demonstrate that the methodology presented in this paper has the capability to significantly enhance the observability of the power grid following a fault event, while also bolstering the resilience of power CPS with minimal resource allocation.

articleTitle: Review of Wind Power Prediction Methods Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Accurate and reliable wind power prediction is the key to realize the smooth grid connection of wind power generation. However, the influence of wind speed, wind direction, and air density and other factors leads to the high randomness and uncertainty of wind power, which brings great challenges to the prediction work. In view of the current large-scale grid connection demand of wind power new energy, the significance and method classification of wind power power prediction are discussed from many angles. This paper summarizes the latest applications of artificial intelligence technology in the field of wind power prediction, including traditional machine learning and deep learning, and compares and summarizes them. At present, deep learning prediction method is the mainstream method, and data processing and model training and robustness are the key factors. Finally, the future trends and research innovations of AI technology in wind power prediction are discussed.

articleTitle: Study on Serial Type Pump-Valve Compound Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In response to the contradiction between the control accuracy and system efficiency in traditional electro-hydraulic servo systems, this paper proposes a series-connected pump-valve composite control system and investigates the corresponding control strategies. In terms of system positioning control, a positioning error-based switch control strategy is introduced. At the beginning of positioning, the pump control section dominates to reduce system energy consumption. When the positioning error decreases to the set value, it switches to the pump-valve coordinated control state to achieve precise positioning. For dynamic tracking control, a composite control strategy is proposed, where in the pump control section adopts feedforward compensation PI control, and the valve control section adopts PID control. Simulation results indicate that, in terms of positioning control, the switch control strategy based on positioning error can significantly improve the system response speed. In dynamic tracking control, the composite control strategy combining feedforward compensation PI control and PID control enables the system to possess the advantages of high system efficiency and high precision fast response.

articleTitle: Research on Electric Energy Substitution Potential under the Diversification Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to tap the regional power substitution potential, a regional power substitution potential model is constructed based on the regional gross domestic product, population, coal consumption and other energy consumption as potential evaluation indicators, and the ranking of regional power substitution potential is analyzed. A regional multi-scenario electric energy substitution potential analysis model is established, and the combined model of GM grey prediction and neural network is used to forecast the energy consumption, so as to realize the prediction and analysis of electric energy substitution potential under various scenarios. Taking Eastern Inner Mongolia region Province as an example, this paper ranks the power substitution potential of urban areas under its jurisdiction, and forecasts the power substitution potential of Eastern Inner Mongolia under multiple scenarios. Finally, according to the prediction results, suggestions are put forward to promote the development of power substitution.

articleTitle: A Power System Disturbance Localization Method Based on the Dice Coefficient Criterion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: When a disturbance occurs in the power system, it is necessary to quickly and accurately locate the location of the disturbance, but at present, due to the limited number of synchronous Phasor Measurement Units (PMU) can not realize the monitoring of the whole system, and can only make use of the limited monitoring data to carry out the disturbance localization analysis.
