Considering the sparseness of the monitoring data, combining the relationship between the branch current and the node voltage, a cutter disturbance localization model based on the theory of compressed sensing is constructed and an improved OMP algorithm based on the Dice coefficient criterion (DOMP algorithm) is proposed. The load-shedding disturbance localization experiments are carried out in the IEEE-39 node system. Simulation results show that the DOMP algorithm outperforms the original OMP algorithm in terms of accuracy and success rate for disturbance localization.

articleTitle: A Faster Evaluation Method of Product Acceleration Factors Based on a Reliability Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Acceleration factor evaluation serves as the premise for acceleration tests and a speedier evaluation of product reliability. The current acceleration factor evaluation approaches primarily use multi-group stress acceleration test methods but ignore the redundancy backups of product components, thus resulting in prolonged testing times, higher costs and significant errors. This study forwards a faster evaluation technique of product acceleration factors based on a reliability model to address this issue. First, a product reliability model is constructed to describe the redundancy backup relations of product components and estimate the mean time between failure under normal service and acceleration conditions of products. Next, the device acceleration factor evaluation methods based on activation energy are presented, and a complete machine acceleration factor evaluation model of a product is developed to evaluate the acceleration factors of product acceleration conditions. Finally, an acceleration factor evaluation based on an integrated circuit is performed. The proposed method exhibits higher evaluation efficiency, minor errors and broader application scopes.

articleTitle: Research on AIOps-based intelligent monitoring technology for meteorological business
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The article focuses on the research of business monitoring key technologies based on AIOps, and designs relevant intelligent algorithms, which are applied to meteorological business for experimental validation. The algorithm of alarm compression and correlation achieves the compression and correlation of alarms by analyzing and processing alarm data, which helps to reduce repetitive and redundant alarm information, improve the readability and comprehensibility of alarms. The root cause analysis algorithm identifies the root cause of anomalies by in-depth analysis and mining of abnormal data, which helps to quickly locate and solve problems and reduce business interruption time. The capacity forecasting and analysis algorithm predicts the future demand for system resources by combining historical data and trend analysis, which helps to optimize resource allocation and make preparations for expansion or optimization in advance. These intelligent monitoring technologies work well in meteorological business, enhancing the support capability of “Tianjing” for the “cloud + end” business system, realizing efficient and intelligent monitoring and management.

articleTitle: Application of Multi-node Intelligent Monitoring System in Concrete Construction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This article first designs a new type of intelligent monitoring node, which is suitable for concrete construction applications in remote areas. Intelligent nodes have advantages such as battery power supply, low-power design, no need for external connections, and convenient networking. Intelligent nodes have advantages such as battery power supply, low power consumption design, no need for external connections, and convenient networking, as well as monitor the core temperature, external temperature, and internal strength information of concrete in real-time during construction and upload data wirelessly. Subsequently, a detailed discussion was conducted on the multi-node and multi-sensor information fusion algorithm based on Kalman filtering for the intelligent node. The algorithm first performs outlier removal on the collected data, then the algorithm considers the core temperature, external temperature, and intensity information as a whole and parallelly calculates the fusion information of multiple nodes and sensors. The experimental results show that under the information fusion of 10-100 sensors, the average measurement accuracy of core temperature is improved by 70.80%, the average measurement accuracy of external temperature is improved by 67.45%, and the average measurement accuracy of internal strength information is improved by 68.87%. Moreover, as the number of sensors increases, the measurement accuracy will further improve. The new intelligent monitoring node designed in the paper meets the needs of the vast majority of concrete construction scenarios. The sensor information fusion algorithm designed based on the intelligent node has low computational complexity, simple parameter adjustment, and significant improvement in measurement accuracy, whichs can not only accelerate construction progress, reduce construction costs, and ensure construction quality, but also provide strong support for intelligent analysis and judgment of subsequent multi node concrete monitoring networks.

articleTitle: Information Flow Design and Onboard Verification of Remote Sensing SAR Satellite
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: GF-3 series satellites, the first C band and multi-polarization SAR satellite constellation in China, achieve breakthroughs in a number of core and key technologies. The distribution information architecture with two kinds of data buses is used for the satellite control, information transmission and management. In this article, the design of information system net architecture, function architecture, housekeeping data storage and playback flow, important data flow and payload data flow are described. According to the requirements of users’ convenience, a distribution and layered automatic mission management architecture is applied. It has a more advanced mission interface, in which way the satellite internal design can be shielded from the satellite user and it makes satellite used easily. To ensure the satellite operation stability in orbit, several automatic health management methods are used, including system monitoring, payload mission safety control, system recovery and reconfiguration, etc. Finally, the information system test matrices during developing phase and in orbit test results are described, and some suggestions for the following satellite information system design are put forwards.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Algorithm for Rotor Time Constant of Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Power electronics technology and computer technology have made significant progress at present, and the frequency conversion and speed regulation technology of AC motor based on these two technologies has also been developed. Therefore, the variable frequency speed control system of induction motor has become a hot research topic today. The induction motor speed control system is a nonlinear system, and its dynamic response, speed control accuracy, and work efficiency are far superior to other speed control systems. The design strategy of induction motor variable frequency speed control system is based on the mathematical model of induction motor, and the accuracy of motor parameters directly affects the accuracy of flux observation and speed estimation, when the motor parameters are inaccurate, it can lead to a decrease in system performance, therefore, it is necessary to implement adaptive control of motor parameters. In actual working conditions, motor parameters may change due to environmental influences, among which changes in rotor time constant can lead to torque fluctuations and affect system performance. In order to further improve the performance of the system, a model reference adaptive system based on reactive power model is proposed for online identification of rotor time constant. The algorithm has been proven to be effective through experiments.

articleTitle: Intelligent Awareness Method of Power 5G Network Security Situation Based on Neural Network and Fuzzy Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: 5G introduces new technologies and new architectures, while also facing more complex security risks and threats. Power companies use leased 5G network slices to form a network symbiotic relationship with operators. The security of 5G network directly affects the safe and stable operation of power grid. However, power companies only own part of 5GC network elements, so it is necessary to carry out network security protection research for key parts of 5G network architecture. Through the research of 5GC security situation awareness technology, it can deal with 5G security challenges and help power grid companies operate 5G network slices efficiently and safely. This paper proposes a network security situation awareness method based on fuzzy theory and gated recurrent unit, which can convert attack information and network information into network situation, provide quantitative indicators of network security, and detect and respond to potential threats in time.

articleTitle: Improved PEGASIS Routing Protocol for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: PEGASIS protocol is the classic chain routing protocol, its network is formed into a chain by greedy algorithm, the cluster head is generated by random selection, which is easy to lead to uneven energy consumption of the nodes and large network latency. Aiming at these problems, an improved PEGASIS routing protocol for wireless sensor networks is proposed. By calculating the optimal number of clusters, the nodes are divided into several original clusters, and the ant colony optimization algorithm is used to form chains within the clusters. During network operation, dynamic time intervals are taken to update the chains based on the energy of the nodes to prevent premature death of nodes. The results show that the proposed protocol can prolong the lifetime of the network compared with the PEGASIS and PEGASIS-REDP.

articleTitle: Research on Behavior Simulation Optimization for Automated Testing in Mobile Game
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: GUIs(Graphical User Interfaces) are an important part of many software applications, especially for mobile gaming applications whose GUI screens contain a large number of widgetized control elements for triggering state transitions. Traditional testing tools such as Monkey Test generate random event sequences that fail to generate valid events for these manipulated controls, which can easily lead the test into a loop that cannot be recovered from a particular interface state. For this reason, this paper proposes a new automated testing framework named YOLOv5-ABLN-Test, which utilizes the model YOLOv5ABLN proposed in previous studies for control identification. Meanwhile, a new interface state determination strategy is proposed based on the improved ORB algorithm. The framework confirms the actual operable GUI controls by initiating GUI events to the recognized controls. We have implemented the framework as an Android application testing tool and compared it with the existing techniques in the industry through case studies of real-world applications.

articleTitle: Automatic Generation Technology of Station Signal Layout in Railway Station
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The signal plane layout of railway station is drawn according to the line diagram of the station yard, which can correctly reflect the layout of the main outdoor equipment and the setting location, the use of lines and stock tracks, and the general situation of the train and shunting operation in the station. C++ language is used to conduct secondary development of AutoCAD for computer-aided design, design and implement the basic equipment diagram of the station and yard, and automatically generate the relevant contents of the layout plan by reading the information of the station and yard line diagram.

articleTitle: Multi-Robot Motion Planning for Dynamic Environment based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, multi-robot navigation based on the deep reinforcement learning (DRL) was proposed, which could be used to solve collision avoidance between robots. Firstly, a novel neural network architecture is proposed based on a bidirectional loop module, which could map the status of obstacles to corresponding actions directly. By this way, the complexity of the calculation and decision-making process could be avoided. Then, a new reward function is proposed to improve the performance of reinforcement learning and reduce the probability of collisions in crowded environments. Subsequently, one simulation environment was built to train the proposed strategy. Also, the proposed strategy was updated and optimized by the DRL algorithm based on the actor-critic model. Experimental results show optimization results in the fields of success rate, total travel time, and average speed compared with existing methods with learning-based and optimal collision avoidance strategies.

articleTitle: Research on Binocular Stereo Vision Calibration Technology Based on Sea Surface Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The limited texture information and low matching accuracy of sea surface images result in large errors and poor stability when using existing camera external calibration methods for sea surface calibration. By improving it, the accuracy and stability of external parameter calibration have been effectively improved. After obtaining the binocular image, use Wallis filtering to preprocess the image to enhance texture features, and then use the improved AKAZE feature point extraction algorithm for uniform feature point extraction. Use KNN combined with NNDR matching method for coarse matching, and then use RANSAC iterative algorithm for matching purification. Use beam adjustment to optimize camera external parameters for the purified matching points. 1600 feature points were uniformly extracted from the weakly textured sea surface image pairs using measured data. After rough matching, 560 matching points were obtained. RANSAC iteration eliminated coarse points, and ultimately retained 378 optimal matching points. The beam adjustment optimization was used to obtain accurate camera external parameters, verifying the feasibility of the proposed method. This study solves the problems of low accuracy and poor stability in extrinsic calibration of sea scenes, improves the reliability of stereo photography wave measurement technology, and is conducive to its promotion and application.

articleTitle: Mobile Phone Location Algorithm in Classroom -- Solving Students’ Attention Problem
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper uses signal detection and estimation theory to establish a model of students’ attention mechanisms in the classroom. Firstly, this paper introduces several commonly used methods for locating signal sources indoors: the nearest neighbor method, weighted K-nearest neighbor method, and approximate method. Then, the algorithm principle is introduced in detail. By comparing the classroom-measured data with the simulated values, the teacher found that the fusion model has a good effect on detecting students’ attention. The research in this paper can be used to improve students’ concentration and indoor signal detection.

articleTitle: Research on Accelerated Life Test Method of Planetary Reducers Based on Transient Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that the life test of planetary reducer takes a long time and lacks a reliable test plan, an accelerated life test method based on transient dynamics is proposed, which can obtain the life-stress relationships by simulation in the design stage and guide the formulation of the accelerated test plan. Firstly, the finite element model of the planetary reducer was established, the fatigue stress spectrum of the planetary reducer under four working conditions were obtained, combined with nCode, the fatigue life of planetary reducer at the design stress was analyzed. The strength check of each gear was carried out to preliminarily choose the highest allowed test stress. Under the premise of not changing the failure mechanism, the life-stress model between the load and the mean life of the planetary reducer was established. The R-square of the linear regression model was 0.9287, which demonstrated the validity of the model and data. The results show that the acceleration factor at the highest stress level is 72.14.

articleTitle: Simplified Crayfish Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A simplified crayfish optimization algorithm is proposed to address the complex form and low operational efficiency of basic crayfish optimization algorithms. Firstly, the position update method of foraging behavior in the basic crayfish optimization algorithm was analyzed. And then a random search radius to optimize the foraging range was used, so as to reduce the process of generating a random number and calculating sine and cosine. Through optimization experiments on 23 universal benchmark test functions, both the simplified algorithm and the basic algorithm underwent 30 operations, and their average, standard deviation, and average running time were compared. The results show that the simplified algorithm fully maintains the basic algorithm’s convergence speed, convergence accuracy, robustness and other performance in finding the optimal solution, and reduces the average running time by 7.63%, improving the running efficiency.

articleTitle: Text Classification of Long-tailed Complaints and Reports based on Rebalanced Loss Function
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The long-tailed distribution of data poses a significant challenge in text classification tasks. The imbalanced distribution of samples among categories often hinders effective classification of categories with a limited number of samples (referred to as tail class), leading to suboptimal overall classification performance. To address this issue and accurately classify the texts of complaints and reports, this paper proposes a text classification method tailored for long-tailed distribution, leveraging a rebalanced loss function to adjust the weights of samples from different categories. In the proposed approach, we first improve the classic loss function by incorporating the Gumbel activation function to replace the conventional activation function. This modification imparts varying gradients to both head class and tail class, thereby mitigating classification bias. Subsequently, to counteract overfitting in the tail class, regularization constraints is introduced within the loss function, enhancing its generalization capability. Experimental results demonstrate that, when compared to alternative loss functions, the method presented in this paper yields superior classification results in addressing multi-classification problems characterized by long-tailed distribution of text data.

articleTitle: Application and research of ensemble learning in imbalanced credit default prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Personal loans are the core and foundation of financial business. Traditional personal credit approval is performed manually. With the large-scale popularization of the Internet, users can conveniently apply for loans through various financial platforms. Personal credit has the characteristics of large crowd size, small amount, short cycle, and high complexity. Manual review is not only inefficient but also has low accuracy in predicting user default. Credit default technology based on machine learning algorithms emerged as the times require. However, the credit default dataset is a typical imbalanced dataset. The imbalanced dataset seriously affects the performance of the algorithm, which causes the algorithm to only focus on majority class samples and ignore minority class samples. This paper proposes an algorithm called multi-granularity class weighting that can effectively handle the class imbalance problem. The main contribution of this paper is to propose an algorithm called multi-granularity class weighting to deal with the class imbalance problem, propose a new feature generation algorithm to generate high-quality features, and use the stacking method in ensemble learning to improve the model performance.

articleTitle: A New Scene Transfer Method for Flame Burning Images Based on Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The training of video fire detection models based on deep learning relies on a large number of positive and negative samples, namely fire video and scenario video with other disturbances similar to fire. In some special occasions, the fire video sampled in this scene is insufficient due to the prohibition of ignition. In this thesis, the migration of flames recorded in other similar scenarios to the specific scenarios is proposed to increase the video of fires in restricted situations. Considering the reservation and transmission of information, the generative adversarial networks is adopted and the defects of the existing methods of disentangling image information into latent spaces are overcome. This model can add flames to a given scene video and complete the fusion of style information while maintaining high quality background details. Experimental results show that this method can ensure the diversity of fire in the scene, and produce perceptually realistic results.

articleTitle: Clock Drift and Time Error Compensation with Neural Network for Time Synchronization in TSN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: TSN implements time synchronization through IEEE 802.1AS protocol, and the performance of time synchronization is related to the frequency accuracy and stability of each TSN clock. However, the problems of clock drift and timestamp granularity error (TSGE) will degrade the network time synchronization performance. This paper analyzes the causes of time errors caused by network time synchronization, and puts forward the overall scheme to improve the performance of time synchronization. An intelligent compensation algorithm for clock drift is designed, which includes measuring node clock correlation data, training neural network, using neural network to make prediction and compensating time stamp. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is stable and accurate in time synchronization.

articleTitle: Research on Remote Sensing Satellite Service Mode Based on Edge Computing Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the increasing number of satellites and the improvement of earth-observation resolution, remote sensing data has exploded. The timeliness of current satellite scheduling control and data processing mode is seriously insufficient. Edge computing technology enables the rapid response of remote sensing services and the rapid generation of products. The remote sensing satellite system architecture based on edge computing technology is designed, and its physical structure and functional model are clarified. Three remote sensing satellite service modes are designed based on edge computing technology, which are driven by user needs, driven by edge cloud autonomy and driven by central cloud. In order to provide reference for disaster relief by satellite remote sensing service.

articleTitle: Research on a Photovoltaic Panel Dust Detection System Based on Improved Mobilenet Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Solar panels (photovoltaic panels) are used in various industries, mainly to generate clean electricity and provide energy for various occasions. However, due to long-term exposure to the natural environment, the accumulation of dust on solar panels is inevitable due to factors such as climate, wind, vegetation, and animals, which weakens the ability of solar panels to absorb too much energy, reduces efficiency, shortens lifespan, and increases costs. This paper utilizes a model that combines feature extraction from a convolutional neural network and a machine learning classifier to train and classify the Kaggle solar panel public dataset using the two-class image classification method. The final classification accuracy is 94%, and a system is designed to achieve automatic recognition of solar panel dust detection. This paper adopts a method of combining MobileNet feature extraction with different classifiers, and ultimately, the MobileNet plus logistic regression method has the best effect. The need for regular maintenance of solar panels is high, and the cost is high. This study can help detect dust accumulation on solar panels, reduce costs, improve solar energy utilization, and bring great convenience to solar panel testing.

articleTitle: Fast numerical computation on the harmonic Arnoldi algorithm for large-scale φ functions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the problem of complex networks, it is often necessary to calculate matrix exponential function which is a special case of $\varphi$ functions arising from exponential integrators. However, the computational overhead of matrix exponential function is very high if the matrix of networks is large scale. For generality, in this paper, we consider the fast computation of large-scale $\varphi$ functions. In the previous work (G. Wu, L. Zhang, T. Xu, Adv. Comput. Math., 42(2016) 505–541.), we have given a thick-restated harmonic Arnoldi (TRHA) method for approximating $\varphi$ functions. However, in this algorithm, one needs to solve initial value problems frequently in the practical computation. When the time variable t approaches to zero, it is not easy to solve these initial value problems and is time-consuming. To overcome this problem, in the current work, we propose the exponential quadrature rule (EQR) method for solving the initial value problems. The major benefit of our EQR method is that we can avoid the time t approaching to zero and then reduce the computational time. Numerical examples demonstrate the effectiveness of our new method for approximating large-scale $\varphi$ functions.

articleTitle: A pre-trained model specialized for ship trajectory prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The problem of ship trajectory prediction has a long-standing history within the broader domain of time series forecasting. Historically, trajectory prediction tasks involved dividing a trajectory into training and testing sets. However, due to the emphasis on the completeness of ship trajectories and their relatively weak periodicity, this approach undoubtedly resulted in information loss as some important patterns and features were not adequately learned. In order to capture the entirety of ship trajectories, we propose a pre-training model specifically designed for ship trajectory prediction. Employing a single-decoder architecture and fine-tuning on specific sub-tasks, this model enables direct input of data segments, allowing for immediate initiation of the prediction process. Our approach not only achieves impressive prediction accuracy but also opens up new possibilities for downstream tasks. The pre-trained model extends its applicability beyond traditional sequential trajectory prediction. By adjusting the downstream linear layers, the model can be tailored to produce a wider array of desired outcomes. This adaptability empowers the model to address a variety of tasks, thereby enhancing its utility in ship trajectory forecasting.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Resource Allocation for Full-duplex Device-to-Device Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Device-to-device (D2D) technology is one of the key research areas in 5G/6G networks, and full-duplex (FD) D2D will further enhance its spectral efficiency (SE). In recent years, deep learning approaches have shown remarkable performance in D2D resource allocation tasks. However, most schemes only model the channel state information (CSI) as an independent feature, neglecting the spatial relationships among multiple channels and users within the scenario. In this paper, we first design an objective function for FD D2D communication resource allocation, which aims to maximize the SE of D2D users while ensuring the minimal required SE of cellular users. Then, considering the complex CSI constituted by all the users in different channels as a three-dimensional vector, a centralized resource allocation model based on multi-dimensional spatial convolutional networks and attention mechanisms (SP-Conv-Att) is proposed. To alleviate the burden of base station, we develop two distributed models, Dist-Att and Dist-Att-Conv, to facilitate users to perform channel and power allocation locally, based on attention and multi-user convolutional networks respectively. Numerical results demonstrate that our models outperform traditional schemes and recent deep neural network models, significantly approximating the optimal solution computed by exhaustive algorithm with extremely low latency.

articleTitle: Classification of Benign and Malignant Breast Cancer Diagnosis Based on Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Efficient and accurate classification of breast cancer pathological images is of crucial significance for both doctors’ diagnosis and computer-aided diagnosis, and this study combines the problems existing in the classification of breast cancer pathological images at this stage, and proposes a method based on convolutional neural network (VGG_16) to extract features of breast cancer pathological images to realize the pathological images of breast cancer, which is faster in the processing of breast cancer pathological images and can quickly and accurately diagnose benign and malignant lesions. By learning from different details and textures in the image, the network is able to effectively capture important features about benign and malignant breast cancer. The continuously optimized model can achieve a classification accuracy of 98% or more for benign and malignant breast cancer on the BreakHis dataset. It aims to improve the accuracy and efficiency of benign and malignant diagnosis of breast cancer. Experimental results show that the classification method for benign and malignant diagnosis of breast cancer based on convolutional neural network is effective. This has important implications for both diagnostic decision-making by doctors and computer-aided diagnosis. Further research can explore deeper network structures or other improved methods to further improve the performance and accuracy of breast cancer pathological image classification.

articleTitle: Insulation Fault Analysis Caused by Internal Metal Particles in 330kV GIS
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Gas insulated switchgear (GIS) may develop defects internally during production, transportation, and installation, which can lead to partial discharges and consequently, failure. This paper focuses on an insulation fault caused by internal metal particles in a 330kV GIS. The composition of decomposition products and foreign objects inside the cylinder was analyzed using scanning electron microscopy and energy spectrum analysis. A multi-physics field simulation software, COMSOL, was used to establish an electric field simulation model and analyze the movement of metal particles in the cylinder and the fault mechanism. The analysis found that the cause of the accident was the vibration caused by the frequent operation of the circuit breaker near the fault point. This vibration moved the metal piece on the outside of the B-phase shield closer to the shield. Under the high electric field near the shield, the metal piece moved upward and ultimately caused a gas gap breakdown discharge. This discharge occurred because the local field strength exceeded the breakdown field strength, resulting in a fault. Based on this accident, solutions and preventive measures have been proposed to improve the operational reliability of this type of GIS equipment.

articleTitle: Track-Optimization of Relay UAV based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Future wars will be more technologically advanced and information-driven. Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) relay communications will play a crucial role in the battlefield. The paper aims to address the deployment of RUAVs on the battlefield by designing trajectories that consider air users, ground users, and potential threats. The goal is to ensure that RUAVs maximize the uplink data transfer rate while ensuring safety. Given the complexity of the battlefield environment, we have designed a neural network structure with predictive capabilities and proposed a DDQN-based RUAV trajectory optimization algorithm. Our experiments have demonstrated that our algorithm learns environmental information more quickly, achieves greater returns, and exhibits faster and more stable convergence performance in battlefield environments than traditional methods.

articleTitle: Dynamic Multi-Scale Spatio-Temporal Graph ODE for Metro Ridership Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Accurate metro ridership prediction is a very crucial task for the daily operation of metro system. However, complex spatio-temporal correlations of ridership makes it challenging. Existing studies widely use Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to model spatial correlations, but traditional GNN models cannot expand the spatial receptive field by increasing the depth, and all node representations will converge to the same value with deeper layers. In this paper, we propose a novel Dynamic Multi-Scale Spatio-Temporal Graph Ordinary Differential Equation Networks (DMSTGODE). First, the temporal module captures dynamic multi-scale temporal dependencies through a temporal convolution module and a temporal attention module. Second, we design a tensor-based Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) solver, which not only captures spatio-temporal features but also avoids over-smoothing problems. To understand the network more comprehensively, we consider both the geographic adjacency matrix and the semantic adjacency matrix. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that our proposed method significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: ChatGPT – Technical Research Model, Capability Analysis, and Application Prospects
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: ChatGPT is one of the most advanced research achievements in the field of natural language processing. In order to showcase the research technology and application value of the large language model ChatGPT, this article provides a comprehensive summary of its development history, research status, and key technologies. This paper focuses on key technologies such as large-scale corpus training, support for high computing power, the fundamental model architecture of the Transformer, and reinforcement learning from human feedback. Three types of features are analyzed: the ChatGPT model GPT-4 Turbo, custom ChatGPT, and the multimodal API. In light of the limitations of technology based on current deep neural networks, which rely on big data and extensive computing power, and the presence of illusory performance, several suggestions are being proposed. The revolutionary applications of ChatGPT in the fields of education, search engines, metaverse, and high-tech enterprises are summarized. Finally, the full text is summarized and prospected.

articleTitle: An Improved Humboldt Squid Optimization Algorithm Based on Genetic Mutation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved Humboldt squid optimization algorithm (GMHSOA) based on genetic mutation to address the issues of multiple adaptive parameters and high time cost that the generation of egg positions during the exploitation of the newly proposed Humboldt squid optimization algorithm (HSOA). The proposal of this algorithm starts from the essence of the optimization algorithm exploitation stage, that is, the generation of egg group positions requires inheriting the optimization results of parents on the one hand, and effectively avoiding the problem of algorithm falling into local optima on the other hand. In other words, the egg group also needs to undergo mutation or mutation to generate new positions and search for the optimal solution again, which precisely reflects two aspects of genetics and mutation. In order to verify the performance of the proposed algorithm, the GMHSOA algorithm was compared with HSOA, PSO, COA, PDO, SSA, and BES algorithms based on 23 benchmark test functions in terms of algorithm convergence and time cost, and good results were obtained. Therefore, the algorithm proposed in this article has certain advantages.

articleTitle: EVisionary: A Prediction Platform for Electric Vehicle Charging Capacity based on the Impact Analysis of Climate Factors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents EVisionary, a system platform that analyzes the impact of climate factors on electric vehicle charging demand and predicts the charging capacity of electric vehicles. The platform utilizes big data statistical analysis methods and implements seven machine learning and deep learning time series prediction models to forecast short-to-medium-term electric vehicles’ charging demand. A case study of the electric vehicle charging data set in Dundee, Scotland is used to explore the relationship between climate factors and charging demand. Performance comparisons of the prediction models are conducted, and the platform enables users to set data analysis and forecast parameters for valuable analysis and forecast results.

articleTitle: Surface defect detection method for high-voltage cable joints based on improved YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of inaccurate and time-consuming manual detection of surface defects on high-voltage cable joints, a method for detecting surface defects on cable joints based on improved YOLOv5s is proposed. Firstly, (Space to Depth) SPD convolution and (Efficient Channel Attention) ECA attention mechanism are used in the feature extraction network to prevent the loss of information in tiny defects due to pooling operations. Secondly, a new multi-scale fusion feature pyramid structure is designed to better retain and fuse important information at each scale. Then the decoupling operation is performed on the detection head to avoid the conflict between the classification task and the localization task. Finally, the (Normalize Wasserstein Distance) DWN metric is used to design the localization loss to improve the ability of tiny defect localization. The experimental results show that the proposed method achieves 93.86% mAP in the cable joint surface defect dataset. Compared with the original algorithm, it improves 2.61% mAP, and at the same time reduces the number of parameters by 27.46% and the flops by 49.43%.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient and Latency-optimal Task Offloading Strategies for Multi-user in Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Compute-intensive and latency-sensitive applications place stringent demands on mobile devices in terms of computational power and task latency. Edge computing is a promising technique to alleviate the computational constraints of mobile terminals and reduce their energy consumption through computation offloading. This paper proposes a two-tier task offloading framework for multi-user multi-server edge IoT scenarios, comprehensively considering factors such as task offloading decision, network channel allocation, edge server computational resources, device transmission power, and the size of the task offloading data volume, and constructing a multi-user task offloading Optimization problem model. In the process of solving the optimization problem, a Combining GA and PSO Computation offloading Algorithm (CGPCA) is proposed for solving the model. Finally, the convergence of the algorithm is verified through simulation experiments, and the experimental results show that the proposed algorithm in this study can effectively reduce the task offloading delay and energy consumption, and improve the quality of end-user service compared with other existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Electronic Medical Record Privacy Protection Scheme Based on Attribute Encryption Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of science and technology and the progress of medical and health system, electronic medical records with the advantages of large storage capacity and easy sharing have gradually replaced traditional paper medical records. In recent years, due to factors such as improper hospital management or hacker attacks, medical privacy leaks have occurred frequently, which not only caused serious privacy violations to patients, but also caused a negative impact on society that cannot be ignored. In order to prevent the leakage of medical privacy data during the sharing process and protect the electronic medical record data of patients, an access control scheme based on attribute encryption technology is proposed. The proposed scheme uses the ordered binary decision diagram (OBDD) as the access structure. Compared with the threshold access structure and the linear secret sharing access structure (LSSS), OBDD can represent any access strategy and support positive and negative values of attributes, and its expression efficiency higher. The proposed scheme combines ciphertext attribute-based encryption (CP-ABE) with the national secret SM4 algorithm, and uses hybrid encryption to realize data protection of electronic medical records. After security analysis and experimental verification, the proposed scheme satisfies the selection plaintext security under the judgment bilinear Diffie-Hellman (DBDH) assumption, and has constant key length and high decryption efficiency, which has higher storage and computing performance advantages than other schemes.

articleTitle: Scheduling Distributed Flexible Assembly Lines using Safe Reinforcement Learning with Soft Shielding
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Highly automated assembly lines enable significant productivity gains in the manufacturing industry, particularly in mass production condition. Nonetheless, challenges persist in job scheduling for make-to-job and mass customization, necessitating further investigation to improve efficiency, reduce tardiness, promote safety and reliability. In this contribution, an advantage actor-critic based reinforcement learning method is proposed to address scheduling problems of distributed flexible assembly lines in a real-time manner. To enhance the performance, a more condensed environment representation approach is proposed, which is designed to work with the masks made by priority dispatching rules to generate fixed and advantageous action space. Moreover, a Monte-Carlo tree search based soft shielding component is developed to help address long-sequence dependent unsafe behaviors and monitor the risk of overdue scheduling. Finally, the proposed algorithm and its soft shielding component are validated in performance evaluation.

articleTitle: Analysis and Identification of Glass Composition Based on Logistic Regression and PCA+k-means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the data of question C of the “Higher Education Society Cup” National Undergraduate Mathematical Modeling Contest in 2022, analyzes and identifies the components in glass relics. Firstly, Eliminating Fixed Sum Constraints of Various Components in Glass through Central Log-Ratio Transformation, and the change amount and rate of chemical composition of high-potassium and lead-barium glasses before and after weathering were preliminarily explored, and the data were analyzed by chi-square and corrected chi-square. Then, the composition of different glass types was analyzed by binary Logistic regression model. Finally, the PCA+K-Means coupling model is established to classify the high-potassium glasses. It is found that the change amount and change rate of each component of different types of glass are different before and after weathering, and the distribution is also different. That is to say, different types of glass have significant effects on the surface weathering of glass, but the effects of glass decoration, color and weathering are not significant. And different chemical substances have a significant impact on the classification of ancient glass products. At the same time, the subcategories of high-potassium glasses can be divided into four categories according to the contents of calcium oxide, magnesium oxide and alumina.

articleTitle: A Multi-Scenario Traffic Classification Method Based on Pretrained Encoder and Text Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The current network traffic application scenarios are complex and diverse. The traditional traffic classification methods are obviously no longer suitable for the complex traffic of today. Most of these methods are usually only designed for traffic classification in single scenarios, and they yield mixed performance results when applied to multiple traffic datasets. With the advancement of deep learning, the current predominant methods for complex traffic classification rely on pre-trained models. These models effectively address the issue of weak semantics in encrypted traffic and can achieve high performance in classifying such traffic. We propose a multi-scenario traffic classification approach based on an existing benchmark model. This approach treats the traffic as textual sequence information and processes it as text. It involves extracting the 12-layer [CLS] vectors of the pre-trained encoder and combining them with textual convolutional neural networks. This approach yields features for key information as well as a combination of low-level and high-level semantics. The F1 score for the encrypted traffic ISCX-VPN dataset reaches 99.66%, while for the malicious intrusion traffic ISCX-IDS2012 dataset, it reaches 99%. These scores are higher than those of most benchmark models. Additionally, performance on the USTC-TFC dataset is also on par with the best current malware traffic classification models, with an F1 score of 99.50%. Experiments have proven that the model presented in this paper can effectively distinguish network traffic in various scenarios.

articleTitle: A Multi-objective Constrained Optimization Method for Manufacturing Process Parameters of Electrolytic Copper Foil
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The manufacturing of electrolytic copper foil products has strong coupling and multiple influencing factors. Its process parameters are influenced by both equipment status and product quality. However, existing process optimization methods only consider product quality requirements. To overcome these problems, a multi-objective constrained optimization method for manufacturing process parameters of electrolytic copper foil is proposed. First, a non-linear mapping model based on neural networks is established between process-equipment and product quality parameters; then, based on the established mapping model, equipment status information, and product quality requirements, a multi-objective constraints function is constructed, and a genetic algorithm is used to optimize process parameters. Finally, the actual production data of the enterprise proves that the proposed method can effectively improve the product quality and production efficiency of electrolytic copper foil.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of System-of-System Contribution Rate of Equipment Based on Operational Concept
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: System-of-system(SOS) contribution rate evaluation has become an indispensable part of equipment project demonstration. According to the requirements of systematic construction and application of equipment, it is urgent to evaluate the SOS contribution rate(SCR) of equipment from the perspective of operational conceptual capability requirements. Introduce the operational concept-driven idea into the field of SCR evaluation of equipment, take the operational concept (CONOPS) capability system as the object of contribution rate of equipment, and take the role of equipment in the transformation of CONOPS capability as the main line, this paper proposes a framework for evaluating SCR of equipment driven by CONOPS, and constructs the cycle model of CONOPS capability generation, and analyzes the key steps of SCR evaluation of equipment, and verifies the feasibility and rationality of the method through examples. It can provide quantitative decision support for evaluating SCR of equipment based on CONOPS capability generation mechanism, in order to achieve the original intention of SCR of equipment to support equipment priority development ranking decision.

articleTitle: Key Technologies of Government Data Heterogeneity and Interoperation: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Government data is the core of national data resources. Building a government big data system and strengthening data aggregation, sharing and utilization are the key to smooth the circulation of data resources, build a high-quality digital government, and promote the modernization of the national governance system and governance capacity. Government data sources are wide and the collection standards are not uniform, which leads to the problems of diversified information sources, large structural differences and difficult alignment. At present, most of the existing researches focus on the application and management of government data, and few studies fully discuss the heterogeneity of government data and the data sharing technology framework based on interoperation. This paper first summarizes the source characteristics and heterogeneity of government data, then analyzes the key technologies of government data sharing based on interoperation, and finally summarizes and looks forward to the government big data system.

articleTitle: Learning to Evaluate Potential Safety Risk of Ego-Vehicle via Inverse Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The flourishing development of autonomous driving technology has brought forth a pivotal question, which is how to enhance the safety of autonomous vehicles. Ensuring vehicle safety requires comprehensive attention not only to the surrounding environment but also an in-depth exploration and monitoring of crucial factors intrinsic to the vehicle itself. One such key factor is the slip ratio, a determinant of the traction force acting on the vehicle, which importantly impacts the safety of the vehicle. The precise quantification of slip ratio’s impact on vehicle safety holds crucial significance for mitigating potential hazards and enhancing overall safety. This paper introduces a novel approach, which utilizes deep inverse reinforcement learning (DIRL) to extract the evaluation of slip ratio’s influence on vehicle safety from expert demonstration, by considering the single step action case to get rid of the dependence on vehicle model. The proposed method provides a general and direct safety assessment approach, imparting novel insights for practical applications in this field. The effectiveness of the proposed method is empirically verified by experimental results, which demonstrate the accuracy of the proposed method in assessing vehicle safety.

articleTitle: Prototype of Software Theorem Radar System Based on RFSoC and PetaLinux
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In view of the rapid development of modern radar technology and the increasing complexity of the modern radar system, this paper points out that the current situation leads to the problem that the radar types are too complex and the function is single, and if you want to improve or change the radar function, you need to replace a large number of hardware, which leads to the challenge of radar research and development efficiency and update speed. In order to solve these challenges, this paper proposes a solution called software-defined radar, and expounds the idea of selecting a heterogeneous computing platform as the core platform of software-defined radar. On this basis, a software-defined radar architecture of three levels, namely analog layer, logic layer and software layer, was constructed, and RFSoC heterogeneous chip and PetaLinux embedded operating system were selected as the architecture carrier according to the division of software and hardware and functional characteristics of each layer. The paper also analyzes the specific implementation methods of transferring the functions of radar signal transmission, radar signal processing and other advanced algorithms to the software level. Finally, the future development trend and worthy of attention of software-defined radar technology are summarized. The actual field test shows that the software-defined radar platform has achieved good results, which verifies the feasibility of software-defined radar technology.

articleTitle: Research on Microservice Migration Mechanism for Mobile Edge Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Microservice is a new type of service architecture different from monomer service architecture, which can improve the service quality of nearby users. However, the movement of users will lead to frequent switching of edge servers that provide services to users, increasing service delay and service cost. It is difficult to meet both the low latency requirements of users and the low cost requirements of service providers. Therefore, this paper aims to solve how to formulate a microservice deployment and migration strategy considering service response time and service cost, construct a microservice deployment migration model, abstract the problem into a Markov decision process, and use deep reinforcement learning algorithm to solve it. Finally, simulation experiments are carried out to compare the effect of deep reinforcement learning algorithm with that of heuristic algorithm and random selection algorithm, and to verify the performance of reinforcement learning algorithm in solving this problem.

articleTitle: Information Geometry Approach Based on Deep Learning for Massive MIMO-OFDM Channel Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Massive multiple input multiple output communication has outstanding advantages in spectrum and energy efficiency. Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing modulation is the fundamental modulation technology for broadband wireless communication. In recent years, the combination of the two has been widely used in 5G systems. Channel estimation plays an important role in massive MIMO-OFDM systems. However, with the significant increase of channel matrix dimension in massive MIMO-OFDM systems, it is challenging to perform accurate channel estimation with low computation complexity. The existing information geometry approach for channel estimation in massive MIMO-OFDM systems can achieve higher channel estimation accuracy with iterations. However, this algorithm based on heuristic strategy has unstable convergence performance. An information geometry approach based on deep learning for channel estimation is proposed in this paper to overcome the aforementioned shortcoming. This method can solve the optimization problem of damping factors in existing information geometry approach for channel estimation. It has better convergence performance with less number of algorithm iterations, and the complexity of channel estimation is reduced significantly.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Peak-Valley Time-Sharing Tariffs in Customer-Side Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: High wind abandonment rate, insufficient consumption, is the main problem that restricts the development of China’s wind power industry. Restricted by the power structure, grid network and power load characteristics, some of China’s regional power grid peak capacity is limited, unable to meet the demand to further improve the level of wind power consumption; and wind energy resources are more centralized, away from the load center, the grid scheduling capacity is limited. Therefore, demand-side response has become an important breakthrough to solve the problem of wind abandonment, peak and valley time-sharing tariff is an important means of demand-side response, this mechanism to price as an economic lever, can guide the user to reasonably adjust the demand for electricity, to realize the peaks and valleys to fill in the valley, increase the valley of the wind power online power, thus improving the wind power consumption capacity. Explore the development of wind power peak and valley time-sharing tariffs and their effective implementation, for solving the current wind power abandonment problem is very necessary, has a high practical research value. In this paper, on the basis of in-depth analysis of the peak and valley tariff and its role in the mechanism, the establishment of the peak and valley time-sharing tariff pricing mechanism based on the consumption of wind power, and its application in the user-side energy storage system, to solve the current problem of large-scale wind power abandonment, to improve the efficiency of renewable energy utilization, resource conservation, and to improve the quality of the environment, has a very important significance.

articleTitle: Multi-perspective Visualization Analysis of Taxi Trajectory Data Features
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The shortcomings of current analysis of taxi trajectory data include restricted perspectives and insufficient consideration of spatiotemporal features. To address these issues, this paper proposes a method for analyzing trajectory data from multiple angles to explore the information contained in taxi data in three dimensions: spatiotemporal hotspots, popular routes, and regional characteristics. Firstly, a new clustering algorithm is constructed, combining radial graphs and heat maps to analyze the travel characteristics of residents in hotspots. Then, spatial similarity is introduced to cluster hot routes, and urban travel characteristics are analyzed using hot route maps and flight maps. Finally, by calculating the ratio of weekend to weekday traffic flow, a radar chart of point of interest distribution is constructed to explore the composition characteristics of the city’s three types of regions. The study found that roads such as Qiongzhou Avenue, Longhua Road, and Binhai Avenue in Haikou have high traffic volumes during rush hour, which easily leads to traffic congestion. Hotspot areas such as Xiuying Bridge, World Trade Center, and university areas have obvious changes, and the hotspot values are highest from 18:00 to 24:00 every day. The residential population activity areas are relatively stable, and people prefer to relax and seek medical treatment on weekends. The analysis shows that Haikou is a young city, and the experimental results are consistent with the age distribution of Haikou residents. The spatiotemporal characteristics of the city obtained from this research will provide valuable reference information for future urban planning and public facility layout.

articleTitle: Energy Saving and Stability Control Strategies for a Platoon System of Mixed Gasoline and Electric Vehicles under Uncertainty and Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: An energy saving strategy and stability control method of heterogeneous intelligent connected platoon system consisted of fuel vehicles and pure electric vehicles were proposed. Firstly, the dynamics model and energy consumption model of heterogeneous vehicle platoon were established considering the factors that weaken the stability of vehicle system, such as uncertain parameters, communication delay and external interference. Secondly, the optimal economic vehicle speed was planned offline based on dynamic programming method, and a new energy-saving spacing strategy was proposed. Secondly, the state tracking error system was constructed. Based on the distributed robust control method, the stability criterion of platoon system under interference and information delay was given. Through the simulation test, it is found that the energy saving effect of following vehicles can be improved by 10.087 %, 10.311 %, 10.355 % and 42.138 % respectively under the premise of keeping the platoon system stable.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Optimal Frequency Hopping Patterns in OFDM Mobile Communication System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a method for generating optimal frequency hopping patterns with ideal autocorrelation and cross-correlation in an OFDM cellular mobile communication system. Our approach utilizes a two-dimensional cyclic shift and employs Welch Costas arrays for pattern design. The primary objective is to effectively eliminate interference from OFDM subcarriers, particularly those associated with multipath delay and Doppler shift in cellular mobile communication systems. Furthermore, we offer a structural diagram illustrating the practical application of these optimal frequency hopping patterns within the OFDM communication system.

articleTitle: Anti-Mobile UAV Cluster Interference Algorithm based on online BSS for multi-satellite MIMO communication system with FFR
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The multi-satellite multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) communication system with full frequency reuse (FFR) has high spectral efficiency. However, satellite communications are highly susceptible to interference, and the communication quality of multi-satellite MIMO communication systems with FFR will be seriously affected when suffering from close-range interference from mobile unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) Cluster. Therefore, we utilize an online blind source separation (BSS) algorithm without the aid of a priori information for the anti-jamming of mobile UAV clusters, which can avoid the additional occupation of channel resources, as well as process the mixed signals of time-varying systems and output separated signals in real-time. In this paper, the R-V-M-EASI algorithm is proposed, which adjusts the adaptive step size and momentum term factor using the crosstalk index as a separation performance index. The mutation point of the time-varying mixing matrix can be determined by detecting the change of the error function and then using a better converged separation matrix before the mutation to separate the observation signal retrospectively. Simulation results show that the R-V-M-EASI algorithm can effectively separate the mixed signals in both stationary and non-stationary environments, and it has faster convergence speed and lower steady error. For scenarios where the mixed matrix mutates, the proposed algorithm is effective in improving the separation accuracy of the separation matrix at the initial stage.

articleTitle: Detection and Defense Mechanism for Service Request Packet Flooding Attacks in Smart Identifier Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Due to the rapid growth of internet traffic, increased mobility, and heightened security requirements, signs of aging have manifested in today’s internet. To adapt to these changes and advance the internet towards the future, the Smart Identifier Network (SINET) has been proposed and is widely considered a promising architecture for the future internet. However, the security of SINET is jeopardized by a security vulnerability known as a Service Request Packet Flooding (SRPF) attack. In this type of attack, adversaries flood SINET with a large number of malicious service request packets, occupying the service request list space of routers in the network. By depleting the router’s memory resources, attackers render the router incapable of serving normal users, thereby degrading the performance of the network’s transmission. In this paper, we propose a defense mechanism against SRPF attacks based on Theil entropy and dynamic credibility. This method achieves early detection of SRPF attacks, ensuring the effectiveness and accuracy of detection, and it also effectively counters packet flooding attacks, reducing the packet loss rate for legitimate requests and safeguarding legitimate users. Simulation results demonstrate that our approach effectively mitigates SRPF in SINET.

articleTitle: Research Status of Attitude Measurement Based on Global Navigation Satellite System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Attitude measurement technology is the key technology in the research of information munitions. At present, the main methods commonly used in attitude measurement are inertial navigation and geomagnetic navigation. Global satellite navigation system (GNSS) has become the research hotspot of carrier attitude measurement because of its characteristics of no calibration, low cost and low energy consumption. In this paper, the method of carrier attitude measurement is introduced, and the research status of satellite navigation system based carrier attitude measurement technology, the development status of system application, existing problems and development trend are described in detail.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine Power Curve Abnormal Feature Detection Algorithm based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The traditional screening of abnormal information in wind turbine power curves mainly relies on personnel with specialized knowledge backgrounds, and this screening method could be more efficient and of varying accuracy. Solving this problem involves proposing an enhanced YOLOv5 target detection model in this paper to identify abnormal features in the wind turbine power curves. Subsequently, it automatically screens fault information in wind turbine power curves, thereby improving the swift localization of problematic units. This study collects operational data from SCADA systems of wind farms nationwide. It employs various processing methods, such as data visualization and anomaly feature annotation, to generate a dataset of anomalous features in the power curves of wind turbines. Regarding enhancement, this paper initially integrates the SE attention mechanism into the final layer of the YOLOv5 backbone network to augment the network’s capacity for capturing crucial features. Following this, we substitute the CIoU in the localization loss function with the SIoU function and introduce an angular loss to enhance regression accuracy. On the homemade dataset, the experimentally refined model demonstrates a 3.9% improvement in mAP compared to the conventional model. It also exhibits favorable results in real-world application scenarios, markedly enhancing the efficiency of problematic unit detection and offering substantial support for the intelligentization process of wind power stations.

articleTitle: A Dual-branch Model for Early Detection of Alzheimer’s Disease Using Resting-State fMRI
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is the most prevalent form of dementia, and early diagnosis is crucial for delaying and treating AD. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI), a widely used medical imaging technique, offers rich temporal and spatial data, which has led researchers to explore various feature extraction methods based on rs-fMRI images for AD identification. However, the related work still suffers from insufficient utilization of temporal and spatial information which leads to unsatisfactory early diagnosis. In this study, we propose a dual-branch fusion model to extract spatial-temporal features from rs-fMRI images. Our proposed model can extract temporal features at different levels. We developed a Class Activation Sequence (CAS) branch, which is a structure that emphasizes the function of each temporal node throughout the whole time series. Additionally, we created a time-domain local branch for local feature extraction. Further, we designed a fusion module for the model to describe temporal contextual relationships and fuse features at various levels. We tested the performance of the model on the ADNI dataset, and the experimental results show that compared with other algorithms, the dual-branch fusion model achieves higher classification accuracy on several classification tasks including early diagnosis, which proves the advantage of the dual-branch fusion model in temporal and spatial feature extraction for rs-fMRI images, and our work also provides a foundation for the temporal domain characterization of rs-fMRI images.

articleTitle: Research on Single-hop Anti-eavesdropping Technology Based on Double Full-duplex Cooperative Interference
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the eavesdropper’s CSI is difficult to obtain, combined with the characteristics of satellite channel, a single hop anti eavesdropping method based on dual full duplex cooperative interference is proposed in this thesis. This method does not need the CSI between the ground terminal and the eavesdropper, gets rid of the dependence of the existing satellite communication anti eavesdropping technology on the eavesdropper CSI, and has high robustness. Firstly, a single hop anti eavesdropping model based on dual full duplex cooperative interference is established. On this basis, the expressions of signal to interference noise ratio (SINR) are derived respectively between legitimate terminal and eavesdropper in the case of residual self-interference and complete elimination of self-interference in full duplex receiver, and then the expression of system security rate is given. Then, under the constraints of system total power and user information rate, the optimal power allocation problem is established, and its optimal closed-form solution is obtained. Finally, the correctness of the theoretical derivation is verified by simulation. The simulation results show that the optimal power allocation scheme proposed in this thesis can significantly improve the system security compared with the equal power allocation scheme.

articleTitle: Quantum Secure Communication Scheme for Power Dispatching Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the security of power dispatching data transmission over the network, the combined modulation quantum key distribution system which encodes each single-photon signal with both phase modulation and polarization modulation is studied. Based on the abstract unit model of power dispatching data transmission network, the network deployment scheme of using quantum key to realize the encrypted transmission of dispatching data is elaborated. In order to better meet the needs of practical application scenarios, a quantum key allocation scheme that comprehensively considers service importance, service bandwidth, and the amount of remaining keys in the quantum key pool, a quantum key request response scheme that comprehensively considers service delay constraints, the number of service key requests and service importance, and a quantum key pool key resource supplement scheme that comprehensively considers the success rate of service encryption and the freshness of quantum keys in the quantum key pool are further designed. The scheme presented in this paper can provide a reference for the design and practical application of quantum secure communication network for power dispatching data.

articleTitle: Research on Data Interaction Behavior Security Situational Awareness of Power monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low accuracy of abnormal behavior detection and high false positive rate and false positive rate in the detection of traditional data interaction behavior, we propose a data interaction behavior security situation analysis model of power monitoring system. This model progresses sequentially from three aspects: data exchange behavior information collection method of power monitoring system, security situation analysis of important business data, and dynamic behavior security control of data interaction. Based on the time series model, the temporal correlation between the previous data and the current environment is established, and the anomalies are determined for the long-term operation law of the features for the data layer and the feature layer. For the decision-making layer, including sensitive data distribution and cyberspace, the effectiveness of abnormal behavior detection is improved through comparison with its own historical data and horizontal comparison of other data interactions.

articleTitle: Review of Static Image Compression Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the increasing development of digital image communication technology, the requirements for image quality, such as texture details, color levels, and dynamic range, are gradually increasing. This presents unprecedented challenges to the tradeoff between the reliability and effectiveness of image compression technology. Static image compression standards are an integration of phased research achievements in image compression algorithms and provide guidance for the study of image compression. Firstly, static image compression algorithms are introduced in three types: discrete cosine transform (DCT) coding-based methods, prediction coding-based methods, and discrete wavelet transform (DWT) coding-based methods, based on the existing literatures and the latest achievements. The basic idea is elaborated for each typical algorithm. Secondly, the advantages and disadvantages of these algorithms are analyzed, compared, and summarized. Thirdly, research on static image compression in the past three years is detailed and analyzed, which is divided into three technical fields: image steganography, high fidelity image processing, and optimization of image processing performance. Finally, the challenges in each field are proposed as well. Some potential future research work is advised.

articleTitle: Task allocation for inspection drone of power transmission lines based on improved NSGA-II
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
