abstract: During the research on unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) power inspection process, the problem of UAV task allocation was studied, and multi-objective optimization was performed: minimizing the sum of UAV total path lengths and minimizing the longest working time of UAVs. This problem was formulated as the multiobjective multiple traveling salesperson problem (MOMTSP), and a hybrid integer programming multiobjective optimization scheduling model was constructed. To solve this problem, an improved non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm (AE-NSGA-II) was proposed, which can adaptively adjust the crossover and mutation rates and enhance the exploration to find more optimal solutions in both objective function directions. In the experiments, this algorithm was utilized to find a set of optimal solutions on the Pareto front.

articleTitle: Automatic feature extraction model of power iot terminal
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The feature extraction technology of Internet of Things terminal is the focus of current research. In this paper, an automatic feature extraction method of power Internet of Things terminal is proposed, which includes: identifying the flow information of power Internet of Things terminal; Set feature classification rules to classify and label device feature information into shallow feature and deep feature. The shallow feature of the device is extracted from the edge node, and the deep feature of the device is extracted from the cloud. Analyze the abnormal characteristics of each label, analyze the correlation degree of extracted features, and screen out the feature values with high correlation degree; Construct multi-mode feature extraction model; The feature extraction model of multiple patterns is constructed by combining workflow automation orchestration. Based on packet resolution, traffic uploaded by devices is detected and classified. Based on actual service conditions, different feature information is extracted on edge terminals and the cloud cloud as required, and the feature extraction process is automated to improve computing efficiency, reduce network delay, and reduce cloud computing and storage costs.

articleTitle: Detecting Adverse Drug Reactions through Drug Common Sense Reasoning and Dual-channel Contrastive Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Adverse drug reactions (ADR) refer to harmful reactions that occur after patients take drugs under normal dosage and usage. Timely detection of potential adverse drug reactions can effectively reduce its negative impact on patients. The exponential growth of biomedical literature and the rapid development of social media have effectively promoted the development of natural language processing technology in the field of adverse drug reaction detection. The current mainstream approach is to use the pre-trained language model BERT for detection, but it lacks professional information about the biomedical field. At the same time, the vector generated by model does not have the ability to represent semantic relevance and is easily deceived by noise in social media. In this paper, we propose a Contrastive and Drug Commonsense-enriched ADR Detector (CDC-ADROR). An external knowledge module is added to the model, and the drug-related keywords in each sample are obtained from GPT-4 by using prompt learning, effectively solving the problem of BERT’s lack of professional information. Meanwhile, contrastive learning is introduced to improve the loss function of the model, improving the quality of sentence representation vectors. Extensive experiments are carried out to evaluate the proposed framework on two datasets CADEC and Twitter.

articleTitle: A Survey for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles in Smart Agriculture: Types and Modelling Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Despite its major role in economic growth and development, the agriculture sector is facing many challenges globally. More significant problems have been continuously induced over the years, such as desertification, lack of infrastructure over vast agriculture areas, environmental pollution, excessive use of pesticides, lack of water resources, land fertility decline, and many more. As a solution, the idea of smart agriculture started pervading the world with the ability of transforming traditional farming sector to modern automated one for better crop field management. This can be done by using the technology of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) where diverse agriculture sensors are located on the ground to measure different crop field parameters. However, as the number of sensor nodes increases as the difficulty in managing the system network increases. Consequently, common limitations are to be considered such as energy management, communication interruption, bad connectivity, and difficulties in nodes localization. Therefore, the idea of using Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) along with WSN in smart agriculture becomes cruicial to improve the system capabilities. UAVs can help locate and identify sensors on the ground, ensure a correct delivery of data, and assist in every stage of the crop field cycle. With its ability to provide better solution for crop fields management, UAV grabbed researchers’ attention and encouraged them to deeply study this area and try to develop innovative UAV-WSN based applications that can be integrated with the agriculture sector. Hence, it is important to study UAV in all its aspects as it becomes the heart of the smart agriculture system. This article focuses particularly on UAV’s type and mathematical model selection. Therefore, to understand UAV’s functionality, this paper surveys different mathematical modelling techniques to derive the UAV plant, examines parameters identification methods to numerically evaluate the model, and discusses existing UAV open-source simulators to verify the ability of the selected model in realistic scenarios. Furthermore, key challenges and future research directions are presented to continuously improve the WSN-UAV based applications in smart agriculture.

articleTitle: Evacuation method for multi-agent based on deep reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a MIXPPO (Mixed Proximal Policy Optimization) method based on deep reinforcement learning to address the evacuation task of multiple agents in a dynamic environment. In this work, we integrating four modules: observation data normalization, advantage function normalization, learning rate decay and orthogonalization of the weight matrix for the policy network to improve the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm. These improvements enable the model to generate safe and effective evacuation strategies. The experiments indicate that in simulated scenarios, our approach can effectively guide multiple agents to move towards exits while avoiding collisions with each other, offering a novel solution to the multi-agent evacuation problem.

articleTitle: Cloud platform protocol data graph structure modeling method based on spectral clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Graph Convolutional Neural Network (GCN) used for protocol recognition has a high dependence on the input graph structure. Due to changes in proprietary protocols by manufacturers, it is difficult to establish an effective graph structure using traditional graph composition methods. To solve this problem, a graph structure construction method based on spectral clustering is proposed. Improve the similarity matrix of spectral clustering and choose Bray-Curtis distance to calculate similarity, use subspace learning and attribute selection to eliminate the influence of data redundant information, and use hypergraph to construct graph structure. At the same time, the hypergraph Laplacian matrix is used to constrain the spectral representation, and a graph structure model applied to GCN is established. Using protocol data in an industrial environment, the proposed spectral clustering algorithm is compared with other clustering algorithms. The experiments show that the improved composition method is accurate and efficient in high-dimensional data composition, and the new spectral clustering method reduces the result deviation.

articleTitle: Motion Control of Quadruped Robot Based on Improved CPG Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This topic studies the gait control and attitude control of a quadruped robot during flat slope movement. It studies its motion control strategies and methods from the aspects of model construction, gait analysis, and control of the quadruped robot, and conducts simulations. and physical verification to achieve smooth movement of the quadruped robot on a combination of flat and slope ground. First, the generation method of animal rhythmic gait and the mechanism of central pattern generator were studied. The Hopf oscillator was chosen to generate the locomotion gait of the quadruped robot. In addition, four Hopf oscillators are coupled to construct a CPG network, thereby realizing motion gait planning based on CPG network control. Simulation experiments were conducted on the CPG gait control algorithm and slope stability control algorithm. Then, the entire quadruped robot hardware system was built based on the physical platform of SoC FPGA, and the simulation content was experimentally verified. Through the analysis of experimental results, the feasibility of the above motion control method is verified.

articleTitle: Sequence recommendation algorithm based on cross domain user preference migration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Data sparsity is a problem faced by most recommendation systems. Sequence recommendation is a recommendation method to predict user preferences based on user behavior sequence. There is also the problem of data sparsity. User behavior sequences are scattered in different fields, and user interests are related in different fields. User behavior sequence data in some fields are very sparse, and user behavior sequence data in some fields are relatively dense. From a single domain, when the user behavior sequence data is sparse, the user preference model can not be accurately constructed based on the user behavior sequence. In order to solve this problem, starting from the relevance of domain user interests, this paper migrates the user preference information of related domains to build the user preference model of the target domain, and proposes a sequence recommendation method based on cross domain user preference migration. Firstly, this paper studies the feasibility of knowledge map guiding preference migration, constructs cross domain knowledge map according to the connection relationship between items in different fields, and embeds the relationship path between items into item representation, so that the relationship path can guide user preference migration between different fields. Then, the domain preference distribution and general preference distribution are established. The MMD distance is used to align the general preference distribution, and the anti transfer learning is used to align the domain preference distribution and general preference distribution. According to the user’s general preference distribution in the source domain, the user’s preference model in the target domain is constructed. Finally, experiments verify the effectiveness and correctness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Study on Improvement of Receiving Grid DC transmission feeding location Selection Method Using Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Multiple DC transmission feeding in receiving power grid brings huge risk to the stable operation of the power grid. It is of great significance to plan the DC feeding point economically and reasonably under the premise of ensuring the stable operation of the receiving end power grid. The article first calculates the multi-infeed interaction influence factor of the AC/DC receiving end system, divides the receiving end power grid into various regions, and then uses the principal component analysis method to calculate the characteristic root of the MIIF matrix, determines the corresponding characteristic vector with the largest characteristic root, and analyzes the nodes The voltage is disturbed by the voltage changes of other nodes, and the best DC feeding point in each region is selected to determine the optimal DC feeding point plan of the receiving end power grid. The calculation of the feeding point is selected through the traditional method and only the cluster analysis. The comparison of examples shows that the principal component analysis method can quickly and concisely determine the DC feeding point of the complex receiving end power grid.

articleTitle: Optimal Radio Labeling for the Cartesian Product of Star and Even Circle
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The graph itself can represent the topology of the network, so in the research of wireless communication network technology, graphs are often used to model the channel allocation of wireless communication networks. The distance between vertices of the graph is used to analyze the strength of channel interference between sites. In order to avoid interference and achieve interference interference-free communication, it is necessary to allocate channels reasonably in wireless communication. Radio labeling is a variant of the channel allocation problem, which transforms the channel allocation problem into a labeling problem of the graph. In this paper, by studying the Cartesian product topology of a star and an even cycle, we obtained the upper and lower bounds of their radio labeling.

articleTitle: Top-k Query Algorithm on Massive Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In many fields of big data applications, the volume of data has hit a record high and continues to grow exponentially. In decision support applications, one of the challenging issues is to retrieve the most important answers which end-users are interested in from massive data given user-specified preference queries. If users are unsatisfied with the returned results, Why questions may be raised to filter out unwanted objects from the result list. In Top-k queries, it is not easy to specify preferences explicitly. In this context, Why questions are often asked when the unsatisfying query results are retrieved. To deal with the Why questions, a sample-based BTW approach is proposed. By adjusting either the weights of preferences, the k value or both these parameters, this approach can get a new query at a lower cost and thus exclude Why tuples results. However, the BTW approach requires to perform Top-k query processing on each object in the dataset. It results in high time complexity as the number of data increases. To improve the efficiency of the BTW approach, an improved BTW approach is proposed by leveraging two optimization techniques that integrate appropriate pruning strategies. To verify the effectiveness of the solution, a variety of cases are analyzed. Experimental studies using real and synthetic datasets are also conducted to examine the effectiveness and efficiency of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Survey of Deep Learning Applications in WiFi Localization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Thanks to the extensive coverage of WiFi and the wide application of smart devices in recent years, WiFi-based positioning systems have gained more and more attention. Recently, deep learning, which is popular in the field of machine learning, has also been applied to the field of WiFi positioning to a certain extent in order to obtain better positioning performance. This paper summarizes the technologies and methods in WiFi positioning systems, introduces the application of deep learning in WiFi positioning by taking WiFi fingerprint technology as the main body, and introduces the development status and challenges of WiFi positioning technology.

articleTitle: Transformer Hybrid Neural Network Model for Natural Language Reasoning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Inference reasoning is a core task in natural language processing, and textual entailment inference is a particularly challenging task. In order to explore textual entailment inference, this paper proposes an enhanced hybrid neural network model based on the Transformer architecture. The Transformer encodes the premises and hypotheses by introducing positional information, obtaining contextual representations. By adding positional information to the premise and hypothesis texts, the model can better capture the sequential relationships in the sequences. Next, we calculate attention scores between the premises and hypotheses, allowing the model to focus more on important information between them, thereby enhancing the model’s inference ability for their meaning or inferential relationship. We evaluated the model on the Stanford Natural Language Inference (SNLI) dataset [1] and achieved an accuracy of 88.9%, surpassing previous research achievements. This indicates that our model has great potential in the task of textual entailment inference.

articleTitle: Spatially-Adaptive Instance Normalization for Generation of More Style-Recognizable Motions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Motion style transfer is a common method for generating expressive computer animation, but the motions generated by existing methods lack semantic recognition. This paper proposes a framework that generates more natural and style-recognizable motions. It utilizes a normalization layer named SP-AIN to integrate style and content features. This module generates two parameters for adaptive learning by twice convolving the style features. It retains more style features when generating new motions and improves the efficiency of style transmission. Additionally, to enhance the recognition of style features, we incorporate triplet loss as an optimization item during network training. Through a large number of examples compared with prior work, we demonstrate that our framework possesses good universality and accuracy in the task of style transfer, as well as the ability to generate high-quality stylized motions.

articleTitle: Research on Lightweight Voiceprint Recognition Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The development of lightweight voiceprint recognition models is aimed at addressing challenges encountered when deploying voiceprint recognition systems on resource-constrained devices. Despite the impressive performance of complex neural network models in certain tasks, they often require substantial storage space and computational resources, making them difficult to run on lightweight devices. Research on lightweight voiceprint recognition models primarily focuses on reducing the model’s size and computational requirements to accommodate the limited storage space and computational resources of mobile devices and embedded systems. This contributes to the more widespread deployment of voiceprint recognition technology in practical applications, enhancing its practicality. This article, based on depthwise separable convolution, designs a lightweight neural network that effectively reduces the complexity of the model.

articleTitle: Sensorless Control of Synchronous Reluctance Motor Based on High Frequency Signal Injection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the nonlinear characteristics of synchronous reluctance motor (SynRM) caused by electromagnetic saturation and cross coupling of stator inductance, a sensorless control method combining recursive least square method and pulsating high frequency current injection was proposed. The principle is to inject high frequency sinusoidal current signals with fixed amplitude into the direct axis of synchronous reluctance motor observation coordinate system, and extract voltage signals containing rotor position information from the quadrature axis. The recursive least square method with forgetting factor is used to realize the online identification of the motor resistance and inductance parameters. The sensorless control of motor is realized by proper signal processing method. In this paper, theoretical analysis, software simulation and prototype experiments are carried out to verify the accuracy and practicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Anti-UAV Detection Method Based on Local-Global Feature Focusing Module
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: When applied to the task of small UAV target detection on visual images, YOLOv5 algorithm suffered false positive and false negative a lot. An improved method based on YOLOv5 is proposed to deal with this situation. A Local-Global Feature Focusing Module is designed at the input of the backbone network. By increasing the context between local features and global features in the shallow layer, strengthened feature representation ability, and improved the detection effect of the drone target. Experiments on the test set show that compared with the method before the improvement, the proposed method’s precision is increased by 1.41% and recall is increased by 2.96%. At the same time of ensuring the real-time detection, the effect on UAV targets detection of the proposed method is significantly increased.

articleTitle: Design of ultrasonic propagation rule system in mud environment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This article is about the study of ultrasonic propagation under different densities in mud environment. In recent years, with the rapid development of energy metering, ultrasonic is more and more widely used in this industry. In exploration, logging and other fields, there is a mud environment, ultrasonic wave needs to be carried out in the mud environment, there are many factors affecting the ultrasonic wave propagation in the mud and the mud parameters are very important for the ultrasonic wave propagation in the mine. This technology has great potential for engineering applications, can effectively save cost and time, and create greater profit space for engineering. This article conducts theoretical analysis on the attenuation characteristics of propagation in mud environments, uses MATLAB software to numerically simulate the attenuation characteristics, designs hardware systems, and builds experimental equipment platforms for verification, providing a foundation for theoretical research.

articleTitle: Surgical Tool Detection in Open Surgery Based on Faster R-CNN, YOLO v5 and YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: High-precision tool detection can provide rich tool movement information for automated surgical video analysis, so tool detection based on surgical video is of vital significance for understanding surgical scenes. Previous studies on surgical tool detection mainly focused on endoscopic surgery. However, surgical instruments in open surgical video have more difficulties to detect because of the occlusion between instruments. In this paper, we introduce a new simulated open surgery dataset called AEDCSSAD, which includes bowel anastomosis, hepatic rupture repair and closure the abdomen surgeries. Pre-trained Faster R-CNN and different versions of YOLOv5 and YOLOv8 were used and fine-tuned on our dataset respectively, among which YOLOv8x achieved the best results on the dataset, with the mAP up to 94.2%.

articleTitle: ISMOTE Oversampling Algorithm For Imbalanced Data Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In recent years, the problem of imbalanced classification has been widely concerned. The SMOTE algorithm can expand the minority class samples and improve the classification ability of the minority class in the imbalanced data set, but there is a certain blindness in the selection of minority class sample points and the selection of random numbers. In this paper, the I-SMOTE algorithm (Improved Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique) is proposed. The algorithm gives the definition of noise and processes the noise. According to the distribution law of minority samples, minority samples can be synthesized more reasonably. The interpolation correlation coefficient is carefully divided when synthesizing samples. Four UCI unbalanced data sets were selected and three classical single classifier algorithms were used for experiments. The SMOTE algorithm and the ISMOTE algorithm were compared. The results showed that the classification results of the ISMOTE algorithm were improved in different degrees in F value, G-mean value and AUC value, which proved the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Network traffic prediction based on LST-GRU model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the increase of hidden layer, aiming at the problem of gradient disappearance or gradient explosion in the existing neural network model network, the invention proposes a network traffic prediction method based on LSTGRU(Long Short-Term Memory-Gated Recurrent Unit) model, firstly classifies the traffic data, and then uses GRU and LSTM network to extract and predict temporal spatial features. It is proved by experiments that the algorithm and model of the invention have the highest accuracy, the smallest prediction error, and the fastest network training to convergence speed.

articleTitle: Improve Performance of Dilated Convolutional: A Zero-Split-Merge Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Text-to-Speech (TTS) is a popular application in the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP). Convolutional 1D (Conv1D) is an essential operation in TTS models, accounting for a significant portion of their computation. Currently, the implementation of Dilated Conv1D in TensorFlow is inefficient due to redundant memory move operations. This paper proposes a Zero-Split-Merge (ZSM) solution to enhance the performance of Dilated Conv1D, and reduce the overall compute time of TTS models According to experiment results, up to 6.3x performance gain was seen by adopting the proposed ZSM solution.

articleTitle: Research on Fog Computing Task Scheduling Strategy with Deadline Constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The task scheduling problem in Fog Computing environments generally studies the scheduling strategy between tasks and computing resources, seeking a solution based on task scheduling execute time and performance optimization. There is little research on task scheduling strategies with deadline constraints. Based on the improved Apriori algorithm and utilizing the obtained task scheduling classification rules, this paper designs and proposes a task scheduling model and DLCM algorithm that meet time constraints in Fog Computing environment. The DLCM algorithm was validated through simulation experiments, and compared to similar algorithms, the algorithm showed significant improvements in task execution time and scheduling costs.

articleTitle: Fusion-CAM: Fine-Grained and High-Faithfulness Explanations for Deep Convolutional Network via Hierarchical Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The interpretability of the convolutional neural networks(CNNs) has become a research hotspot. A popular explanation method is based on Class Activation Mapping (CAM), which visualizes the salient regions most relevant to neural network decisions. However, many CAM methods use the feature maps produced by the final convolution layer to generate the class activation maps, which usually have a low spatial resolution and can only generate coarse-grained visual explanations that provide a rough spatial location of the target object. In this paper, we propose a novel CAM method named Fusion-CAM. It improves traditional CAM methods by combining final class activation map containing semantic information with intermediate layer class activation maps containing fine-grained details, to generate fine-grained visual explanations with high faithfulness. In order to obtain high-quality intermediate layer class activation maps, we utilize Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) to obtain the weighting components of each channel of the intermediate layer feature maps, and the intermediate layer class activation maps generated by weighted summation are less noisy and have clear fine-grained details, which help to improve the quality of the final class activation map. Qualitative and quantitative experiments show that Fusion-CAM can be easily attached to different CAM methods to improve their performance.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Power Forecasting Model based on Random Forest and BiLSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Due to the strong randomness and volatility of the photovoltaic power generation process, it is difficult to accurately and effectively predict power. In response to this issue, This paper presents a photovoltaic power prediction model based on random forest (RF) and bidirectional long short term memory (BiLSTM) neural network. Firstly, fuzzy C-means (FCM) clustering is used to obtain similar day data under different meteorological conditions. Then, the random forest model is trained using the photovoltaic power feature information data of similar days to be predicted. By comparing the importance evaluation indicators of feature information, the optimal set of input feature information is obtained, and the historical data of this set is input into the BiLSTM neural network model to obtain the photovoltaic power of the predicted period. Finally, the model proposed in this paper was used for photovoltaic power prediction in different meteorological environments, and compared with several commonly used algorithms to verify the effectiveness and accuracy of the method.

articleTitle: Verifications of Simulation based Reconfiguration Methods for Industrial 5G Wireless Channel
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: this paper focuses on the application field of 5G industry, analyzes and extracts the electromagnetic environment of 5G frequency band in industrial scenarios, and achieves laboratory restoration through integration with channel simulators, which is applied to the testing and verification process of 5G terminals in the industry. This paper focuses on the method validation of terminal and network equipment testing technology for loading electromagnetic interference in the 5G frequency band of industrial scenarios. Key parameters of factory environment and interference are extracted through simulation calculation, and integrated with the 5G testing system to achieve a fusion method of simulation calculation and channel modeling. The accuracy of the fusion method was verified by comparing it with actual on-site test data. Based on the research results of this project, it is possible to restore the industrial site environment in the laboratory, which can be used for 5G terminals in the industry. This can effectively improve the extraction efficiency of the industrial site environment and enhance the flexibility of testing configuration, which has a positive significance for forming distinctive testing capabilities in the 5G application field.

articleTitle: Design of Intermediate Frequency Signal Synchronization Acquisition in Satellite-Borne Synthetic Aperture Microwave Radiometer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The satellite-borne synthetic aperture microwave radiometer utilizes multiple antenna pairs to form baselines for detecting the brightness temperature signal of the target. Compared to traditional real aperture microwave radiometers, it has the characteristic of higher resolution. However, the phase difference between multiple antenna channels is one of the crucial factors affecting the accuracy of brightness temperature numerical inversion. To reduce the phase difference between the multiple channels of intermediate frequency signals, firstly, the principle of intermediate frequency signal acquisition in the synthetic aperture was analyzed, highlighting the impact of phase difference on inversion accuracy. Secondly, a synchronization method for the sampling clock and data reception clock was designed to further enhance the stability and consistency of the phase difference. Finally, this design method was experimentally validated. The results demonstrate that the proposed method has a phase difference stability of less than 0.03°, a phase difference consistency of less than 5°, the effective number of bits for all six channels are greater than 10.4, and the isolation degree between different channels exceeds 80 dB. The research results indicate that the proposed method effectively enhances the reliability of intermediate frequency synchronization acquisition unit in the satellite-borne synthetic aperture microwave radiometer, laying a solid foundation for subsequent processing.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Composite Transmission and Substation System with Multi-State Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: When wind power is integrated into largescale power systems, the multiple-state characteristics of its output can have a significant impact on the safe and stable operation of the power system. A fault in the primary equipment of a substation can lead to a partial power outage at the plant and structural changes in the regional grid, increasing the risk of a regional blackout. This article proposes a state reduction method that takes into account the fitting errors of wind farm power characteristics. The equivalent combined system of transformers and transmission lines is sampled using a two-level Monte Carlo sampling technique, and the system risk indicators are calculated using an AC power flow model. Finally, using the improved IEEE-RTS6 system as an example, the proposed method and model are analyzed and validated, showing the effectiveness of the wind farm multi-state model and the two-level Monte Carlo sampling method.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of High Reliable Local Communication for Multi-Business Access in Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the construction of new power systems, diversified power businesses have emerged with differentiated requirements on power communication technologies in aspects like bandwidth, direction, coverage, QoS and business security boundaries. Therefore, this paper conducts research on key technologies of highly reliable local communication for multi-business access in power systems, and designs a multi-modal intelligent fusion gateway that is compatible with various common communication protocols and dedicated power communication protocols. It verifies the performance and availability of the multi-modal intelligent gateway and its software system, effectively reducing the construction cost and network maintenance difficulty of terminal communication access networks and improving network adaptability.

articleTitle: Research of Image Arbitrary Style Transfer based on Contrastive Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the practical applications of image style transfer techniques in fields such as image editing and creative design, arbitrary style transfer has become an increasingly hot research area in computer vision. Addressing the challenges in existing arbitrary style transfer models, namely how to maintain consistency in preserving the semantic content and structural information of images during style transfer, while transferring more style features, this study incorporates the idea of contrastive learning into the model training process. By continuously optimizing the content similarity of generated images through contrastive learning loss, the effectiveness of arbitrary style transfer is ensured. Experimental results demonstrate that the generated images of the arbitrary style transfer model designed in this study exhibit superior performance in both preserving content structures and transferring style features compared to existing algorithmic models.

articleTitle: A 5.27nW/kHz Low Power Relaxation Oscillator with Current Consumption Reduction Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that high power consumption in traditional relaxation oscillators, this paper presents a design of a low power relaxation oscillator. This relaxation oscillator achieves power consumption reduction by incorporating a logic-controlled switch on the voltage comparator, reducing the current supply during non-operational periods. Additionally, digital trimming is introduced to correct frequency deviations caused by process variations. Based on a 180-nm CMOS process, and the layout design and post-simulation are conducted using Cadence. The layout area is 0.034 $mm^{2}$. Simulation results show that operating at 1.2 V, achieves an oscillation frequency of 25 kHz with a power consumption of 5.27 nW/kHz. With the temperature range from -60 to 110°C, the temperature coefficient of the oscillation frequency is 235.3 ppm/°C. With the supply voltage range from 1 to 3 V, the linear sensitivity of the oscillation frequency is 2%/V.

articleTitle: Application of SPMOA optimization algorithm in heliostat field parameter optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to achieve the goal of “carbon peak” and “carbon neutrality”, it is urgent to build a new power system with new energy as the main body. Tower solar thermal power generation is a new type of low-carbon and environmentally friendly clean energy technology. However, at present, the efficiency of solar power generation is affected by various factors, and it is always unable to store and transport power with maximum efficiency, among which the heliostat layout is the most influential, so how to optimize the heliostat field has become the biggest problem. To this end, we propose an innovative Stepwise Particle Movement Optimization Algorithm (SPMOA). Based on Monte Carlo Ray Tracing method, the field of circular helioscope is discussed in depth and the corresponding mathematical model is established. In the calculation process, we use the stepwise moving constraint exclusion particle optimization algorithm (SPMOA). The solution space is fully explored through particle movement simulation, velocity updating mechanism and randomness factor. The goal is to find a solution that maximizes the annual average thermal power output per mirror area while ensuring that the rated power is achieved. Finally, the position coordinates of the absorption tower, the size of each heliostat, the installation height, the position coordinates, and the maximum output thermal efficiency are obtained under the specified position.

Author Keywords: Step moving constraint repulsive particle optimization algorithm

articleTitle: Computing Resource Allocation Model Based on Local Device Power in MEC
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The mobile Internet has got a such great progress, the amount of network data has exploded, and the demand of users has also increased. How to solve the problem of energy consumption and time delay in mobile edge computing becomes the key to improve the quality of service. This paper studies how to complete the task assignment between user device and edge server with the minimum cost, where the minimum cost is a weighted function of energy consumption and time delay. This minimum cost can be effectively compared with different optimization algorithms. Firstly, this paper establishes a 0-1 integer programming model including energy consumption and time delay factors. Secondly, the branch and bound algorithm is used to find the optimal solution. Finally, the simulation results show that the optimization algorithm is flexible and can allocate computing resources scientifically to multiple users.The optimization model can not only automatically reduce the energy consumption and time delay of user terminal device, but also artificially selectively reduce the energy consumption and time delay of terminal device by introducing the parameter of residual power of terminal device. In this paper, the interference between lines in ultra-dense networks is taken into account, and a key parameter, the maximum calculation frequency without interference, is proposed to limit the maximum number of devices for offloading calculation in a cell. The above two methods are for the convenience of edge computing, which can be used in practice to improve the users’ experience.

articleTitle: Detection system of excess matter in hole of complex workpiece based on manipulator control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to effectively detect excess matter in the aperture of complex workpiece, this paper proposes a detection system of excess matter in the hole of complex workpiece based on the motion path planning algorithm of robot arm. The system modeled the motion parameters of the robot arm and used the inverse motion analysis method to calculate the motion angles of each joint of the robot arm, so as to achieve accurate control of the motion of the robot arm. Then, the coordinate position of the complex workpiece hole was calculated through the homogeneous matrix transformation, and the robot arm holding the endoscope was controlled to move to the corresponding position of each hole of the complex workpiece. Identify and detect burrs and residues in holes, and generate inspection reports. The test results show that the system is superior to the existing methods in terms of detection speed and accuracy, and has high detection accuracy and adaptability. It can be effectively applied in the actual production process, and provides a new technical means for the quality control of the manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: A Method of Zero Calibration for Large Mechanical Arm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The rocker arm type motion simulation support equipment can simulate the equivalent motion trajectory of the aircraft, which is essentially a large mechanical arm. Because it is diffcult to level the base through the conventional ten thousand method, and not leveling will bring erors to simulation accuracy of the contorl motion trajectory, futher measurement and calibration are required, This paper presents a calibration method for the zeor position measurement of the base of a large manipulator. In this method, a measuring instrusment intergrating a morth finder and a total station is used to measure the coordinates of the marked points on the base of the mainpulator.The center coordinates and the vertical and horizontal “angle” of the base are obtained through the spatial coordinate calculation.Finally,these effects are superimposed on the coordinate system that needs to be used in space, and the influence of the base tilt on the manipulator can be eliminated,This method solves the problem of diccicult leveling of large epuipment and improves the positioning accuracy of the system.

Author Keywords: Calibration Method for The Zeor Position Measurement

articleTitle: Research on Data-Driven Comprehensive Battery State-of-Health Evaluation Strategy for Roadside Energy Storage System in Electric Transportation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For roadside energy storage systems in electric transportation, assessing battery health status is crucial. This paper utilizes charging and discharging data samples from base stations and power stations under different operating conditions to present the variation of battery health status at different cycle counts. It also examines the current fluctuation and voltage changes of four batteries in the battery pack over a three-day working period. Relevant features of battery charging and discharging are extracted, and battery health status is analyzed through clustering using K-means++ and a comprehensive scoring model, resulting in four levels: excellent, good, fair, and poor. By comparing the two methods, it is found that the comprehensive scoring model performs better than Kmeans++. In summary, the research findings effectively reflect the battery’s charging and discharging capabilities, facilitating the assessment of energy storage level in charging facilities.

articleTitle: Research on Monocular Depth Estimation Method based on Multi-Level Attention and Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Monocular depth estimation is a fundamental task in computer vision and has drawn increasing attention. Recently, attention-based models and encoder-decoder architectures have led to great improvements in monocular depth estimation. Typically, most of the previous methods used repeated simple up-sampling operations during decoding, which may not make full use of the potential properties of the features extracted by the encoder, and there are problems of inaccurate prediction of the edge and depth maximum region. We propose an attention-based feature fusion module for encoder and decoder. We treat the monocular depth estimation as a pixel-level optimization problem, where the coarsest encoder feature is used to initialize the pixel-level optimization, which is then refined to higher resolution by the proposed attentional feature fusion (AFF). We formulate the prediction problem as ordinal regression over the bin centers that discretize the continuous depth range. It predicts a correspondingly different distribution of bins based on different pictures and we predict bins at the coarsest level using global pooling and MLP layers. In the NYUV2 dataset, the proposed architecture improving original model by 2.5.% and 1.1%, in terms of Log10 and Absolute relative error, respectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of High Frequency Transfer Impedance of Current Probe Based on Electromagnetic Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Transfer impedance is a core indicator of current monitoring probes, but due to the influence of the structure and material of the probe, the transfer impedance experiences resonance and drops at high frequency. This paper focuses on the impact of coil turns, magnetic core permeability, and the distance between the shielding shell and the coil on the transfer impedance of current probes. The above influencing factors were analyzed through simulation of the electromagnetic model of the current probe. The research indicates that when the magnetic permeability of the core is high, the magnitude of the permeability has no significant effect on the resonance of the transfer impedance; The more turns of the winding and the closer the distance between the shielding shell and the coil, the lower the resonance frequency of the transfer impedance.

articleTitle: Federated Learning for ASR Based on FedEA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the advancement and refinement of federated learning, integrating federated learning with speech recognition has spawned innovative ideas and approaches for training speech recognition models. This study presents a novel federated aggregation method, Federated Error Average(FedEA), which fuses federated learning with wav2vec2.0, a renowned self-supervised pre-trained speech recognition model. It features a redesign to enable the aggregation model to address scenarios where malicious users introduce substantial interference data effectively. Experimental assessments were conducted using the 178-hour professional recording Aishell dataset. The results of these experiments demonstrate that an error rate as low as 10.84% can be achieved on the Aishell dataset, even in the absence of malicious user interference and the necessity for a language model. Moreover, when a substantial number of malicious users are introduced to disrupt the data, the innovative FedEA aggregation method can allocate smaller weights to ensure robust convergence and recognition performance of the aggregation model. Remarkably, the experimental outcomes surpass existing mainstream aggregation methods.

articleTitle: Cup and Disc Segmentation Algorithm Based on Improved Swin-UNet Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Glaucoma is a common eye disease with a high incidence and high rate of blindness, emphasizing the importance of early diagnosis. This paper proposes the combination of the Swin Transformer and U-Net++ network, along with the introduction of the acmix module. The entire network structure retains the advantages of convolutional neural networks while incorporating the currently mainstream self-attention mechanism, thereby improving segmentation accuracy. The paper first preprocesses the dataset and then uses a combined focal loss and IoU loss function for deep supervised learning of the model. The proposed network architecture achieved high accuracy in the DRISHTI-GS, RIM-ONE-r3, and REFUGE datasets. The combined network architecture of this paper, integrating self-attention with convolution, demonstrates high segmentation accuracy, holding significant medical value for early glaucoma screening.

articleTitle: Vertical and Horizontal Network for Small Object Detection in Sports Videos
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Detecting small objects is often impeded by blurriness and low resolution, which poses substantial challenges for accurately detecting and localizing such objects. Balls and players in sports competition videos are small objects more difficult to detect because of motion blur. Balls and players in sports game videos are small objects that are more difficult to detect due to motion blur. To tackle this challenge, we propose a small object detection backbone network named VHNet based on vertical and horizontal information flow in sports scenarios. In order to verify the effectiveness of our backbone network, we manually annotated a small ball detection data set and conducted comparative experiments with the SOTA small object detection method. The results demonstrate the superiority of our method in sports video detection tasks.

articleTitle: Chinese Named Entity Recognition Based on BERT and Grouped-query Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Named entity recognition (NER) is an important task in Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Chinese NER is more difficult than English NER. Currently, machine learning and deep learning methods have been widely used in NER research. Traditional NER methods often ignore long-distance syntactic dependencies between words, and word preprocessing of such models usually ignores the contextual semantic information of the target word and fails to realize its polysemy. To address these shortcomings, this paper proposes a BERT-BiLSTM-GQA-CRF model for Chinese NER. BERT preprocessing language model generates word vectors representing contextual semantic information, inputs the sequence of trained word vectors into the BiLSTM layer embedded with Grouped-query attention (GQA) to obtain the overall semantic information, and finally decodes the sequence of entity tokens through the CRF layer. Compared to Multi-head attention (MHA), Multi-query attention (MQA) uses only a single key-value head, which can greatly speed up decoder inference. However, MQA leads to quality degradation, so in this paper, we use GQA to make the model more accurate than MHA with a speed comparable to MQA. Experimental results on the Weibo corpus and MSRA corpus show that the improved model improves both recognition effectiveness and speed.

articleTitle: Edge Computing-enabled Network Architecture Design for Space-Air-Ground Integrated Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The space-air-ground integrated network (SAGIN) has become important research content for the next generation of 6G communication networks. Considering the difficulties in network resource management, complex network service configuration, network collaboration and security sharing pressure in network construction. A novel edge computing-enabled network architecture is proposed. On this basis, key technologies such as software defined network (SDN), network slicing and blockchain are used to solve the difficulties in network system construction. Then, the proposed architecture is designed and described in detail. Furthermore, the key technical challenges in the practical application and implementation of the proposed architecture are further explored, providing a fundamental reference for further in-depth research. Finally, simulation experiments verify that the proposed architecture achieves significant improvements in terminal devices’ task processing energy consumption and latency compared to network architecture with other studies.

articleTitle: High-Precision Data Recovery for Bubble Charts
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Bubble chart is an efficient data visualization tool with wide applications in sociology, economics, medicine, and other fields. Accurate information such as bubble radius and position is crucial for representing and processing raw data. However, in some bubble charts, certain bubbles may be obscured, making it impossible to obtain specific parameter information for the bubbles and thus hindering data analysis. To address this issue, this paper proposes a universal algorithm framework that integrates core steps such as coordinate system mapping, layer separation, connected component extraction, edge extraction, duplicate edge elimination, and Hough transform. Simulation indicates that with a small proportion of exposed edges, the proposed algorithm can accurately extract radius and position information.

articleTitle: Real-time data processing method for the feedback control system of the error field of the Keda Torus eXperiment around the gap
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This article describes the feedback control system of the error field in a reversed field pinch (RFP) device KTX. The system includes an electromagnetic probes(EMP) array, a real-time control system based on a field-programmable gate array (FPGA), a digital power amplifier (DPA) array as the actuator, and a feedback control coil. It takes full advantage of FPGA to fulfill a highspeed, real-time feedback control requirement. Zero drift elimination and real-time PID on FPGA make real-time feedback control possible. It successfully achieved the mission of error field control and made the magnetic field density drop more than 90 percent.

articleTitle: Stability of Stochastic Dynamic Systems and Application to Supply Chain Finance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, the mean-square asymptotic stability of a class of stochastic dynamical systems is investigated using the fixed point method, and the conclusions obtained are applied to the study of the stability of the evolutionary game between financial institutions and small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in the supply chain finance credit market. The article expands the field of stochastic dynamical systems application and innovatively adopts the immobile point method to study the stability of stochastic evolutionary game models.

articleTitle: A Few-Shot Semantic Segmentation Network with Mixed Prototypes and Base Learner
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Few-shot semantic segmentation methods aim to segment new object categories with limited labeled samples. Existing approaches struggle to extract comprehensive semantic matching information from target regions and mitigate noise from complex backgrounds. To address background noise, this paper proposes a novel few-shot semantic segmentation approach using prototype generation and base class learning. A pyramid pooling convolutional layer extracts rich prototype vectors by discerning differences between the core mask and label mask. Additionally, a base class learning module captures semantic information from base class objects during training, effectively suppressing interference from background regions and aiding in background semantic matching. Comparative and ablation experiments demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed model. Evaluation on benchmark datasets shows its effectiveness, with results on Pascal-5i dataset surpassing the baseline model, achieving an average intersection over union of 67.15% in one-shot scenarios.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Intelligent Lifting Inspection Robot for Indoor Substation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In response to the problem of limited indoor space and varying heights of power equipment and incomplete inspection, an indoor intelligent lifting inspection robot is designed. A lightweight differential motion chassis is adopted in robot and it has the ability to turn in situ; the ROS node method is used to integrate various data of the robot body into the ROS robot operating system; the Lidar is used to achieve intelligent positioning and navigation; the lifting rod which carries detection components maximize the detection range of the equipment. After practical application, the robot has high lifting stroke and flexibility, and the inspection process has high reliability and safety.

articleTitle: Optimization of Coordinate Control of Industrial Robot Manipulator for Virus Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The detection of infectious viruses using the mechanical arm of an industrial robot can face challenges such as bending and deviations between the detection position and the actual position. This paper introduces a novel approach to improve the control accuracy of the robot arm’s end by utilizing an auxiliary support device. Two models were developed: Model-1, representing the original robot, and Model-2, which incorporates the support device. Simulation results demonstrate that the support device effectively reduces the bending deformation of the robot arm under various working conditions, thereby enhancing operational accuracy. Model-2 exhibits an impressive 94.43% reduction in maximum displacement deviation compared to Model-1, along with a 41.22% decrease in maximum Mises stress. Furthermore, the proposed auxiliary support device is characterized by its simplicity, easy maintenance, and potential for reducing operational and maintenance costs in similar industrial applications, making it highly marketable.

articleTitle: An Improved Method of Domain Ontology Concept Similarity Calculation based on Semantic Distance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Conceptual similarity calculation has important application value in the fields of natural language processing, information retrieval, knowledge graph and so on. And how to improve the accuracy of conceptual similarity calculation is an important research topic nowadays. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved domain ontology concept similarity calculation method based on semantic distance. This method improves the traditional conceptual similarity calculation method based on semantic distance with three aspects: node distance, semantic coincidence degree, attribute and instance coincidence degree. Experiments on the constructed plant domain ontology were carried out to verify the effect of the proposed method. And the results showed that the maximum semantic similarity value of proposed method is sim (Convolvulaceae, Morning Glory)=0.9285, and the minimum semantic similarity value is sim (Seasonal Flowers, Lilies)=0.3571. The semantic similarity coverage of the proposed method is [0.3571, 0.9285], which was better than the traditional similarity method based on semantic distance. Thus, it is proved that our method has great application potential.

articleTitle: Research on Constructing Course Ideology and Politics Teaching Quality Evaluation System Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Starting from the current situation of teaching quality evaluation in course ideology and politics, this thesis expounds the methods and algorithms of teaching evaluation, and constructs a teaching quality evaluation system for course ideology and politics. The structure diagram of the teaching quality evaluation system is designed, and the collection and integration methods of teaching evaluation big data and the quality evaluation process of the teaching quality evaluation system are proposed. The design and application of this system are of great significance for improving the professional teaching ability of teachers in course ideology and politics and enhancing teaching quality.

articleTitle: Virtual Power Plant Interactive communication simulation based on OPNET
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In recent years, distributed new energy represented by photovoltaic technology has been increasingly widely used, and the scale of grid connection is increasing. In response to the increasingly urgent demand for distributed photovoltaic interactive communication, this article analyzes the model of distributed photovoltaic interactive data flow, builds a distributed photovoltaic user interactive communication model based on OPNET software, and builds a small simulation network that includes photovoltaic users and aggregators, verifying the practicality of the model.

articleTitle: An Unmanned Boat Planning Path Algorithm for Multi Targets Verification Tasks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the process of executing static multi-objective verification tasks, unmanned boats need to plan routes to complete the verification tasks one by one. The whole work needs to balance verification efficiency and accuracy. This paper proposes multi-objective verification planning algorithm based on a heuristic TSP algorithm, which can quickly confirm the order of verification target points. At the same time, a hexagonal marking algorithm is proposed, which can plan path quickly. To confirm the effectiveness and feasibility, our team executes several simulation and implementation tests. The result of the test show that method proposed in this paper has high verification efficiency, high accuracy and less obstacle avoidance times.

articleTitle: Research on Point Cloud Data Preprocessing for Unmanned LiDAR
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the continuous progress of random social technology and economy, autonomous driving technology has become a key direction for the development of modern automotive industry. The environmental perception system, as an important component of autonomous driving technology, directly determines the safety, stability, and comfort of autonomous vehicles. As an active imaging system, LiDAR has the advantages of high accuracy in obtaining clustering information, being less susceptible to external environmental interference, and not limited by light intensity compared to passive imaging systems. In order to enable the vehicle mounted LiDAR to better achieve environmental perception, it is necessary to preprocess point cloud data. This article mainly studies three key steps in the preprocessing process, including point cloud filtering denoising, downsampling, and ground point cloud segmentation, and verifies the algorithm for the above preprocessing methods. The research in this paper provides technical support for autonomous driving to achieve environmental awareness.

articleTitle: A Simulation Model for Temperature Field of 10kV Cable Joint Based on Multi medium Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Under the action of instantaneous short-circuit impulse current, the cable core will lead to short-term heat accumulation, which will cause the breakdown of the cable insulator and cause fire, and even cause explosion. Therefore, it is a key factor for cable fire warning and risk assessment to accurately obtain the temperature change of the inner conductor of the cable. This paper proposes a multi-medium fusion temperature field calculation model of 10kV cable conductor. Compared with the current common thermal circuit model and finite element simulation numerical calculation model, the temperature field calculation and simulation model proposed in this paper comprehensively considers the influence of multiple media such as load current, external environment, excessive short-term load and protective layer grounding current on the cable conductor temperature field. It has the advantages of wider constraint conditions and closer to the actual environment application. The effectiveness and reliability of the proposed model are verified by the experimental results of the given simulation model.

articleTitle: Collaborative development of Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area based on multi-source data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A good coordinated development model within the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area is conducive to achieving China’s high-quality deveoppment requirements. Using multi-source data such as financial service points of interest and nighttime light data, combined with kernel density method and collaborative development gravity model, this paper comprehensively analyzes the financial and scientific innovation strength as well as the production and life of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and draws the following conclusions: First, The financial density centers of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area are generally distributed in the places with high social level. From 2018 to 2021, the financial density centers of the Bay Area are concentrated in the west of Guangzhou, the south of Hong Kong, the south of Shenzhen, the east of Foshan and the junction of Zhuhai and Macao. Second, The coordinated development of the Bay Area mainly relies on the connect-ion between Shenzhen, Dongguan, Guangzhou and Foshan. Third, Combined with the gravity model of collaborative development, three urban subgroups are formed: Foshan-Guangzhou-Zhaoqing, Hong Kong-Shenzhen-Dongguan-Huizhou and Macao-Zhuhai-Zhongshan-Jiangmen. The maximum circulation of resources is achieved within the subgroups.

articleTitle: Use the MBSE method to design the thrust adjust function of Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to take advantage of the digital transformation to support the aerospace system engineering development, this paper analyzes the whole life cycle development process of the vehicle under the traditional development model, and based on that, introduce a new development model called Electrical System Integration that can concurrent design by integrating information sharing and activity synchronization which is not only inherits the traditional system engineering development experience but also have optimizes the system design. With the help of The Model based Systems Engineering method can make the model and data are applied to the whole life cycle development of products, to realize the model definition system, data-driven process, knowledge and quality assurance. Finally, make an example on the process of design scheme come out and decision-making for the system function of power supply and distribution.

articleTitle: Research on Aviation Safety Prediction Based on Multivariate Grey Model Optimized by Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Considered that the causal mechanism of aviation accidents is complex and has many causal factors with strong grey characteristics, while the traditional grey prediction model is only applicable to single variable and has low accuracy, a new method of aviation safety prediction is proposed based on a multivariate grey model optimized by genetic algorithm. Firstly, the SHEL analysis model is used to determine the causes of aviation safety and and further screening for key causal factors. Secondly, a multivariate grey $\operatorname{MGM}(1, n, \mathrm{GA}(r))$ aviation safety prediction model is constructed by taking human factors, environmental factors, equipment and facilities factors, external influencing factors, and forced reporting events as the research objects, and genetic algorithm is used to search the optimal solution of grey model parameters. Finally, the simulation example shows that the proposed method is more applicable and has higher prediction accuracy and advantages in aviation safety short time prediction than the traditional grey model.

articleTitle: Research on Network Security Event Correlation Analysis Method Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the increasing development of big data technology, it is possible to identify various attacks and threats by correlating various network security events and related system information. Network security event correlation analysis technology has also emerged. This article first elaborates on the goal and significance of network security event correlation analysis technology, as well as the problems existing in existing network security event correlation analysis technology; Then, a network security knowledge graph was designed, which defines entity attributes from four dimensions: assets, topology, vulnerabilities, and alarms. Finally, based on the network security knowledge graph, a network security event correlation analysis method is proposed, and examples are given to illustrate that this method can accurately identify real alarms from multi-source network security alarm information.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Transparent Processing Technology in High-throughput Communication Satellites
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of satellite communication technology, the traditional communication satellites can only provide fixed service transponders, but cannot meet the application needs of the new generation of satellite communication. While increasing the capacity of the system, the new generation of communication satellites needs to improve the flexibility of the system. It has become a development trend to use the digital flexible payloads such as Digital Transparent Processor (DTP) to provide sufficient flexibility for the satellite communication system. In this paper, a DTP link scheme applied to Ku-band multibeam payload is designed. In addition, the functions, interfaces and components of a typical digital transparent processor are illustrated, and the key heat dissipation design of the product in the design process of communication satellite system is expounded. On this basis, the correctness of the DTP link design of the single machine and the whole satellite is verified through the satellite-ground joint test and the whole satellite test.

articleTitle: Design of ACO variable structure controller for brushless direct current motor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: PID (Proportional Integral Derivative) control algorithm is often used to control the speed and position of brushless direct current motors. In this paper, according to the basic structure and operation principle of brushless direct current motor, a double closed-loop mathematical model with the internal loop current hysteresis and the speed outer loop of brushless direct current motor is established. ACO (Ant Colony Optimization) algorithm is introduced into PID control. Using the variable structure of ACO algorithm, the PID parameters in the double closed-loop model of brushless direct current motor are optimized. Finally, the simulation results show that this method has obvious advantages over the traditional PID control in terms of precision and stability, and effectively improves the performance of the brushless direct current motor under the disturbance load.

articleTitle: RPA Performance Continuous Optimization Based on PDCA Cycle
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: RPA is the completion of Robotic Process Automation. By simulating human behavior, it performs mouse and keyboard operations in the human-computer interaction interface of the software and automatically completes fixed business operations according to the predesigned workflow, which is widely applicable to business scenarios with high repeatability, strong complexity, and clear processes. The typical application scenarios of RPA were analyzed for engineering requirements. According to the characteristics of RPA technology, an RPA performance evaluation method is designed, and an RPA performance continuous optimization scheme based on the PDCA cycle is proposed. It provides a reference for RPA to further improve efficiency, reduce cost, and reduce error in engineering applications.

articleTitle: A Novel Encoding Deep Learning Algorithm of Radio Signal Understanding
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the social development, more and more new electronic equipment are used and there are more complicated radio signals around us. For the electromagnetic security, it is necessary to understand the radio signal and find the potential risk or abnormal behavior. With deep learning methods are used in many practical products, especially in compute vision field. So, in this paper, the radio signal is encoded into the Gramian Angular Summation Fields (GASF) image by two phase encoding, then using the simple Convolutional Neural Network(CNN)method to process the radio signal. The method encodes the in-phase and the quadrature (IQ) components into GASF respectively. Then we use the combine Two Phase GASF (TPGASF)images to recognize the radio signal modulation through the CNN method. In this paper, experiment is set up with the radio signal modulation which is a typical scene of radio signal understanding. The experiment results show that the more accuracy is got through the TPGASF algorithm than other methods.

Author Keywords: two phase gramian angular summation field

articleTitle: A Secure Communication Protocol Based on Blockchain and MQTT for IOT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Data in the Internet of Things are confronted with security threats such as leakage, tampering, and malicious deletion. Blockchain has the advantages of decentralization and immutability, which can solve the above problems. The MQTT protocol is a lightweight and scalable communication protocol for the application layer of the Internet of Things. Different from the conventional MQTT protocol, this paper proposes a secure authentication MQTT protocol for IoT based on blockchain. It ensures the authenticity and credibility of device and user identities by realizing the decentralized design of MQTT with blockchain’s decentralized authentication mechanism.
