A smart contract is designed for trusted transactions and data sharing between devices, and a public key encryption algorithm is adopted to encrypt data transmitted between IoT devices. The proposed scheme is proved to achieve secure communication between IoT devices efficiently.

articleTitle: Design of Irregular Material Volume Measurement System Based on Laser Sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to grasp the quantity of raw material inventory in the industrial site warehouse in real time, the article presents an application study of a remote measurement system for rapid measurement of irregular material volume. The system is divided into a field acquisition side and a remote control side. The field acquisition side is composed of laser sensor, motor, controller, etc. to form an acquisition data device, which realizes the data acquisition in the warehouse according to the cycle scanning method; The remote control side uses Qt software development communication software (C/S mode) to remotely control the acquisition device, read the point cloud data matrix, and perform boundary processing, coordinate conversion, 3D reconstruction and volume calculation on the point cloud. The measurement system is used for joint testing and analysis under multiple working conditions, and the calculated volume results have good repeatability, low relative error and high accuracy, providing an effective solution for improving the efficiency of industrial site material inventory.

articleTitle: An Approximate Method for Throughput Design of Inhomogeneous Assembly Systems considering Production Loss
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To sustainably maintain the high competitions and prevent the cost, manufacturers usually pursue the accurate throughput design which helps avoid the production loss during the period of warming. Despite the extensive studies for throughput analysis of serial production systems, inhomogeneous assembly systems have received much less investigation. The purpose of this paper is to present an approximate method for the throughput design of inhomogeneous assembly systems without lacking any production loss during the period of warming. The method is proposed based on the ‘split-based’ model considering the component-level principles of inhomogeneous production, unreliable machines, and finite-capacity buffers. The model can be solved by using the fixed-point theory. Numerical studies demonstrate the high accuracy comparing with the simulation results. The dynamic model built in this research can also serve as an analytical tool for optimal design and management of assembly systems with complex layout.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Editing of Metro Passenger Service Information
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming to improve the quality of passenger information services in metro, an integrated editing method has been proposed to provide passengers with diversified information services. Firstly, abstract descriptions of passenger information display elements are designed to construct a component library for display layout editing. The visual editing of component layout, event correlation, and attribute extension is achieved through component drag and drop. Secondly, the models of playlist associated task, event triggered task, and attribute update task were defined to achieve programmable display logic control. Multiple task combinations based on the time series were set up according to the terminal display requirements. Finally, the editing results, including the components and their interrelationships, should be semantically described to get an arrangement protocol file that can be parsed by service terminals and achieve the broadcasting.

articleTitle: A kind of Optical Fiber Sensing Based Boundary Security Alarm System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: By utilizing technologies such as fiber optic sensing and optical communication, a boundary security alarm system is designed and built. The system consists of fiber optic sensors, linkage devices, signal processing host, switches, etc. It has characteristics such as multiple linkage alarms, low false alarm rates, precise positioning, strong environmental adaptability, cost-effectiveness, etc. It has ability of monitoring multiple defense areas flexibly and independently. Compared to traditional boundary security solutions, the designed boundary security alarm system offers enhanced reliability, stability, accuracy, environmental friendliness, and cost-effectiveness, which effectively improves boundary security capabilities of the target area.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Infrared Radiation of Aeroengine Nozzle
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The infrared radiation of aircraft is the main detection object of short-range air-to-air missile. The infrared radiation of aeroengine nozzle is the most important part of the infrared radiation of aircraft. The composition of aircraft infrared radiation is summarized and a theoretical model of a certain type of aeroengine infrared radiation is established based on the basic theory of infrared radiation. The infrared radiation characteristics under different view angles and flight states in $3 \mu$m $\sim 5 \mu$m and $8 \mu$m $\sim 14 \mu$m wavelength bands are analyzed through the simulation of the aeroengine nozzle infrared radiation. The simulation results prove the effectiveness of the theoretical model and also provide reference for the studying of infrared radiation characteristics of the type of aeroengine under different flight states.

articleTitle: Underwater Image Enhancement Based on Global Dual Gamma Correction Combined with WOA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Due to light absorption and scattering, underwater images often suffer from quality degradation problems such as color deviation, low contrast, and blurred details. To address these problems, we propose a low-light image enhancement method based on the combination of global dual gamma correction and Whale Optimization Algorithm(WOA). Firstly, we use the double gamma function to correct the image globally with the WOA algorithm, in addition, we optimize the selection of the parameter $(\alpha)$ to improve the convergence performance of the algorithm, so as to find the optimal gamma value to achieve the details of the image enhancement, and finally, we put in the U-Net network with the added attention to further optimize the image enhancement. The experimental results show that the overall underwater enhancement effect of this paper is better than other comparative algorithms, and the evaluation indexes PNSR, SSIM, and UIQM achieve the highest values of 33.01, 0.974, and 3.042, respectively.

articleTitle: Improved algorithm for small object detection in aerial image based on YOLOv7 model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For the problems of high false negative and false positive rate of the current detection technology for small object detection in aerial image, we proposed a small object detection for aerial image based on the improved YOLOv7. Firstly, a SPPCSPC-MP model is proposed to capture weakly salient small objects in aerial images in order to improve the model’s feature capture capability for small objects. Secondly, we introduced the SPD-Conv module for low-resolution images and small target refinement detection. The SPD-Conv module solves the problems of losing fine-grained information and low learning efficiency for feature representation in the original model. Then, The K-means++ is used to re-cluster the anchor boxes, which makes the anchor boxes fit the objects more closely and increases the network’s localisation accuracy on the object. Finally, we evaluate the performance of the improved algorithm on the processed DOTA aerial image dataset. The experimental results show that the improved YOLOv7 model has a mean average precision (mAP) of 77.8% and a recall of 75.2%, which is an improvement of 5.3% and 5.6% compared to the baseline model, and effectively improve the quality of small object detection in aerial image.

articleTitle: A Dual-Loop LDO with Voltage-Controlled Oscillator Based Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A voltage-controlled oscillator based low-dropout regulator with dual loops is proposed. The fine-tuning loop processes signals in the time domain using voltage-controlled oscillators and a frequency comparator, achieving precise voltage regulation. The coarse-tuning loop utilizes continuous-time comparators, ensures fast transient response. This LDO is designed and simulated based on the $0.18-\mu \mathrm{m}$ CMOS process. The simulation results demonstrate that the LDO can maintain a 1 V output voltage with a maximum load current of 50 mA when the input voltage ranges from 1.2 V to 2 V. When a load current steps from 1 mA to 11 mA within 15 ns, the drop voltage and settle time are 127 mV and $0.1 \mu \mathrm{s}$, respectively.

articleTitle: Grain yield prediction in Shandong Province based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on the relevant influencing index data of grain production in Shandong Province from 2000 to 2021, eight variables including the number of employees in the primary industry, the grain price index of the previous year, the sown area of grain crops, the total power of machinery, the amount of pesticide application, the amount of fertilizer application, the rural electricity consumption and the effective irrigation area were taken as the input value of the neural network, and the grain output was taken as the output value. The grain output of Shandong Province from 2019 to 2021 is forecasted. The results show that the prediction model of grain yield in Shandong Province based on BP neural network is an effective method with high fitting accuracy. The application of BP neural network in grain yield forecasting has high precision, which accords with the objective reality in grain yield forecasting, and has guiding significance for grain forecasting in government departments.

articleTitle: Research on the Relationship Between New Energy Vehicles and Dual Carbon in Yangtze River Delta Based on GRA-LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: New energy automobile industry plays an important role in building a green, low-carbon and recycling industrial system. In this paper, the prediction simulation training and prediction accuracy comparison study are carried out with the help of the newly constructed GRA-LSTM model, Biological Neural Network model and the first-order one-variable gray GM (1, 1) model. The LSTM model is created and trained by Learning Rate Decay function. The Learning Rate Decay callback function is set, and the learning rate is gradually reduced during the training process to carry out simulation training, and finally the trained model is used to make predictions, and the time for the Yangtze River Delta region to reach carbon peak is 2028, and the time to reach carbon neutrality is 2060, and at the same time this paper analyzes and finds out that the higher the new energy automobile market ownership is, the shorter the time for carbon peak and carbon neutrality will be.2.

articleTitle: EANet: Enhanced Attention-based Model for Surface Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Surface defect detection is an crucial part of industrial production processes, many automated methods have been proposed to replace manual detection ways. Aim at the shortcomings of existing typical attention-based methods, this paper proposes an enhanced attention-based model for surface defect detection. Specifically, on the basis of the original classification task, Firstly we add a segmentation task and design another classification task connecting the output features of the segmentation task. Then, we construct a softmax attention module between the two classification tasks mentioned above. subsequently, we introduce a distribution vector to better utilize the attention mechanism mentioned above. Finally, we conduct experiments on publicly available datasets and verify the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: YOLOv5 for Enhanced Small Object Detection in Paired IR and Depth Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper introduces a comprehensive approach to enhance Time-of-Flight (ToF) infrared image object detection. A novel Depth Images Enhancement method using Joint Filtering and Partial Convolution is proposed, simulating real-world distortions in low-quality depth maps. The Joint Depth Filtering Network and Partial Convolution are integrated to mitigate noise and invalid pixels. Additionally, the research refines the loss function selection for YOLOv5 in ToF image object detection. The adaptation of the Complete Intersection over Union Loss to Alpha Intersection over Union Loss ($\alpha=3$) enhances model robustness without introducing complexity. The refined loss function is expressed and validated, contributing to improved YOLOv5 performance. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A Blind Detection Method for Weak Signals Based on Response Matrix
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This article proposes and establishes a multi antenna weak signal detection model based on array antenna response matrix in wireless communication systems. Based on uniform linear array (ULA) and uniform circular array (UCA), two signal detection algorithms based on the ratio of random matrix eigenvalues are used: average-maximum eigenvalue (AME) algorithm and average-difference eigenvalue (ADE) algorithm based on the sample covariance matrix. A simulation of weak signal blind detection with multi antenna cooperation was conducted. The simulation results show that the signal detection method based on this model does not require prior information of signals and noise, and can achieve signal blind detection with excellent performance under very low signal-noise-ratio (SNR), low sample points, low antenna cooperation, and low false alarm probability.

articleTitle: A Fast Inter Mode Decision Approach Based on Machine Learning for Video Compressor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: When making mode decisions of inter frames in H.264 [1], the encoder must perform exhaustive calculations of the costs of Rate Distortion (RD) on all modes and find the optimal one. This procedure has high computational complexity for many redundant calculations. A Machine Learning based mode division strategy is proposed in this paper, which can accurately and quickly predict unnecessary modes and improve the overall encoding speed. The strategy uses the logistic regression model [2] and includes three features: the Quantization Parameter (QP), the variance, and the best RD cost of the 16x16 macroblock. The experimental results on different video scenes show that compared with the existing fast mode in x264, the speed is increased by 13.5% and the quality is improved by 0.15%.

articleTitle: A Method for Constructing Synthetic Datasets for Weakly Textured Pipe Instance Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Instance segmentation is of great significance for the automatic picking of weakly textured pipes. However, it is hard to acquire synthetic datasets with a robust sim-to-real capability for training instance segmentation models due to the domain gap between the synthetic and real images. This paper proposes a method for generating photorealistic images of weakly textured pipes using BlenderProc2 and automatically constructing a synthetic dataset. The innovation of this approach lies in combining Physically-Based Rendering (PBR) with domain randomization techniques to reduce the sim-to-real gap. The presented results on instance segmentation tasks indicate that the Mask R-CNN model with PointRend module achieves a 9.919% improvement in Average Precision (AP) for segmentation and an almost 29% improvement for bounding boxes when trained on images synthesized using the proposed method, compared to training on realistic images combined with data augmentation. Thus, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified in this study.

articleTitle: The Association between Childhood Maltreatment, Self-Esteem, and Attachment in Adult Women Based on Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This study used the Childhood Trauma Questionnaire, Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale, and Experiences in Close Relationships Inventory to analyze the associations among childhood maltreatment, self-esteem, and adult attachment in four hundred eighty-seven single adult women. IBM SPSS was used to examine correlation analysis and variance analysis; EXCEL was used to draw line figures for variance analysis; and SPSS AMOS was employed to do latent variable structural equation modeling. The results showed that self-esteem was significantly and negatively associated with childhood physical abuse, emotional abuse, sexual abuse, physical neglect, and emotional neglect. Moreover, attachment avoidance and attachment anxiety were significantly and positively associated with all five types of maltreatment. Analysis of variance results indicated that childhood physical neglect had the most minor effect on self-esteem, attachment avoidance, and attachment anxiety at the moderate to severe maltreatment levels. Physical abuse had the most effect on both self-esteem and attachment avoidance, whereas sexual abuse had the most effect on attachment anxiety at the severe level. The structural equation model results suggested that both emotional neglect and physical abuse negatively predicted self-esteem and positively predicted attachment avoidance and attachment anxiety. Moreover, self-esteem partially mediated the association between emotional neglect and attachment avoidance, and also partially mediated the association between physical abuse and attachment anxiety. Therefore, we concluded that five types of childhood maltreatment had adverse effects on self-esteem and adult attachment. Self-esteem played a partial mediating role in the associations between emotional neglect and attachment avoidance, and between physical abuse and attachment anxiety, respectively.

articleTitle: Estimation of Surface Layer Optical Turbulence using K-Nearest Neighbor Model in Northwest China
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents an estimate of surface layer optical turbulence in Northwest China’s Gansu Province using K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) model with conventional meteorological parameters such as temperature, relative humidity, wind speed, etc. In the KNN model, the Euclidean distance is used as a metric, the mean function is used as a label calculation method, and the optimal value of the number of neighbor samples k is determined by the grid search method. The estimated and measured results were compared. The results shows that the overall trend of the estimated and measured values is relatively consistent. The mean absolute percentage error of the model is 2.48% and the mean absolute error is 0.343. Under clear weather conditions, the model performs well in all-day variations, as well as in the morning and twilight changes. However, for rainy days, the model estimations are on the high side, and the model accuracy needs to be further improved.

articleTitle: Research on Classification Based on Core Region of Commodity Image
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The diversification of commodity images brings challenges to the information annotation of ecommerce platform. The definition method of core area of commodity images used in this paper suppresses the background part of non-main area, highlights the main area, and can locate the parts of interest. Aiming at the problems of insufficient contrast and critical visible deviation in commodity images, this paper uses a gradient-based Gaussian Markov random field feature extraction algorithm. Experimental results show that compared with the original Gaussian Markov random field features, this feature not only describes the boundary change information more comprehensively, but also conforms to the human visual characteristics more, and the classification effect is better under the same classifier parameters. In this paper, the commodity image data set CD (Commodity Dataset) data set to verify the effectiveness of the classification algorithm of the core region of commodity images.

Author Keywords: characteristics of gaussian markov random fields

articleTitle: Design of Multi Area Wireless Clock Synchronization in UWB Positioning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As an indoor high-precision positioning technology, UWB has many advantages. Its TDOA solution principle based on time difference of arrival requires extremely high clock synchronization accuracy. The wired synchronization method faces difficulties in circuit design and engineering construction, and it is not suitable for large-scale engineering applications. This paper studies the basic principles of wireless clock synchronization, extends the principle of multi area wireless clock synchronization, abstracts a simpler general processing method, and further proposes a design of multi-previous synchronous anchors, and improves system reliability. Actual test proves the method is effective.

articleTitle: Application of Self-Distillation Framework in Transmission Line Defect Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Drones have become very common in inspections of transmission lines across the country, but the images and videos captured by drones still require manual processing, which is time-consuming and labor-intensive, not intelligent enough to meet real-time requirements, and the response is relatively passive; currently in the power sector artificial intelligence has been used to process drone footage, but it has not yet reached the level of human experts. In recent years, methods to improve model performance have focused on conceiving new network structures and improving the quantity and quality of sample sets. Both methods are costly. This paper proposes a training framework for the model based on self-distillation. Without changing the model structure or changing the data set, you can learn the knowledge of your own network to improve model performance and use smaller models under the same performance requirements. Based on this framework, we implemented a self-distillation system on ResNet and verified the framework by comparing original training and self-distillation training. Of course, this framework is also applicable to other networks. Experiments show that the self-distillation method can significantly improve the accuracy of recognition.

articleTitle: Automatic Feature Engineering: Getting an Insight of Consumers’ Attitudes towards AI-Generated Advertising
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rise of artificial-intelligence driven large language models, an increasing number of marketing tasks are being delegated to generative AI. But consumers’ attitudes towards AI-generated advertisements are quite ambivalent, meriting exploration. This study has collected a dataset of human attitudes towards AI advertisements and has applied two automatic feature mining algorithms from machine learning to extract two sets of generated features, consistency and dynamism. Furthermore, by integrating expertise from the marketing domain, the study explores the interpretability behind the high-order features, representing a cutting-edge attempt to address business problems with machine learning and feature engineering. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Review of Researches on Power Cables Ampacity Calculation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Ampacity is an important index of power cable operation, and the accuracy of its calculation model is of great significance to the lean management of the cable and the stable operation of the power grid. Based on the definition of cable rated current-carrying capacity, this paper analyzes the relevant standards for the current-carrying capacity calculation of power cables at home and abroad, and focuses on the advantages and disadvantages of the analytical method based on the hot circuit model and the numerical calculation method based on the finite element model for current-carrying calculation models. Combined with the development of the digital transformation of the power grid, the calculation of cable current-carrying capacity is summarized and prospeced.

articleTitle: Spacecraft Close-range Attitude Tracking Control via Extended State Observer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This study is concerned with the spacecraft close-range attitude tracking control system with parameter uncertainty and external disturbances. First, an extended state observer is employed to estimate and compensate for the rotational inertia uncertainty and external disturbances. Second, based on the integral terminal sliding mode surface, the attitude tracking control law with unmeasured angular velocity is proposed which guarantee the attitude control system asymptotically stable. Finally, through the simulation results, the effectiveness of the proposed control law is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Research on Low Latency Frame Structure in the Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The construction of the energy IoT has achieved preliminary results, but the introduction of green new energy has placed higher demands on it. Due to the instability of their output power, these new energy sources require real-time control and scheduling. Therefore, ensuring low-latency transmission of signals in the energy IoT is crucial and the most important issue in the energy IoT. The fixed configuration of traditional TDD systems for uplink and downlink transmission results in uncontrollable transmission latency, which cannot meet the requirements for low latency. This paper proposes a flexible and variable low-latency TDD frame structure that can quickly change the uplink-downlink configuration of TDD. In addition, we also propose a short-latency transmission scheme that adjusts the modulation scheme flexibly using channel information, thereby increasing the probability of successful demodulation with only two transmissions.

articleTitle: Design of Simulation Demonstration System for Unmanned Equipment Simulation Test
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to make up for the shortcomings of practical test, supplement test sample data, improve test efficiency, and reduce test costs, the use of simulation test has become an important mode of unmanned equipment test. The specific method is to use a simulation test platform to collect experimental data and conduct evaluation and analysis. This paper focuses on the requirements of unmanned equipment simulation test, clarifies the design principles of simulation test, and conducts simulation test process design. The overall design of the simulation demonstration system is carried out from the aspects of system architecture, environmental simulation design, target model design, and demonstration verification function design. Through the above analysis, it can guide the construction of simulation test conditions, standardize the implementation process of simulation tests, and provide method support and technical framework for unmanned equipment simulation test.

articleTitle: Temperature Dependence Survey for a 2.5-2.9 GHz GaAs Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To investigate the temperature property of the GaAs MMIC PA, series temperature simulations and analysis have been carried out in this paper. It can be shown that the outputs of RF small signal and large signal all lower with the rising temperature. Therefore, this 2.5-2.9 GHz MMIC GaAs PA is sensitive with temperature,, it is reasonable to provide important guidelines for MMIC design.

articleTitle: Surface Flaw Recognition of Engine Connecting Rod Based on Mathematical Morphology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To improve the detection accuracy of surface flaws on the engine connecting rod (ECR) and ensure their service life, an automatic detection method for ECR surface flaws is proposed by combining image processing technology. A set of surface flaw detection and identification systems for the ECR is developed and is based on machine vision. To decrease errors in the natural collection, a platform is designed independently that can realize adjustment of the X, Y, and Z axes. To obtain the ECR surface flaw, the image processing method was proposed. The developed system includes gray-scale transform, pretreatment, median filtering, binarization operation, mathematical morphology, segmentation, feature extraction, etc. On the basis of the mathematical morphology, the recognition of the surface flaw of the ECR is analyzed in detail. The different sizes and shapes of the structural elements on image processing are analyzed. The system has implemented algorithm design for image acquisition, gray-scale conversion, and binarization, and has conducted experimental tests on the processing performance, real-time performance, and reliability of platform applications, achieving certain phased results.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Substation Load Monitoring System via the Data Sharing Center
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Load monitoring is a critical component of the operation of an electrical power system. However, in practical applications, the granularity of monitoring systems is often limited to the substation level, lacking accurate perception of the electricity load of lower-level users. This limitation results in monitoring systems being unable to proactively intervene with high-load users at the lower level after detecting heavy overloads in the station area, and can only passively take measures such as power rationing. To address this issue, this paper proposes an Enhanced Substation Load Monitoring (ESLM) system. ESLM is based on a Measurement Data Sharing Center (DSC) that aggregates data sources and possesses a dual-level perception capability for substations and residential loads. Specifically, ESLM only monitors substations that frequently experience high loads, achieving monitoring in a lower cost and easier to operate manner, and automatically triggers alarms when the station/user load exceeds the threshold. The practical results demonstrate that ESLM improves the granularity and accuracy of load monitoring, reduces monitoring complexity, and effectively improves the efficiency of substation operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Research on Shareholder Association Analysis Based on Apriori Algorithm of Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the progress of Internet technology, the behavior information left by users on the network is increasing. Through the application of data mining technology, we can find the underlying rules between these behaviors and reveal the valuable information they contain, which is of great significance for a deeper understanding of the cross-influence in the market and the potential market trends. This paper selects the classic Apriori algorithm of association rules in data mining, introduces the basic concepts of association rules and Apriori algorithm, and uses Python programming language to analyze the association of shareholders in financial industry. The analysis provides a reference basis for mining the relationship between shareholders in the industry.

articleTitle: Research on Oracle Bone Inscriptions Recognition From Multi-Source Data Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: How to carry out recognition process in a quick and effective way is important to the oracle bone inscriptions research area. In this paper, we proposed a recognition method which adopt a skeletonization process to normalize handwriting and rubbing forms of oracle bone inscriptions into the same expression. Then by using models based on CNN such as VGG19, AlexNet and ResNet34, the proposed method can simultaneously handle recognition work with mixed input. The experiment results showed that our method achieve a good performance applied in the real oracle bone inscriptions data set.

articleTitle: A Scalable Target Indexing and Retrieval System for Massive Video Data Processing based on Elasticsearch and Hadoop
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapidly development of video surveillance techniques, more and more high resolution video files are generated. However, traditional video surveillance system cannot utilize the massive data efficiently. This paper proposes a scalable video processing and target retrieval system based on Hadoop and Elasticsearch. The imported massive videos can be parallel processed with transcode, target detection and feature extraction modules. These video processing modules are packaged and provide RPC services through thrift. With the design of decoupling, other detection and feature extraction algorithms can be easily integrated in our application to improve the speed and performance. We also build an easy-to-use application for users to manage the processing procedure, monitor the processing status, retrieve detected targets with defined rules and analysis the relationships of targets to discover underlying connections between different targets with time and geo-spatial interactions.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a New Intelligent Driving Habit Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the continuous development of society, cars have become one of the most frequently used means of transportation in modern times. In order to alleviate the severe domestic traffic situation and ensure the driving safety of others, it is urgent to develop good driving habits among drivers. This article proposes the design and implementation of a new intelligent driving habit detection system. This system mainly measures driving speed and angle through the gyroscope module to determine whether the driving behavior complies with the rules. After the driving is finally stopped, the scores measured in different driving modes will be Displayed on the LCD display and mobile phone Bluetooth APP. At the same time, the system is equipped with photovoltaic power generation modules stored in built-in batteries, which are flexible, easy to operate, energy-saving, environmentally friendly, and highly reliable. The system function is very stable and meets the national environmental protection requirements, and the market application prospects are very broad.

articleTitle: Bolt anomaly detection based on yolov8 and point cloud
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As a common connecting element, bolts are widely used in industries such as railway bridges, wind turbine towers, and building structures. However, due to long-term use, environmental changes, etc., loose bolts may cause instability and safety hazards to the equipment. Therefore, online bolt loosening monitoring is particularly important. For urban rail data, according to the box information, the template point cloud to be registered is obtained. The test point cloud to be registered will first be subject to yolov8 target detection, and then the IOU matching rule will be used to determine whether the bolt is lost, and the bolts that are not lost will be processed. Looseness detection, therefore, we directly take the target detection frame matched by the test point cloud and obtain the test point cloud to be matched. Point cloud registration uses GICP for registration. The target point cloud and test point cloud are segmented separately. Effective normal vectors are obtained for the target point cloud and test point cloud planes, and the normal vectors of the template bolt and the test bolt are obtained., calculate the angle between any two normal vectors. The angle between the normal vectors is used to determine whether the bolt is loose. The test data results show that this method can detect whether the bolt is loose.

articleTitle: 3DSP-GAN: A 3D-to-3D Network for CT Reconstruction from Biplane X-rays
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the advantages of lower imaging costs and radiation damage, reconstruction of corresponding CT images from X-ray images not only provides richer and more intuitive 3D information, but also improves imaging efficiency. However, existing studies still have some limitations in reconstructing the details of internal organs in CT. Based on this problem, in this paper, we propose a 3DGAN network framework, 3DSP-GAN, for biplane X-ray reconstruction of lung CT. Our approach reduces the semantic gap of cross-dimensional images by constructing a 3D-3D generator network and also proposes a Res-SP downsampling module for feature extraction, which makes the generated lung CT structures clearer. Experimental results show that our method is advantageous for the reconstruction of lung internal details, and the reconstruction quality is also better than existing methods.

articleTitle: An Invention Relates to a Design Method of a 10kV Cable Joint Fault On-line Monitoring Device
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on the risk assessment of fire and explosion failure of power cable joints, this paper designs a set of online monitoring device for faults caused by excessive short circuit load of 10kV cable joints. The device realizes online monitoring of temperature, zero sequence voltage, sheath grounding current, ambient temperature and humidity of the cable joints. All kinds of potential faults and fire risks of power cable joints are intelligently diagnosed, which realize all-round monitoring of the safe operation of power cables.

articleTitle: On-load Tap Changer Fault Diagnosis Based on Improved Whale Algorithm Optimized LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to realize accurate fault diagnosis of on-load tap changer (OLTC), an OLTC fault diagnosis method based on improved WOA optimized long short term memory(LSTM) neural network was proposed. Firstly, the WOA algorithm was improved by hybrid initialization strategy, nonlinear dynamic update strategy and elite solution retention strategy to improve the convergence. Then, the number of hidden layer nodes and learning rate of LSTM were optimized by improving WOA algorithm to obtain the optimal LSTM model. Then, the feature vector was formed by extracting the characteristics of OLTC vibration signal in time domain, frequency domain and energy entropy. The feature vector was input into the optimal LSTM neural network for learning and fault diagnosis. The results show that the average accuracy of the method is 98.7%, which is suitable for OLTC fault diagnosis.

Author Keywords: long short term memory neural network

articleTitle: A 2.5 V - 5.5 V, 800 kHz Relaxation Oscillator with Delay Cancellation Using Frequency to Voltage Feedback
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A 800 kHz relaxation oscillator based on frequency-voltage feedback is designed in a 90 nm BCD technology for the power management unit. The proposed relaxation oscillator adopts frequency-voltage feedback circuit, in which the output frequency is converted to the voltage as a feedback signal to adjust output frequency. By utilizing frequency-voltage feedback, it compensates the delays introduced by the comparators and the capacitor reset logic. The proposed oscillator has minimized sensitivity to supply voltage variations by utilization of a widlar current source. And temperature stability is achieved by the temperature compensation resistance. The proposed oscillator demonstrates a frequency variation of only ±0.7% over the supply voltage range of 2.5 V to 5.5 V, while a variation of ±0.4% over −40 °C - 120 °C.

articleTitle: Vehicle Natural Gas Leakage Detection System Based on HWD32F103 Design
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to ensure the safe operation of urban vehicles, a vehicle natural gas leakage detection system based on a domestically produced HWD32F103 microcontroller was designed. The system consists of a host, a set of leakage sensors, and temperature sensors. The sensors transmit the measured temperature and gas concentration information to the host through CAN communication, and display the measured data in real time through the TFT-LCD color screen on the host. The system has data storage, offline detection, and alarm functions. The experiment shows that the system can timely and accurately detect natural gas leaks and temperature anomalies in vehicles, ensuring the safety of the vehicle during operation.

articleTitle: A Software Defect Prediction Approach based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In recent years, there has been an increasing interest in using machine learning methods to predict software defects. In practical engineering applications, the number of defective software samples is far less than that of non-defective software samples, resulting in unbalanced distribution of samples. In addition, the prediction performance of a single classifier is limited due to the diversity of distribution of defect data. Therefore, a series of methods should be adopted to solve these problems to improve the accuracy and reliability of software defect prediction. Here, the combined sampling method is used to deal with the class imbalance problem, and the minority class defect samples are synthesized. Through improved Bagging, different base classifiers are selected to increase the diversity of classifiers in defect prediction, and the final prediction result is obtained by weighted integration of multiple classifiers according to the Accuracy value of each classifier for the test set classification. Through the above method, a better classification effect is obtained.

articleTitle: GR-PBFT: Optimization of PBFT Consensus Algorithm for Supply Chain Traceability
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The blockchain consensus algorithm PBFT has the problems of high communication overhead, high latency, and low consensus efficiency, which cannot well meet the application needs of supply chain traceability scenarios. Therefore, this article proposes the GR-PBFT consensus algorithm based on the characteristics of supply chain traceability. Firstly, a node comprehensive evaluation model based on multidimensional indicators was proposed to achieve quantitative evaluation of nodes. On this basis, a grouping model considering node geographic location and comprehensive evaluation integral was proposed, forming a double-layer consensus architecture that reduces communication latency and improves consensus efficiency. Finally, a consistency protocol within and outside the group was designed to reduce communication overhead. The experiment shows that the GR-PBFT algorithm has lower communication overhead, higher throughput, and lower latency, and has good consensus efficiency, which can provide a reference for supply chain traceability.

articleTitle: Research on Lightweight Ensemble Algorithm for Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As business rapidly evolves, the types of business services become increasingly complex. The conventional approach of manually configuring rules for maintenance and quality assurance systems is gradually proving inadequate, and there is a growing demand for intelligent operations (AIOps) and quality assurance. This paper proposes an anomaly detection algorithm by ensemble various algorithms. Originating from operation and maintenance scenarios, this algorithm is gradually applied to business scenarios. The process involves streaming data collection, data preprocessing, anomaly detection models, and monitoring alerts, thereby realizing multidimensional anomaly detection in both operational and business scenarios. In comparison to traditional monitoring platforms, the proposed algorithm saves manpower and exhibits higher accuracy. Furthermore, when compared to traditional machine learning algorithms, it saves resources and provides faster response times.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Aerobic Exercise Assistant
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the improvement of people’s living standards and the enhancement of health awareness, more and more people are paying attention to their physical health. Aerobic exercise as a beneficial exercise method has received widespread attention and pursuit. Meanwhile, an increasing number of studies and experiments have shown that aerobic exercise has a positive effect on improving physical health and preventing chronic diseases. Therefore, this article designs and develops a sports assistant system based on the STM32 microcontroller which realizes functions such as heart rate detection, temperature detection, step detection, voice broadcasting, GPS positioning and Bluetooth communication for athletes. This enables athletes to timely understand their own exercise status, help users understand their exercise habits and effects and guide users to engage in healthier exercise methods.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of a Cloud-Based Glaucoma Auxiliary Diagnosis Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The main purpose of this research is to design a cloud-based open, shared, collaborative, multi-tenant, multi-organization glaucoma auxiliary diagnosis service platform. It mainly includes the research on the current situation at home and abroad, and analyzes the existing problems. On this basis, aiming at the problems of irreversible glaucoma and uneven distribution of medical resources, the service mode and concept of intelligent medical treatment are proposed to provide a unified portal for hospitals, doctors and patients, so that they can access the platform and choose the services they need. The platform uses information technologies such as cloud computing, big data, and artificial intelligence to achieve data sharing by obtaining patient VF data. Use big data to alert users of possible health risks in advance, and maximize the use of data to prevent possible health problems for users. According to the service model, complete the IaaS, PaaS, SaaS logic architecture and system architecture design; complete the service function development, database modeling development and visual interface development, and finally realize the platform operation. Transform traditional medical services into digital medical services, provide users with streamlined, standardized and precise services, and solve the current problems of uneven distribution of medical resources, non-sharing of data, and insufficient service strength. Promote the deep integration of Internet technology and medical care, and promote the development of information technology in the medical service industry.

articleTitle: Design of distributed control system for wiped film molecular distillation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The wiped film molecular distillation is a molecular still with a rotating scraped film structure, which has the advantages of fast separation and high purity. In this paper, Distributed Control System (DCS) is used to automate the control of the film evaporation process, and establish the control master and slave station. The speed of the feed motor, the speed of the film motor, the temperature of the thermostat and the hot oil machine in the two-stage distillation process are detected and controlled by two circuits in the film scraper evaporator. The hardware of the distributed system is configured and programmed by the STEP7 of SIMATIC to control the process of film evaporation. Then use configuration software designs a monitoring interface for the two-stage distillation process, which is convenient to record real-time data, realize remote safety control of the film scraping evaporation process.

articleTitle: Research on Electronic Police System Based on Intelligent Vision Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of traffic and the increasing number of motor vehicles increases the difficulty of traffic supervision and seriously endangers people’s personal safety. Traditional electronic police have low efficiency, poor accuracy, and other disadvantages, which cannot well meet the various needs brought by the development of current traffic. The system is based on Yolov5+DeepSort algorithm and HyperLPR algorithm to realize the recognition and monitoring of vehicle, license plate and other information. The system uses MySQL relational database management. Finally, PyQt5 is used to display the interface. The cloud electronic police system established by this technology has better performance and can effectively assist traffic management, regulate travel and reduce the occurrence of traffic accidents.

articleTitle: Research on optimal scheduling strategy of water and light complementary based on improved particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the continuous progress and development of society, problems such as environmental pollution and energy shortage have become increasingly prominent. Vigorously developing renewable energy and actively promoting the transformation of energy structure are of great significance for the sustainable development of social economy. Photovoltaic output is highly susceptible to climate environment and other factors, separate integration into the power grid will cause a threat to the safe and stable operation of the power grid or produce a large number of abandoned electricity, through the regulation of good performance, rapid shutdown and clean and pollution-free hydropower and its joint integration into the power grid, can improve the utilization efficiency of renewable clean energy. In this paper, the average value of the total output fluctuation of the system is used to characterize the coordination of the water-light complementary integrated system, and the efficiency of the water-light comprehensive output electricity is used to characterize the economy of the system. A short-term optimal scheduling model of water-light complementary is established considering the coordination and economy of water light, and the daily operation law of hydropower and photovoltaic power generation is analyzed. The results show that the water-light complementary integrated system can consider the coordination of system operation, and realize the maximization of power generation economy while ensuring the minimum fluctuation of total water-light output.

articleTitle: Research on Information System Budget Generation Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The construction of information system projects has many characteristics, including numerous and complex functional requirements, frequent changes in requirements, longer construction periods, and a greater amount of post-maintenance work. Compared with project construction in other industries, the field of information system construction lacks a quota library similar to civil engineering or communication engineering projects, which makes existing budgeting methods and platforms for other industries unsuitable for information system project construction. To address these issues, in this article, we will combine various information and intelligent technologies and propose a method and platform construction plan suitable for information system budget generation, aiming to achieve scientific, accurate, compliant, and efficient budget work.

articleTitle: A Random and Unselectable Graphic Password Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The most widely popular graphic password design scheme among them is the Android graphic unlocking scheme (AUP). AUP and AUP based graphic password schemes often use only a very small part of their theoretical password space in practical use, resulting in AUP’s actual security far falling short of theoretical security. Therefore, AUP actually has significant security risks and is more susceptible to attacks and cracking by attackers. This article proposes a random and non optional graphic password scheme, which effectively avoids the potential risk of shoulder scanning attacks due to its randomness. In addition, the scheme incorporates image elements, making the user’s memory of the set password more vivid and vivid. In this scheme, the image is divided into 8x8 squares, and the password setting habit is broken to avoid the problem of overly simple passwords caused by user usage habits. Additionally, a randomly selected square is designed to effectively prevent enumeration attacks, brute force attacks, and shoulder scanning attacks, resulting in higher security and ease of use.

articleTitle: Research on Network Security Threat Analysis Method Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Network security threat analysis is an important component of network security assessment. Traditional threat analysis methods cannot effectively integrate multi-source information and adapt to the rapidly changing network attack and defense situation. To address the above issues, a network security threat analysis method based on knowledge graph is proposed. Firstly, this article constructs a network security ontology model, which models the concepts and relationships in the field of network security, and then associates and integrates multi-source network security information. Next, this article constructs a network security knowledge graph based on ontology. Then, a network security threat path prediction, traceability, and analysis method based on knowledge graph is proposed to accurately perceive cyberspace security threat. Finally, by comparing with traditional threat detection methods, it is verified that the network security threat analysis method based on knowledge graph proposed in this article is more suitable for perceiving high-strength security threat.
